note_ja: Home Reef の島から南へ黄緑の変色水が渦を巻いて伸び、10-16 にも島の周りに同様の緑の水がある (活動の継続と見られる)。
note_en: Yellow-green discoloured water swirls and extends south from the Home Reef island, and on 10-16 there is similar green water around the island (seen as continuing activity).

note_ja: 中心の東北東 0.3 km に青緑の斑 0.21 km2、東へ淡い尾。快晴で雲の影響はない。この後 10 月まで続く変色水の最初の検知。2019-20 年火口の位置 (区域の中心から 1 km 以内) から出る緑〜青緑の変色水。回ごとに形と向きが変わり (06-10 は南東へ伸びる帯、07-10 は幅のある斑、07-20 は一点から南西へ尾を引く筋)、動かない浅瀬の見え方ではない。短波長赤外では暗く、雲から離れている。2026-04-11 から 10-08 まで 53 回の観測のうち 16 回で候補が出ており、面積は 6〜7 月が最大 (0.7〜0.9 km2)。2025-11 から 2026-03 までは出ていない。軽石・噴煙・新しい陸地は見えない。
note_en: A blue-green patch of 0.21 km2 0.3 km east-north-east of the centre, with a faint tail to the east. Clear sky, no cloud influence. The first detection of discoloured water that continues until October after this. Green to blue-green discoloured water coming from the position of the 2019-20 vent (within 1 km of the zone centre). Its shape and direction change from pass to pass (06-10 a band extending south-east, 07-10 a broad patch, 07-20 a streak trailing south-west from a single point), so it is not the appearance of a stationary shoal. Dark in SWIR (short-wave infrared) and away from cloud. Of 53 observations from 2026-04-11 to 10-08, candidates appear in 16, with the largest area in June-July (0.7-0.9 km2). None from 2025-11 to 2026-03. No pumice, eruption plume or new land is visible.

note_ja: 06-30 は円の南西の巻雲の筋と積雲の縁に沿う淡い灰色の候補。07-05 と 07-10 は島の北東、シアン輪郭の小さな浅瀬の近くで、雲の隙間に淡い斑が出る (位置は 2-3 km ずれる)。雲の縁と霞の可能性が高いが、2 回とも浅瀬の近くなので確かめたい。
note_en: 06-30 is a pale grey candidate along cirrus streaks and cumulus edges south-west of the circle. On 07-05 and 07-10, pale patches appear in gaps in the cloud north-east of the island, near the small shoal with the cyan outline (the position shifts by 2-3 km). Most likely cloud edges and haze, but both times they are near the shoal, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 11/16 と 11/24 の候補は島の周りの浅い棚 (既知の浅瀬の輪郭) に沿う。12/6 と 12/21 は Sholan 島の北 0.5〜1 km のほぼ同じ所に細い緑の筋が出ており、浅瀬の輪郭の外で雲もない。
note_en: The 11/16 and 11/24 candidates follow the shallow shelf around the island (the outline of the known shoal). On 12/6 and 12/21 a thin green streak appears at almost the same place 0.5-1 km north of Sholan Island, outside the shoal outline and with no cloud.
2026-11-14: 2023-05-10: level L3, but the colour is poor and the detection is doubtful.

note_ja: 須美寿島の岩のすぐ北東に淡い白っぽい斑が接している。風影の可能性が高いが、岩に接するので念のため。
note_en: A pale whitish patch touches the rock of Sumisujima just to its north-east. Most likely a wind shadow, but it touches the rock, so just in case.

note_ja: 区域の南半分に色の薄いまだらな面（26 km2）が広がる。散在する積雲の周りの薄い霞らしく湧出点はないが、雲から離れた部分もあり確かではない。
note_en: A pale, mottled surface (26 km2) spreads over the southern half of the zone. It seems to be thin haze around scattered cumulus and there is no source point, but parts are away from cloud and it is not certain.

note_ja: Curtis 島の南東に暗い風下の帯とその脇の浮遊物候補、島から南南東へ淡い灰色の筋が伸びる。たぶん風下の凪と雲だが、噴気のある島なので念のため。
note_en: South-east of Curtis Island, a dark downwind band with a floating matter candidate beside it, and a pale grey streak extending south-south-east from the island. Probably a downwind calm and cloud, but the island has fumaroles, so just in case.

note_ja: 区域を北東-南西にまっすぐ横切る淡い水色の帯があり、候補はその上の小片。後の通過（2014-01-23）にも似た向きの帯が写り、潮目か船の航跡らしいが確かではない。
note_en: A faint light-blue band crosses the zone straight from north-east to south-west, and the candidate is a small piece on it. A band of similar direction is also captured on the later pass (2014-01-23); it seems to be a tide line or ship wake, but this is not certain.

note_ja: この回の候補は中央の雲の塊の脇の雲間の水で、雲による。ただ前の 08-18 の晴れた通過にゾーンを横切る白っぽい曲がった細い筋が数本写っており、2019-08 の Volcano F の軽石筏の時期に当たるので、筋が薄雲か軽石かを確かめたい。
note_en: This pass's candidate is water in gaps beside the central cloud mass and is due to cloud. However, the earlier clear pass on 08-18 shows several thin, curved whitish streaks crossing the zone, at the time of the Volcano F pumice raft in 2019-08, so I would like to check whether the streaks are thin cloud or pumice.

note_ja: 2-19と3-5は雲の縁や小さな積雲の間の小斑。3-10の約3 km2の白い斑は細長い小島の南東岸に接して広がり、薄い霞の下にあって雲の影響と言い切れない。前後の回に同じ斑はない。
note_en: 2-19 and 3-5 are small patches at cloud edges and between small cumulus. The white patch of about 3 km2 on 3-10 spreads against the south-east shore of a long thin islet, under thin haze, and cannot be put down to cloud with certainty. The passes before and after do not show the same patch.

note_ja: 島を覆う雲塊の北西の縁に淡い青緑の斑が散る (1.68 km2)。雲縁のもやの可能性が高いが、前の 03-28 にも島の西沖に青い渦状の斑があり、判断しきれない。
note_en: Pale blue-green patches are scattered along the north-west edge of the cloud mass covering the island (1.68 km2). Most likely haze at the cloud edge, but the previous pass, 03-28, also had a blue swirl-like patch off the west of the island, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: 浅瀬の位置に小さな緑の斑が MODIS と OLCI に出る。浅瀬そのものの可能性が高い。
note_en: A small green patch at the position of the shoal appears in MODIS and OLCI. Most likely the shoal itself.

note_ja: 円の中央の島 (Mahangetang 島) の南 1.5〜4 km に、南北に並ぶ小さな白っぽい斑と淡い筋がある。色は付いておらず潮目や海面の筋の見込みが高いが、島の側から南へ延びる形なので念のため。
note_en: 1.5-4 km south of the island in the middle of the circle (Mahangetang Island) there are small whitish patches lined up north-south and pale streaks. They are not coloured and a tide line or sea-surface streaks are very likely, but as they have the form of extending south from the island side, to be safe.

note_ja: 強い sun glint の回だが、中心付近から南東を回って西へ弧を描く緑の筋 1.4 km2 がある。前後の回 (11-09, 12-09) にも中心の点から水色の小さな斑が出ている。
note_en: A pass with strong sun glint, but there is a green streak of 1.4 km2 arcing from near the centre round the south-east to the west. On the passes before and after (11-09, 12-09) small light-blue patches also come out from the point at the centre.

note_ja: Curtis 島から北東〜東へ扇状に広がる乳白色〜淡い青の水 6.4 km2 (長さ 4 km 以上)。島の北・東・南を囲み、短波長赤外では暗く、雲から離れている。参照画像の島の周りに浅瀬は無い。前の観測 (05-31) は曇天、後の 06-25 は島のすぐ脇に 0.6 km2 まで縮小。この 1 年でこの区域に出た大きな候補はこの 1 回だけ。うねりで島の変質した岩屑が巻き上がった濁りの可能性と、島の周りの熱水活動による変色水の可能性があり、画像だけでは分けられない。
note_en: Milky-white to pale blue water of 6.4 km2 (more than 4 km long) spreading in a fan from Curtis Island to the north-east and east. It surrounds the island on the north, east and south, is dark in SWIR and is away from cloud. The reference image has no shoal around the island. The pass before (05-31) was overcast; on the following one, 06-25, it had shrunk to 0.6 km2 right beside the island. This is the only large candidate at this zone in the past year. It may be turbid water of altered rock debris of the island stirred up by swell, or discoloured water from hydrothermal activity around the island; the image alone cannot separate the two.

note_ja: ゾーン南東の薄い桃褐色のもや状の面の中に浮遊物候補 (0.06 km2) が散る。筋や帯の形はなく SWIR でも薄雲と同じ淡さなので薄雲か霞の可能性が高いが、2019 年に軽石筏を出した火山なので軽石は確かめたい (GVP243091-W の同じ日と同じ)。
note_en: Floating matter candidates (0.06 km2) are scattered within a faint pinkish-brown haze-like surface in the south-east of the zone. There is no streak or band shape, and in SWIR they are as faint as thin cloud, so most likely thin cloud or haze, but this volcano produced a pumice raft in 2019, so I would like pumice checked (same as GVP243091-W on the same date).

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 5/13,25,31は目視確認できた。それ以外は疑わしい。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Confirmed by eye on 05-13, 05-25 and 05-31. The other days are doubtful.

note_ja: 西の島の北西岸に乳青緑の水が帯状に付き (8.15 km2)、前の 11-23 (33.72 km2) と後の 2022-01-15 (42.44 km2) には両島のまわりに乳青緑の渦が大きく広がる。南大洋の円石藻ブルームや氷河の融水濁りの可能性もあるが、島に集中しており、2023-12 にも同じ場所に出るので見る。
note_en: Milky blue-green water clings in a band to the north-west shore of the western island (8.15 km2), and on the earlier 11-23 (33.72 km2) and the later 2022-01-15 (42.44 km2) milky blue-green swirls spread widely around both islands. It may be a Southern Ocean coccolithophore bloom or turbid glacial meltwater, but it is concentrated on the islands and also appears in the same place in 2023-12, so worth a look.

note_ja: 北硫黄島の南東岸から南へ淡い白っぽい水が延びる (2.1 km2)、区域中心から 5 km の島の岸。岸の浅い所の濁りの可能性が高いが、グリントも雲もない。
note_en: Pale whitish water extends south from the south-east shore of Kita-Ioto (2.1 km2), on the island's shore 5 km from the zone centre. Most likely turbid water in the shallows along the shore, but there is no glint and no cloud.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 自動判定を目視確認できる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: The automatic detection can be confirmed by eye.

note_ja: 火口中心から 0.12 km に緑の斑 (0.25 km2) があり、周りから南東へ淡い緑が広がる。雲から離れた晴れた海面で、2018-11 にも火口付近に緑の斑が出ている。浅い山頂の透視の可能性もあるが通常の見え方には写っていない。
note_en: A green patch (0.25 km2) 0.12 km from the vent centre, with faint green spreading around it and to the south-east. A clear sea surface away from cloud; in 2018-11 too a green patch appeared near the vent. It may be the shallow summit seen through the water, but it is not captured in the usual appearance.

note_ja: 中心から約0.7-1.2 kmの同じ位置に緑〜ターコイズの小斑が 05-14・05-16・05-19 と続き、後の 05-21 にも見える。そこから南西へ淡いターコイズの帯が延び、雲の影 (暗い斑) とは色が違う。
note_en: Small green to turquoise patches at the same position, about 0.7-1.2 km from the centre, on 05-14, 05-16 and 05-19 in a row, and also visible on the later 05-21. A pale turquoise band extends south-west from there, differing in colour from the cloud shadows (dark patches).

note_ja: Bogoslof 島の北側に乳青緑の水が積雲の間に広がる (2.80 km2、雲から離れている)。前の 04-04 にも島の周りに同じ色の帯があり、テフラ島の侵食の濁りの可能性が高いが、火山体に接するので一応見る。
note_en: Milky blue-green water spreads between cumulus on the north side of Bogoslof Island (2.80 km2, away from cloud). The previous 04-04 also had a band of the same colour around the island; most likely turbid water from erosion of the tephra island, but it touches the volcanic edifice, so I will look anyway.

note_ja: 12-30 にゾーン西縁を南北に長く走る乳緑の帯 (2.29 km2) が枠外の南南西へ続く。ゾーン内に点源は無いが、帯の先の約 10 km 南西に Kavachi があり、その変色水が流れ込んだ可能性がある (ブルームの可能性も残る)。01-04 は薄雲の中の斑。
note_en: On 12-30 a milky green band (2.29 km2) runs a long way north-south along the west edge of the zone and continues out of the frame to the south-south-west. There is no point source within the zone, but Kavachi lies about 10 km to the south-west beyond the band, and its discoloured water may have flowed in (a bloom remains possible). 01-04 is a patch within thin cloud.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた南西の島の東岸沿いに灰青の明るい帯 (5.56 km2) が沖へ約 1 km 広がる。2 月なので岸の氷や雪泥の可能性が高く、03-04 の後の画像も大きな候補になっているが、濁りと区別しきれない。
note_en: A bright grey-blue band (5.56 km2) along the east shore of the snow-covered south-western island spreads about 1 km offshore. As it is February, shore ice or slush is most likely, and the image after 03-04 is also a large candidate, but it cannot be fully distinguished from turbid water.

note_ja: 候補は島の間の海峡に散る白い氷片と雲縁の斑で、高緯度の流氷・雲で説明できる。ただし西の島の上から北へ細い白い筋が立ち上がっており、地形性の雲とみられるが噴気の可能性を見ておきたい。
note_en: The candidates are white ice fragments scattered in the strait between the islands and patches at cloud edges, explained by high-latitude drift ice and cloud. However, a thin white streak rises north from over the western island; it is seen as orographic cloud, but I would like to keep in mind the possibility of a fumarolic plume.

note_ja: 島の東端の岬から水色の水が沖へ延び、その先の淡い斑が囲まれた。2020-04-23 にも同じ場所に出る。沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが確認したい。
note_en: Light-blue water extends offshore from the cape at the east end of the island, and the pale patch beyond it was outlined. It also appears in the same place on 2020-04-23. Coastal turbid water is most likely, but I would like it checked.

note_ja: 09-28 と 10-13 にゾーン中央 (2021 年火口) に緑の斑があり、前後の通過にも同じ位置から渦を巻いて流れる緑の筋が写る。2021 年噴火後に続く変色水とみられる。10-03 の候補は雲の縁の白い水で、熱異常 4 px も雲域。
note_en: On 09-28 and 10-13 there is a green patch in the middle of the zone (the 2021 vent), and green streaks swirling out from the same position are captured on the passes before and after too. Seen as discoloured water continuing after the 2021 eruption. The 10-03 candidate is white water at a cloud edge, and the 4 px thermal anomaly is also in the cloud area.

note_ja: 島の南西岸沖、浅い棚の外側に淡い緑がかった水が海岸に沿う。2014-01-19 とほぼ同じ場所で、棚か沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが繰り返すので確認したい。
note_en: Off the south-west shore of the island, outside the shallow shelf, pale greenish water runs along the coast. Almost the same place as 2014-01-19; most likely the shelf or coastal turbidity, but it recurs, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 中心に小さな斑が OLCI と MODIS に 1 日ずつ。雲の脇で、MODIS は走査端の縞がある。
note_en: A small patch at the centre, on one day each in OLCI and MODIS. Beside cloud, and MODIS has stripes at the scan edge.

note_ja: 鳥島の北東すぐの海面に淡いまだらな斑（1.0 km2）。霞か海面の模様らしいが、活火山の島のすぐそばで、前の通過（04-12）が L3 だったため念のため。
note_en: A pale mottled patch (1.0 km2) on the sea just north-east of Torishima. It looks like haze or a sea-surface pattern, but it is right next to an active volcanic island and the previous pass (04-12) was L3, so to be safe.

note_ja: 08-21 は厚い霞と雲の下、08-26 は雲の隙間の水で、候補は雲の縁に沿う。09-30 は東の岩礁群 (既知浅瀬) の脇の緑の小片 0.05 km2。10-30 はパナレア島の北端の岸から北東へ淡い筋を引く青緑の斑 (0.35 km2) で、前後の通過には無い。沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、島の北東岸の噴気帯に近いので確認を。
note_en: 08-21 is under thick haze and cloud, and 08-26 is water in a gap in the cloud, with the candidates following cloud edges. 09-30 is a small green fragment of 0.05 km2 beside the group of reefs to the east (known shoal). 10-30 is a blue-green patch (0.35 km2) trailing a pale streak north-east from the shore at the northern tip of Panarea, not present on the earlier and later passes. Coastal turbid water is most likely, but it is close to the fumarolic area on the island's north-east shore, so please check.

note_ja: 区域中心に丸い青っぽい斑が2回とも同じ位置にあり、2017年7月の通過・普段の姿・前後の通過にも見える。既知浅瀬の印はないが海山頂の地形による常在の見え方らしい。
note_en: A round bluish patch at the zone centre is in the same position both times, and is also visible on the July 2017 pass, in the usual appearance and on the earlier and later passes. There is no known-shoal mark, but it seems to be a constant appearance due to the seamount summit topography.

note_ja: 中心の南西約2.5 kmに北北西〜南南東に伸びる細い淡緑の筋(長さ2 km程度、glint caution)。航跡や藻類の筋の可能性が高いが、南端に小さな斑があり決めきれない。前後の回には無い。
note_en: A thin pale green streak running north-north-west to south-south-east about 2.5 km south-west of the centre (about 2 km long, glint caution). A ship wake or algal streak is most likely, but there is a small patch at its southern end, so it cannot be decided. Not present on the earlier and later passes.

note_ja: 山頂から北北東へ伸びる緑の変色水のプルーム (8.89 km2) が晴天の場面に明瞭に写り、SWIR では暗い。前後の通過 (04-21, 05-06) にも同じ緑の変色水があり、頻繁に変色する Kavachi の継続中の活動と見られる。
note_en: A plume of green discoloured water (8.89 km2) extending north-north-east from the summit shows clearly in a clear-sky scene, and it is dark in SWIR. The same green discoloured water is present on the earlier and later passes (04-21, 05-06), and it appears to be the ongoing activity of Kavachi, which frequently discolours the water.

note_ja: 06-25 は快晴でグリントもない沖合（中心から 1.25 km）に緑〜ターコイズの小さな斑（0.16 km2）があり、南東へ淡い筋が尾を引く。SWIR は暗く雲ではなく、通常の見え方にも何もない。07-03 は Epi 島の海岸沿いのターコイズで、グリント severe と雲の下。
note_en: 06-25 is clear with no glint, and offshore (1.25 km from the centre) there is a small green to turquoise patch (0.16 km2) trailing a pale streak to the south-east. SWIR is dark so it is not cloud, and there is nothing in the usual appearance. 07-03 is turquoise along the coast of Epi Island, under glint severe and cloud.

note_ja: Panarea 島の東、東方岩礁群の近くの水面に淡い小さな斑 0.15 km2 と熱画素 2。薄い霞の下で雲から離れており、2002 年のガス噴出域に近いので一度確かめたい。
note_en: East of Panarea, near the eastern group of rocks, a small pale patch of 0.15 km2 on the water and 2 thermal pixels. Under thin haze and away from cloud, and close to the 2002 gas emission area, so I would like to check it once.

note_ja: 冬の雪に覆われた島で、湾内の西側と南東岸に沿う帯が白く拾われる (5.0、1.3、7.6 km2)。薄氷か岸の雪・氷によるものが有力だが、湾内の同じ側に 2 回出ており参照図もない。
note_en: On the snow-covered island in winter, bands along the western side of the bay and the south-east shore are picked up as white (5.0, 1.3, 7.6 km2). Thin ice or snow and ice on the shore is most likely, but it appeared twice on the same side of the bay and there is no reference image.

note_ja: 山頂の南東に北東-南西に延びる緑がかった水色の細長い斑。浅い山頂が透けて見える可能性もあるが、通常の見え方に浅瀬の輪郭は無い。山頂を中心とする同心円状の波紋 (リング状の波) がこの通過と前後の通過に見える。
note_en: A long greenish light-blue patch running north-east to south-west, south-east of the summit. The shallow summit may be showing through, but there is no shoal outline in the usual appearance. Concentric ring waves centred on the summit are visible on this pass and on the passes before and after.

note_ja: 04-05 は Jadid 島の北西端から北へ伸びる青緑の舌、05-10・05-23 は北西の小島の南東の浅い台地の縁の青緑の斑で、同じ位置に出る。前後の通過にも島の周りの青緑の暈が写り、浅い台地と若い島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、既知浅瀬の輪郭の外に一部はみ出す。06-19 は北西-南東の霞の筋に沿う候補。
note_en: 04-05 is a blue-green tongue extending north from the north-west tip of Jadid Island; 05-10 and 05-23 are blue-green patches at the edge of the shallow platform south-east of the north-western islet, at the same position. The blue-green halo around the island is also seen on the passes before and after; most likely turbid water from the shallow platform and erosion of the young island, but part of it extends beyond the outline of the known shoal. 06-19 is a candidate along a north-west to south-east haze streak.

note_ja: グリント注意の場面で、中心の西約6.5 kmに青緑の入り組んだ斑(4.1 km2)があり、SWIRでは何も写らない。周りに薄い雲の筋があり起点も見えないので薄雲やグリントか表層のブルームの可能性が高いが、色がはっきりしているので確認したい。
note_en: A scene under glint caution; about 6.5 km west of the centre there is an intricate blue-green patch (4.1 km2) that shows nothing in SWIR. There are thin cloud streaks around it and no origin is visible, so thin cloud, glint or a surface bloom is most likely, but as the colour is distinct I would like it checked.

note_ja: ゾーン中央の北寄りに緑の小斑 (0.2-0.35 km2) が 05-14・05-16 と後の 05-19 にもほぼ同じ位置に出て、05-14 は西へ淡い緑の筋を数 km 引く。雲から離れており (雲接 0.00)、05-14 は熱異常 4 画素。点から流れる火山性の変色水に見える。
note_en: A small green patch (0.2-0.35 km2) in the northern part of the middle of the zone appears in almost the same position on 05-14 and 05-16 and on the later 05-19 too, and on 05-14 it trails a pale green streak several km to the west. It is away from cloud (cloud contact 0.00), and 05-14 has a thermal anomaly of 4 pixels. It looks like volcanic discoloured water flowing from a point.

note_ja: 快晴・グリントなしの沖合、中心の北 1.3 km に小さな緑の斑（0.09 km2）があり、その東にもう一つ淡い緑の斑がある。SWIR は暗く雲ではない。この帯域では 2018-06-25 と 2021-09-02 にもほぼ同じ所に緑の斑が出ている。
note_en: Offshore, clear and without glint, there is a small green patch (0.09 km2) 1.3 km north of the centre, with another faint green patch to its east. Dark in SWIR, not cloud. In this zone green patches also appeared at almost the same place on 2018-06-25 and 2021-09-02.

note_ja: 2023-10-27 と同じく、ゾーン南西の隅に明るい青緑の水が入り込み、北東へ淡い筋が伸びて候補の小片がその上に乗る。ゾーン内に起点はなく、南西約 10 km の Kavachi の変色水と見られる。
note_en: As on 2023-10-27, bright blue-green water intrudes into the south-west corner of the zone, with a pale streak extending north-east and the candidate fragments lying on it. There is no starting point in the zone; read as discoloured water from Kavachi, about 10 km to the south-west.

note_ja: 2 回とも北の島の北西岸に沿う幅 200 m ほどの緑の帯 (0.58, 0.59 km2) で、岸から離れない。磯の波と濁りの可能性が高いが、2023-11 にも同じ岸に青緑の帯が出ており、09-30 の熱異常 1 px の位置も図から読めないので、岸の湧水などがないか確認を。
note_en: Both times a green band about 200 m wide (0.58, 0.59 km2) along the north-west shore of the northern island, not leaving the shore. Surf on the rocky shore and turbid water are most likely, but a blue-green band also appeared on the same shore in 2023-11, and the position of the 1 px thermal anomaly on 09-30 cannot be read from the figure, so please check for things such as springs on the shore.

note_ja: ゾーン西半分で雲の帯の下に沿って黄緑の水が帯状に広がり、白い筋とともに浮遊物判定 2.95 km2 (熱異常 2 画素)。雲に接しており薄雲越しの色の乱れの可能性が高いが、黄緑の色は雲では説明しにくく、浮遊物か変色水を否定しきれない。
note_en: In the western half of the zone, yellow-green water spreads as a band along the underside of a band of cloud, and together with white streaks it is judged as floating matter, 2.95 km2 (thermal anomaly 2 pixels). It touches the cloud and colour disturbance through thin cloud is most likely, but the yellow-green colour is hard to explain by cloud, and floating matter or discoloured water cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 01-28 は大きな積雲の東、中心の南 2 km に南北に細長い淡い帯がある。雲縁の霞の可能性が高いが Volcano F の中心近くなので念のため。01-31 はグリント下の薄雲の影、02-10 は雲影の縁。
note_en: On 01-28 there is a faint band elongated north-south 2 km south of the centre, east of a large cumulus. Haze at the cloud edge is likely, but it is near the centre of Volcano F, so flagged just in case. 01-31 is the shadow of thin cloud under glint, and 02-10 the edge of a cloud shadow.

note_ja: カルデラ湾の南東岸沿いに乳白色〜水色の三角形の水。2015-12-23・2022-02-08 もほぼ同じ岸沿いで、冬の雪の隣接効果か結氷の可能性もあるが、同じ位置に繰り返し出るので確かめたい。
note_en: A triangle of milky-white to light-blue water along the south-east shore of the caldera bay. 2015-12-23 and 2022-02-08 are also along almost the same shore; it may be a winter snow adjacency effect or freezing, but it recurs at the same position, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 区域中心の丸い青っぽい斑で、2024年7月の2回と同じ位置。普段の姿と前後の通過にも見え、海山頂の地形による常在の見え方らしいが、浅瀬の印がないので確認したい。
note_en: A round bluish patch at the zone centre, at the same position as the two in July 2024. It is also seen in the normal appearance and on the passes before and after, and seems to be a persistent appearance due to the topography of the seamount summit, but there is no shoal mark, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: ゾーン西端に縁のはっきりした青緑の帯があり、画面全体にも淡い青緑の渦が広がる。ゾーン内に源点はなく、ブルームか周辺から流れてきた水の可能性が高い。
note_en: There is a sharp-edged blue-green band at the western end of the zone, and pale blue-green swirls spread over the whole scene. There is no source point in the zone, and a bloom or water that flowed in from the surroundings is most likely.

note_ja: Ushishir 島の東岸の沖 300 m ほどに南北に細長い淡い帯（0.25 km2）があり、火口湾の北東縁の島の上に白い塊が一つ見える。一面に筋状の雲がかかる回なので白い塊は小さな雲と見られるが、噴気か決めきれない。
note_en: About 300 m off the east coast of Ushishir Island there is a pale band elongated north-south (0.25 km2), and a single white mass is visible on the island at the north-east rim of the crater bay. Streaky cloud covers everything on this pass, so the white mass appears to be a small cloud, but whether it is a fumarolic plume cannot be decided.

note_ja: 雪をかぶった北の島の北西岸に沿う緑の帯と、その沖へ幅 500 m ほど広がる青緑の水 (0.99 km2)。2022-09・10 にも同じ岸に緑の帯が出る。冬の波による岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、同じ岸に繰り返し出るので確認を。前後の通過は雲で見えない。
note_en: A green band along the north-west shore of the snow-capped northern island, and blue-green water spreading about 500 m wide offshore from it (0.99 km2). A green band also appears on the same shore in 2022-09 and 2022-10. Most likely shore turbidity from winter waves, but it recurs on the same shore, so please check. The passes before and after are obscured by cloud.

note_ja: 山頂の南、ゾーン中心から 2 km に北北西〜南南東に伸びる緑〜ターコイズの斑 (6.4 km2) があり、雲は無く (clear 0.98) SWIR では暗い。通常の見え方には浅瀬の色が無く、東端に黄緑がかった部分がある。Fonuafo'ou の上の変色水の可能性がある。
note_en: South of the summit, 2 km from the zone centre, there is a green to turquoise patch (6.4 km2) extending north-north-west to south-south-east; there is no cloud (clear 0.98) and it is dark in SWIR. The usual appearance has no shoal colour, and the eastern end has a yellowish-green part. It may be discoloured water above Fonuafo'ou.

note_ja: 雲から離れた外洋に淡い緑の細長い斑 (0.09 km2) があり、拡大図では南へ淡い尾を引く。隣の East Epi B ゾーンと同じ斑で、火口丘群の上なので確かめたい。
note_en: A faint green, long, thin patch (0.09 km2) on the open sea away from cloud; in the zoomed view it trails a faint tail to the south. The same patch as in the neighbouring East Epi B zone, and it lies over the group of cones, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 画像を確認 (既知の噴火期間)
note_en: 2026-11-14: reviewed from the images (documented eruption period)

note_ja: 画面が暗すぎて海面の色が見えず、判断できない。候補は西の小島の東に南北に細長い茶色の小片 2 つ (0.19 km2) で、形は航跡に近いが確かめられないので念のため。
note_en: The scene is too dark for the colour of the sea surface to be seen, so it cannot be judged. The candidates are two small brown fragments elongated north-south east of the small island to the west (0.19 km2); their shape is close to a ship wake, but as this cannot be confirmed, to be safe.

note_ja: Maug のカルデラ内の中央にやや明るい小斑(0.7 km2)。2022-07-06 にもカルデラ内に斑が出ており、同じ場所に繰り返す。中央の浅い溶岩ドームが透けて見える可能性もある。
note_en: A slightly bright small patch (0.7 km2) in the middle of the Maug caldera. A patch also appeared inside the caldera on 2022-07-06, repeating in the same place. The shallow central lava dome may be showing through.

note_ja: 7月1日・3日の浮遊物候補は南岸の白い砂州の上で礁による。7月18日は北西-南東に走る帯状の雲 (SWIR で褐色がかる) の縁に変色水候補 6.8 km2 と高温画素 24 があり、雲列か火山の噴煙かを確かめたい。7月28日は雲間の小片。
note_en: The floating matter candidates on 1 and 3 July are over the white sand bar on the south shore and are due to the reef. On 18 July there is a 6.8 km2 discoloured water candidate and 24 hot pixels at the edge of a band of cloud running north-west to south-east (brownish in SWIR); I would like to check whether it is a cloud line or a volcanic plume. 28 July is a small fragment between clouds.

note_ja: 雪に覆われたカルデラ湾の南東岸沿いに淡い水色の三角形の斑。2013-12-24・2022-02-08 もほぼ同じ岸沿いで、雪の隣接効果か結氷の可能性もあるが、同じ位置に繰り返し出るので確かめたい。
note_en: A pale light-blue triangular patch along the south-east shore of the snow-covered caldera bay. 2013-12-24 and 2022-02-08 are also along almost the same shore; it may be a snow adjacency effect or freezing, but as it appears repeatedly in the same position I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 雲のない日に、横当島の北の小島の北側に接して淡い青白い斑がある。島の浅瀬か風の陰とも見えるが、島に接しているので確かめたい。東縁の小斑は海面のまだら。
note_en: On a cloud-free day there is a faint bluish-white patch adjoining the north side of the small island north of Yokoate-jima. It could be the island's shoal or a wind shadow, but it touches the island, so I would like to check. The small patch on the east edge is mottling of the sea surface.

note_ja: ゾーン東部を南北に約 3 km 伸びる淡い青緑の細い帯 (0.48 km2)。積雲とその影の列に並んでおり影の間の明るい隙間の可能性が高いが、細長い帯の成因を図から決めきれない。
note_en: A thin, faint blue-green band (0.48 km2) running about 3 km north-south in the east of the zone. It lies along a row of cumulus and their shadows and is likely a bright gap between shadows, but the cause of the long thin band cannot be determined from the figure.

note_ja: ロウ島南東岸の沖に淡い青白の丸い斑がいくつか並ぶ (1.8 km2)。雲もグリントもなく、Tuluman 付近で繰り返し出ている淡い水の一例として確かめたい。
note_en: Several faint bluish-white round patches line up off the south-east shore of Lou Island (1.8 km2). No cloud and no glint; I would like to check it as one example of the faint water that appears repeatedly near Tuluman.

note_ja: 区域中心付近に南北に細長い淡い斑。周りにスリックの暗い筋があり水面の状態の可能性もあるが、2023-07-01 にも中心付近に淡い斑が出ている。
note_en: A pale patch elongated north-south near the zone centre. There are dark slick streaks around it, so it may be a sea-surface state, but a pale patch also appeared near the centre on 2023-07-01.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 11-01以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 11-01. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 北の島の北西岸に沿って緑がかった水の斑（3.6 km2）が岸から沖へ広がる。島の上に白い雲がかかり雲の縁とも接するが、岸に付いた緑の水なので確認したい。
note_en: A patch of greenish water (3.6 km2) spreads offshore along the north-west shore of the northern island. White cloud lies over the island and the patch touches the cloud edge, but it is green water attached to the shore, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: ボゴスロフ島から東へ水色の帯が伸び、湧出点のある色のついた水。前の通過（10-10）にも島の周りに同じ色があり、侵食される島の濁りの可能性が高いが、常時区分の閾値を越えたので確認したい。
note_en: A light-blue band extends east from Bogoslof Island: coloured water with a source point. On the previous pass (10-10) there was also the same colour around the island, and turbid water from the eroding island is likely, but it exceeded the threshold of the "persistent" class, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 09-04 に McDonald 島の東へ青緑〜乳白の水が数 km 伸び、前後の 08-20・08-25 も dw 2.3・1.6 km²。08-15 は雲間全体が淡く霞の可能性があるが島の周りに集中しており、島の浸食による懸濁か変色水かは判別できない。
note_en: On 09-04, blue-green to milky water extends several km east of McDonald Island, and the neighbouring passes 08-20 and 08-25 also have dw 2.3 and 1.6 km². On 08-15 the whole cloud gap is pale and may be haze, but it is concentrated around the island; it cannot be told whether it is suspended sediment from island erosion or discoloured water.

note_ja: 雲のない日にマウグのカルデラ湾の中央に細長い淡い斑がある。2023-03-19 にもほぼ同じ位置（中心から 0.3〜0.4 km）に斑があり、湾内の熱水の可能性がある。
note_en: On a cloud-free day, an elongated pale patch in the middle of the Maug caldera bay. On 2023-03-19 there is also a patch at almost the same position (0.3-0.4 km from the centre); it may be hydrothermal water in the bay.

note_ja: 03-23 は雪の海岸沿いの細片だが、04-09 は湾内西岸寄りの淡い筋、04-14 は湾の北の入り江の斑。雪・雲の隣接効果や薄氷の可能性が高いが、湾内は冬・夏の他のエピソードでも繰り返し拾われ、通常の見え方が無く比較できない。
note_en: 03-23 is a strip along the snowy coast, but 04-09 is a faint streak near the west shore of the bay, and 04-14 is a patch in the inlet at the north of the bay. Adjacency effects from snow or cloud, or thin ice, are likely, but the bay is picked up repeatedly in other winter and summer episodes as well, and there is no usual appearance to compare against.

note_ja: 2022 年にできた小島 (中央の黒い点) のすぐ南東から緑の変色水が東へ帯状に広がり (1.34 km2)、雲から離れていて SWIR では暗い。前の 01-12 にも島の周りに緑の水があり、2022-23 年の活動の続きとみられる。
note_en: Green discoloured water spreads east as a band from just south-east of the small island formed in 2022 (the black dot in the middle) (1.34 km2); away from cloud and dark in SWIR. On the previous 01-12 there was also green water around the island; seen as a continuation of the 2022-23 activity.

note_ja: 氷に覆われた Thule 島と Cook 島の氷崖沿い、および両島の間の海峡に乳青緑の水が 3 回とも出る (02-02 に 14.58 km2)。融氷水や崩れた氷による色の可能性が高いが、海峡はカルデラの位置にあり、同じ場所に繰り返し出るので一度見る。
note_en: Milky blue-green water appears all 3 times along the ice cliffs of ice-covered Thule Island and Cook Island and in the strait between the two islands (14.58 km2 on 02-02). Colour from meltwater or collapsed ice is most likely, but the strait is at the position of the caldera, and as it appears repeatedly in the same place, worth a look once.

note_ja: 南西の島の南東端から東へ乳白色の水が帯状に広がる (5.34 km2)。5 月の雪解けの濁りか薄いもやの可能性が高いが、雲からは離れており、2021-02 の候補とほぼ同じ岸に出ている。
note_en: Milky-white water spreads east in a band from the south-east tip of the south-western island (5.34 km2). Most likely May snowmelt turbidity or thin haze, but it is away from cloud and appears on almost the same shore as the 2021-02 candidate.

note_ja: ゾーン全体の水が乳白色がかった青緑に変わっている (sc)。2022-01-15 の Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai の大噴火の 2 日後で、南東 25 km ほどの Hunga からの降灰か変色水が広がったものと見る。Fonuafo'ou 自身の活動を示すものではないが、既知の噴火として記録を。
note_en: The water over the whole zone has turned milky blue-green (sc). It is two days after the major 2022-01-15 eruption of Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai, and is read as ashfall or discoloured water spreading from Hunga, about 25 km to the south-east. It does not indicate activity of Fonuafo'ou itself, but it should be recorded as a known eruption.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北西端から青緑の細い帯が北北西へのび (01-05)、01-10 は島の西に同色の帯が出る。既知の浅瀬 (cyan) のすぐ外で、新しいテフラ島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島自体が 2013 年の火口なので熱水由来を否定しきれない。
note_en: A thin blue-green band runs north-north-west from the north-west tip of Jadid Island (01-05), and on 01-10 a band of the same colour appears west of the island. Just outside the known shoal (cyan); turbid water from erosion of the new tephra island is likely, but the island itself is the 2013 vent, so a hydrothermal origin cannot be fully ruled out.

note_ja: Panarea 島の南東岸から数百 m 沖に、海岸と平行な細い青緑の帯。2023-11-18 にもほぼ同じ位置・形で出るので浅い海底 (砂地の帯) の可能性が高いが、島の東岸には熱水の湧出があるため確認したい。
note_en: A thin blue-green band parallel to the coast, a few hundred m off the south-east shore of Panarea. It also appears in almost the same position and shape on 2023-11-18, so a shallow sea floor (a sandy band) is likely, but there is hydrothermal discharge on the east shore of the island, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 2回とも Jadid 島の東岸から北東へ青緑の水が広がり、起点は同じ島で既知の浅瀬の輪郭の外。前後の回にも島の周りに青緑の水が見える。若い島の浸食による濁りの可能性もあるが、熱水起源を否定できない。
note_en: Both times, blue-green water spreads north-east from the east shore of Jadid Island; it starts at the same island and lies outside the outline of the known shoal. Blue-green water is also visible around the island on the passes before and after. It may be turbid water from erosion of the young island, but a hydrothermal origin cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 6/7 はグリントなしでパナレア島西岸沖に淡い白っぽい小斑 (0.6 km2)。平常図にも似た濃淡があり浅い海底の可能性が高いが、6/14 はサングリントと雲の影で判断できない。
note_en: 6/7 has no glint and shows a small pale whitish patch (0.6 km2) off the west coast of Panarea. The normal-state image has similar shading and a shallow seabed is most likely, but 6/14 cannot be judged because of sun glint and cloud shadow.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた Deception 島で、Port Foster の内側の岸近くと南東岸の外に淡い小斑が散る (計 2.75 km2)。参照画像がなく、融雪水や薄氷の可能性が高いが、温泉の出る湾なので確かめきれない。
note_en: On snow-covered Deception Island, small pale patches are scattered near the inner shore of Port Foster and outside the south-east shore (2.75 km2 in total). There is no reference image; most likely snowmelt water or thin ice, but it is a bay with hot springs, so it cannot be fully settled.

note_ja: 中央の島の北端から北東へ細いターコイズの筋が流れ、前後の通過にも同じ位置で出る。浅い島棚の濁りが流れに引かれた島の後流の可能性が高いが、繰り返すので念のため。04-05 は画像処理が暗く小さな輪郭が散るだけ。
note_en: A thin turquoise streak flows north-east from the northern tip of the central island, and it also appears in the same position on the earlier and later passes. An island wake, in which turbid water on the shallow island shelf is drawn out by the current, is most likely, but as it repeats, to be safe. 04-05 has dark image processing with only small scattered outlines.

note_ja: 島の周りに青緑の水。夏の氷河の濁りの可能性が高いが、火山性を否定できない。
note_en: Blue-green water around the island. Most likely summer glacial turbidity, but a volcanic origin cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 2/14 と 3/30 に中央の島の北岸から水色の筋が渦を巻いて東へ延びる。島の侵食による濁りの可能性もあるが、同じ島を起点に繰り返す。5/9 は全面の霞、6/1 は積雲で判断不能。
note_en: On 2/14 and 3/30, a light-blue streak swirls and extends east from the north shore of the central island. It may be turbid water from erosion of the island, but it recurs from the same island. 5/9 is haze over the whole scene and 6/1 is cumulus; cannot be judged.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 北東のパッチも東南東の大きなパッチと同じ色で動かないため、浅瀬と考えられる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: The patch in the north-east has the same colour as the large patch in the east-south-east and does not move either, so it is taken for a shoal.

note_ja: 候補 0.3 km2 の大半は南硫黄島の岸の青緑の帯 (島の浅い棚)。ただし火口の南東に淡い緑の水が薄く広がって見え、福徳岡ノ場の弱い変色が続いている可能性がある。前後の 10-02・10-12 に候補は無い。
note_en: Most of the candidate of 0.3 km2 is the blue-green band along the shore of Minami-Ioto (the shallow shelf of the island). However, pale green water appears to spread thinly south-east of the vent, and the weak discolouration of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba may be continuing. The passes before and after, 10-02 and 10-12, have no candidate.

note_ja: 浮遊物候補は北東岸の雪氷(SWIRで青)だが、Port Foster湾内全体が明るいターコイズで湾の岸沿いに変色候補がある。融雪の濁りの可能性が高いが参照画像がなく判断しきれない。
note_en: The floating matter candidate is snow and ice on the north-east shore (blue in SWIR), but the whole of Port Foster is bright turquoise and there are discolouration candidates along the bay's shore. Most likely snowmelt turbidity, but there is no reference image, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: Raoul 島の西 (Denham 湾の沖) に色のほとんどない淡い面が広がる。2013・2016 年にも同じ西側に候補があり、風下の静穏域か浅い沿岸とみられるが、同じ場所に繰り返すため確認したい。
note_en: A faint, almost colourless surface spreads west of Raoul Island (off Denham Bay). There were also candidates on the same west side in 2013 and 2016; seen as calm water in the lee or a shallow coast, but it recurs at the same place, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 06-18: 深い微かだが広い海水変色が、中心からNNE方向にたなびき、サークル外で東に向きを変えている。噴出源は複数あるように見える。 06-21: 明瞭な海水変色があるが面積は小さい。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 06-18: deep, faint but wide discoloured water trails from the centre to the north-north-east and turns east outside the circle. There seem to be several sources. 06-21: clear discoloured water, but of small area.

note_ja: 候補は円の東の積雲の隙間の淡い灰色のまだらな水で、薄雲の可能性が高い。ただし熱異常画素が 99 と多く、雪の島の上か雲の上かをこのシートでは確かめられない。
note_en: The candidate is pale grey mottled water in gaps between cumulus east of the circle, most likely thin cloud. However, there are as many as 99 thermal anomaly pixels, and this sheet cannot show whether they are over the snowy island or over cloud.

note_ja: Curtis 島から北西へ乳白色がかった青緑の水が 1〜2 km 伸び、島を湧出点とする舌状の斑に見える。2024-05-30 にも同じ島のまわりに青緑の水が出ている。
note_en: Milky blue-green water extends 1-2 km north-west from Curtis Island and looks like a tongue-shaped patch with the island as its source point. Blue-green water also appeared around the same island on 2024-05-30.

note_ja: Home Reef の浅瀬の明るい点から濃い緑の変色水が西へ広がり、前 (02-22) と後 (03-14) の通過にも同じ位置から緑の帯が伸びる。2022 年の島形成より前の変色で、細い直線の筋は無関係の航跡か雲の線。
note_en: Dark green discoloured water spreads west from the bright point of the Home Reef shoal, and the passes before (02-22) and after (03-14) also show a green band extending from the same position. Discolouration before the 2022 island formation; the thin straight streak is an unrelated ship wake or cloud line.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた Simushir 島の Broutona 湾内で水が淡い灰緑に濁り (04-14 に 9.71 km2)、西岸沿いにも緑の帯 (04-29)。薄氷や融雪の濁り、壁の影の可能性が高いが、参照画像がなく判断しきれない。
note_en: Inside Broutona Bay on snow-covered Simushir Island the water is turbid pale grey-green (9.71 km2 on 04-14), and there is also a green band along the west shore (04-29). Most likely thin ice, snowmelt turbidity or the shadow of the wall, but there is no reference image, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: グリントなし・雲なしで区域中央から南西へ淡い白っぽい斑が網目状に広がる。前の通過 (2022-12-24) にも中央付近に淡い斑があり、スリックかブルームの可能性が高いが確かめたい。
note_en: No glint and no cloud; a faint whitish patch spreads in a mesh pattern south-west from the middle of the zone. On the previous pass (2022-12-24) there was also a faint patch near the middle; a slick or bloom is likely, but I would like to check.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島の岸から乳白色がかった青緑の帯が下流へ伸び、渦を巻いて数 km 流れる (09-16 から 10-29 まで毎回、前後の通過でも同じ)。2016-17 年のテフラ島の侵食濁りの可能性はあるが、島を起点とする噴流状の変色水として確認したい。
note_en: A milky blue-green band extends downstream from the shore of Bogoslof Island, swirling and flowing for several km (every time from 09-16 to 10-29, and the same on the passes before and after). It could be turbid water from erosion of the 2016-17 tephra island, but I would like it checked as jet-like discoloured water originating at the island.

note_ja: 2019年の噴出源から 0.8 km、雲の無い海に緑の小斑 (0.07 km2) があり、拡大図では南へ淡い緑の尾を引く。小さいが点から流れる形で、前後の回には写らない。
note_en: A small green patch (0.07 km2) on cloud-free sea 0.8 km from the 2019 eruption source; in the zoomed view it trails a faint green tail to the south. Small, but shaped like a flow from a point, and not captured on the passes before and after.

note_ja: Yankicha 島の火口湾の近くの岸に接する青緑の小斑 (10-25 南岸 0.20 km2、11-01 東岸 0.14 km2)。位置は 2 回で違い、沿岸の浅瀬や波打ち際の可能性が高いが、火口湾に熱水活動があるので一応見る。
note_en: Small blue-green patches adjoining the shore near the crater bay of Yankicha Island (10-25: south shore, 0.20 km2; 11-01: east shore, 0.14 km2). The position differs between the two, and a coastal shoal or the surf line is likely, but there is hydrothermal activity in the crater bay, so taking a look anyway.

note_ja: 北の島の南西岸のすぐ沖に淡いターコイズの斑(0.6 km2)。沿岸の浅瀬の色らしいが、参照の島の形と比べて位置を確かめたい。
note_en: A faint turquoise patch (0.6 km2) just off the south-west shore of the northern island. It seems to be the colour of a coastal shoal, but I would like to confirm its position against the shape of the island in the reference.

note_ja: 雲のない静かな日に区域中心の 1.5 km 東に淡い白い斑がいくつかまとまる。海面の粗さのまだらにも見えるが、区域のほかの場所には少ない。
note_en: On a calm, cloud-free day, several pale white patches cluster 1.5 km east of the zone centre. They also look like mottling from sea-surface roughness, but there are few such patches elsewhere in the zone.

note_ja: 2015年の島の岸から水色の帯が毎回伸び、08-21 は西岸から西へ 8.9 km2 の水色の流れ。島の侵食による懸濁の見込みが高いが、平常像 (島の消えた後) と比べられず、島そのものも新陸地として拾われている。
note_en: A light-blue band extends from the shore of the 2015 island every time; on 08-21 it is an 8.9 km2 light-blue flow westward from the west shore. Most likely suspended sediment from erosion of the island, but it cannot be compared with the normal-appearance image (after the island disappeared), and the island itself is also picked up as new land.

note_ja: マウグ島のカルデラ湾の南の出口に小さな候補があり、そこから南へ乳白色の筋が伸びる。04-25 の前の通過でも湾内が乳白色に見え、湾内の熱水による色の可能性がある。
note_en: There is a small candidate at the southern outlet of the Maug caldera bay, from which a milky streak extends south. On the earlier pass of 04-25 too the bay appears milky, and the colour may be due to hydrothermal water in the bay.

note_ja: 当時あった島の南岸と西端に青緑の斑 (01-03 2.82 km2)、01-13 は西端から南西へ舌状に伸びる。前後の通過にも同じ縁取りが見え、浅い台地と侵食の濁りの可能性が高い。参照画像に島が無いため新陸判定が出ている。
note_en: Blue-green patches on the south shore and west end of the island that existed at the time (2.82 km2 on 01-03); on 01-13 a tongue extends south-west from the west end. The same fringe is seen on the passes before and after; most likely the shallow platform and erosion turbidity. The new land detection is triggered because the reference image has no island.

note_ja: Sholan 島の北北西約 1 km の同じ位置に緑の斑 (0.4-0.6 km2) が 02-19・03-04・03-09 に出る。前後の画像でも小さな白点とそのまわりの緑が見え、侵食された島の浅瀬の可能性が高い。03-26 は雲の間の帯。
note_en: A green patch (0.4-0.6 km2) appears in the same position about 1 km north-north-west of Sholan Island on 02-19, 03-04 and 03-09. A small white dot with green around it is also visible in the earlier and later images, and a shoal from an eroded island is most likely. 03-26 is a band between clouds.

note_ja: Curtis 島から東南東へ乳白〜明るい青緑の水が扇状に数 km 広がる（6.4 km²）。雲から離れ SWIR では暗く（水）、島を源とする変色水に見える。島の浸食による懸濁の可能性もあるが規模が大きく、後の 06-25 も dw 0.63。
note_en: Milky to bright blue-green water spreads in a fan for several km east-south-east from Curtis Island (6.4 km²). It is away from cloud and dark in SWIR (water), and looks like discoloured water with the island as its source. It may be suspended matter from erosion of the island, but it is large, and the later 06-25 also has dw 0.63.

note_ja: 雲塊の南に乳白緑の柔らかいもや状の斑があり、褐色の変色と小さな浮遊物の候補が重なる (1 回のみ、前後の画像にはない)。薄雲や雲縁の可能性が高いが、SWIR ではっきり明るくなく判断しきれない。
note_en: South of a cloud mass there is a soft, haze-like milky green patch, overlapping brown discolouration and a small floating-matter candidate (once only, not in the earlier or later images). Thin cloud or a cloud edge is most likely, but it is not clearly bright in SWIR, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: 2019-20 年火口の位置に明るい青緑の三日月形の斑 (0.94 km2) があり、周りに淡い緑の暈が広がる。前の 11-08 と後の 11-18 にも同じ点から西へ緑の尾が伸びる。2019 年の島の跡の浅瀬の濁りか熱水による変色水で、2020 年を通じて続いている現象とみられる。
note_en: A bright blue-green crescent-shaped patch (0.94 km2) at the position of the 2019-20 vent, with a pale green halo spreading around it. On the earlier 11-08 and the later 11-18 too, a green tail extends west from the same point. Shoal turbidity at the remains of the 2019 island or hydrothermal discoloured water; it looks like a phenomenon continuing through 2020.

note_ja: ゾーン中心から 0.4〜1.4 km の一点から緑〜ターコイズの変色水が南東へ帯状に流れ出し、8/4 と 8/19 の 2 回に同じ形で見える。雲から離れ、SWIR では暗い。
note_en: Green to turquoise discoloured water flows out in a band to the south-east from a single point 0.4-1.4 km from the zone centre, visible with the same shape on both 8/4 and 8/19. It is away from cloud and dark in SWIR.

note_ja: 快晴・グリントなしの沖合（中心から 3 km）に極小の緑の点（0.09 km2）がある。上空に薄い巻雲の筋があるが点は雲の外に見える。2019 年 8 月に噴火した Volcano F のカルデラ内。
note_en: A tiny green point (0.09 km2) offshore (3 km from the centre) under clear skies with no glint. There are thin cirrus streaks overhead, but the point appears outside the cloud. It is inside the caldera of Volcano F, which erupted in August 2019.

note_ja: 03-12 と 04-11 は Jadid 島から北へ伸びて北東へ曲がる青緑の舌 (3.10, 6.27 km2)、03-25 は同じ島の北東の緑の斑 (2.69 km2)、04-24 は北の小島群の南の淡い斑 (1.67 km2)。04-11 の輪郭には西の場面端の黒い縁に沿う赤線も入る。島ができて 3 年後の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口で同じ所から繰り返し出るので確認を。
note_en: 03-12 and 04-11 are blue-green tongues extending north from Jadid Island and curving to the north-east (3.10, 6.27 km2), 03-25 is a green patch north-east of the same island (2.69 km2), and 04-24 is a faint patch south of the islets to the north (1.67 km2). The outline on 04-11 also includes red lines along the black border at the scene edge to the west. Turbid water from erosion three years after the island formed is likely, but the island itself is the vent and it comes out repeatedly from the same place, so please check.

note_ja: Home Reef の 2022 年の島の縁から緑の変色水が鉤形に南東へ 2 km ほど伸びる。後の通過 (06-26) にも島から伸びる緑の帯があり、2022-24 年の活動の継続とみられる。
note_en: Green discoloured water extends about 2 km south-east in a hook shape from the edge of the 2022 island of Home Reef. The later pass (06-26) also has a green band extending from the island; read as continuation of the 2022-24 activity.

note_ja: 2021 年火口の位置から北西へ青緑の変色水 3.9 km2 が広がり、南端に明るい水色の点 (湧出点とみられる) がある。同じ画像に、この点付近を中心とする同心円状の波紋が半径約 3 km まで写っている (間隔 150〜200 m、赤・近赤外・短波長赤外のどれにも出るので水の色ではなく海面の波)。前後 7 回の通過には波紋は無い。所有者は同種の波紋を福徳岡ノ場・噴火浅根・アナククラカタウで見ており、活動の無い噴火浅根にも出ることから海底地形の効果とみている。波紋は噴火の証拠としては扱わず、変色水だけを根拠に判定した (db/records/ring_waves.csv に記録)。
note_en: Blue-green discoloured water of 3.9 km2 spreads north-west from the position of the 2021 vent, with a bright light-blue dot at its south end (thought to be the source point). The same image shows concentric ring waves centred near this point out to a radius of about 3 km (spacing 150-200 m; they appear in red, near-infrared and short-wave infrared alike, so they are waves on the sea surface, not water colour). There are no ring waves on the 7 passes before and after. The owner has seen the same kind of ring waves at Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, Funka Asane and Anak Krakatau, and since they also appear at Funka Asane, which is not active, regards them as an effect of sea-floor topography. The ring waves are not treated as evidence of an eruption; the verdict was based on the discoloured water alone (recorded in db/records/ring_waves.csv).

note_ja: 雪に覆われた 2 島の間の海峡、南の島の北岸の近くに 0.10 km2 の小さな青緑の斑。2022 年 8-11 月 (GVP290210-A_20220831) にもこの海峡の同じあたりに斑が繰り返し出ている。浅い海峡の底の可能性が高いが、熱水の出口も否定できない。
note_en: In the strait between the two snow-covered islands, near the north shore of the southern island, a small 0.10 km2 blue-green patch. In August-November 2022 (GVP290210-A_20220831) patches also recurred around the same part of this strait. Most likely the bottom of the shallow strait, but a hydrothermal outlet cannot be ruled out either.

note_ja: 当時あった 2015 年形成の島の南西岸から青緑の帯が南西へ伸びる (03-03 1.32 km2、03-23 2.87 km2、約 3 km)。05-02 は積雲の間の斑、06-16 は南岸の白波。参照画像は 2022 年以降で島が無く、島の侵食による沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口なので否定しきれない。
note_en: A blue-green band extends south-west from the south-west shore of the island formed in 2015 that existed then (03-03 1.32 km2, 03-23 2.87 km2, about 3 km). 05-02 is a patch between cumulus, and 06-16 is whitecaps on the south shore. The reference image is from 2022 onwards when the island no longer exists; coastal turbid water from erosion of the island is most likely, but as the island itself is a vent this cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: ラウル島の北と北東の沖にごく淡い水色の斑 (cyan 分類) があり、北東側は積雲に接する。不明瞭で雲の縁の可能性が高いが、8 月の西岸の変色と同じ島なので念のため。
note_en: Very faint light-blue patches (cyan class) off the north and north-east of Raoul Island, the north-eastern one touching cumulus. Indistinct and most likely a cloud edge, but it is the same island as the August discolouration on the west coast, so just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 03-07以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。面積は小さい。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 03-07. Its area is small.

note_ja: 山頂の南に南北に細い淡緑の筋。前のパス（08-19）は中心付近に弧状の淡緑の渦、後（09-08）にも淡緑の筋があり、通常の見え方にも中央南に淡い緑がある。浅い山頂の海底色か継続的な変色水か判別できない。
note_en: A thin pale green streak running north-south south of the summit. The previous pass (08-19) has an arc-shaped pale green swirl near the centre, the later one (09-08) also has a pale green streak, and the usual appearance also has pale green in the south of the centre. Whether it is the seabed colour of the shallow summit or continuing discoloured water cannot be distinguished.

note_ja: 06-19 と 06-22 に Sholan 島の北、ゾーン中心付近に小さな緑の斑があり、06-22 は島の周りの浅瀬 (水色の輪) にも緑の水が付く。06-29 は東の細い筋。2011-12 年の新島の水中部の浅瀬か浸食の濁りとみられるが、中心の同じ位置に 2 回出るので念のため。
note_en: On 06-19 and 06-22 there is a small green patch north of Sholan Island, near the zone centre, and on 06-22 green water also clings to the shoal around the island (light-blue ring). 06-29 is a thin streak to the east. Seen as the shoal of the submerged part of the 2011-12 new island or turbid water from erosion, but it appears twice at the same position at the centre, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: Garove 島のカルデラ湾 (港) の中から湾口を出て南へ延びる淡い帯。前の通過 (2014-11-19) と2025年10月にも同じ形があり、湾内の凪 (風影) らしいが、火山のカルデラ湾で毎回同じ位置なので確認したい。
note_en: A faint band extending from inside the caldera bay (harbour) of Garove Island out through the bay mouth to the south. The same shape was present on the previous pass (2014-11-19) and in October 2025; it seems to be calm water in the bay (wind shadow), but it is a volcanic caldera bay and the position is the same every time, so I would like to check.

note_ja: ラウル島西岸のデナム湾の岸沿いに青緑の水があり、11-08 の通過でも湾内に青緑の候補が出ている。岸の浅瀬や濁りの可能性もある。
note_en: Blue-green water along the shore of Denham Bay on the west coast of Raoul Island, and a blue-green candidate also appears in the bay on the 11-08 pass. It may also be a shore shoal or turbid water.

note_ja: 2つの島の間の浅い海峡と東岸沖に明るい青緑の水(6km2)が広がり、場面全体に白波が多い荒天。浅瀬の巻き上げで説明できそうだが、熱画素3があり、いつもの見え方では海峡は暗いので確認したい。
note_en: Bright blue-green water (6 km2) spreads in the shallow strait between the two islands and off the east coast, in rough weather with many whitecaps over the whole scene. It can probably be explained by stirring-up of the shoal, but there are 3 hot pixels, and the strait is dark in the usual appearance, so I would like it checked.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 02-20.

note_ja: 島の南の積雲列の間に緑がかった水が広く囲まれた(28 km2)。海全体が緑がかって見え雲の縁にも沿うが、前の通過がなく判断しきれない。
note_en: Greenish water between the rows of cumulus south of the island was outlined over a wide area (28 km2). The whole sea looks greenish and it also follows cloud edges, but there is no previous pass, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: Laika の南西、ふだんの見え方でも淡い緑が出る位置に丸い青緑の斑 (0.29 km2)。浅瀬の底の色の可能性が高いが、cyan の輪郭の外で、Karua の熱水による持続的な変色とも区別できない。
note_en: A round blue-green patch (0.29 km2) south-west of Laika, at a position where pale green also appears in the usual appearance. The colour of the shoal bottom is most likely, but it is outside the cyan outline, and it cannot be distinguished from persistent discolouration by Karua's hydrothermal activity either.

note_ja: 6月25日と8月4日は雲の縁の暗い斑。7月11日は強い輝き下でカルデラ湾全体 (11.5 km2) が白く拾われ、7月8日は湾内東岸に褐色の小斑 (約 1 km2)。参照図がなく湾の平常の色を確かめられない。
note_en: 25 June and 4 August are dark patches at cloud edges. On 11 July, under strong glare, the whole caldera bay (11.5 km2) was picked up as white, and on 8 July there is a small brown patch (about 1 km2) on the east shore inside the bay. There is no reference image, so the normal colour of the bay cannot be checked.

note_ja: 鳥島の南東岸に沿ってターコイズの細い帯(cyan)。磯波や沿岸の濁りとみられるが、活火山の島の海岸なので念のため。
note_en: A thin turquoise band (cyan) along the south-east shore of Torishima. It appears to be surf on the rocky shore or coastal turbid water, but as this is the coast of an active volcanic island, to be safe.

note_ja: 山頂付近の一点から東へ伸びる明るい青緑〜乳白の帯 5.3 km2。短波長赤外では暗く、雲から離れている。前後の 11-20・11-30 にも同じ給源から向きの違う帯が出ている。Kavachi は 2025-11 から 2026-11 まで断続的に変色水を出している (候補が出た回: 2025-11-20〜12-27 の各回、2026-02 に小さく、05-09〜05-29 に約 1 km2、07-05 に 6.8 km2、09-21 以降は 11-10 までほぼ毎回)。頻発区域 (frequent) の継続中の活動。
note_en: A bright blue-green to milky-white band of 5.3 km2 extending east from a point near the summit. It is dark in SWIR and away from cloud. The passes before and after, 11-20 and 11-30, also show bands from the same source in other directions. Kavachi released discoloured water intermittently from 2025-11 to 2026-11 (passes with a candidate: every pass from 2025-11-20 to 12-27, a small one in 2026-02, about 1 km2 from 05-09 to 05-29, 6.8 km2 on 07-05, and almost every pass from 09-21 to 11-10). Ongoing activity of a zone of the frequent class.

note_ja: 区域中心付近の一点から淡いターコイズの筋が北西へ伸び、12-26 と 01-11 の両回で同じ位置に見える (01-27 にも小さな緑の点)。浅瀬の砕波か熱水か、Metis Shoal の当時の記録と照らしたい。
note_en: A pale turquoise streak extends north-west from one point near the zone centre, seen at the same position on both 12-26 and 01-11 (also a small green point on 01-27). Breaking waves on a shoal or hydrothermal water; I would like to compare it with the records of Metis Shoal at the time.

note_ja: 北の島の脇に細い灰色の帯 (ap、0.46 km2) があり、南の大島の脇にも白い候補がある。GVP221020-A_20140604 の 06-20 と同じ通過で、薄雲の筋と思われるが確かめたい。
note_en: There is a thin grey band (ap, 0.46 km2) beside the northern island, and a white candidate beside the large southern island too. Same pass as 06-20 of GVP221020-A_20140604; thought to be streaks of thin cloud, but I would like to check.

note_ja: 3月で陸は雪に覆われ、真色では湾内の水が黒く潰れて候補の色を確かめられない。湾内と南東岸沿いの輪郭は薄い海氷か雪の縁の可能性が高い。
note_en: It is March and the land is covered with snow; in true colour the water in the bay is crushed to black and the colour of the candidate cannot be checked. The outlines in the bay and along the south-east shore are likely thin sea ice or the edge of the snow.

note_ja: 島の西岸に接して淡い青白の斑が 2 回、ほぼ同じ位置にある。島の周りの浅い台地や風下の凪の可能性が高いが、普段の見え方に浅瀬の印はない。
note_en: A pale bluish-white patch touching the west shore of the island, twice, at almost the same position. Most likely the shallow platform around the island or a calm downwind, but the normal appearance has no shoal mark.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 09-11は画質が悪いだけ。09-12ではサークルの南東に青い淡いパッチが見えるが、他の全ての画像でも同じ形で見えるため浅瀬と考えた。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 09-11 is only poor image quality. On 09-12 a pale blue patch is visible in the south-east of the circle, but it has the same shape on all the other images, so it is taken for a shoal.

note_ja: 火口付近 (中心から約0.7-1.2 km) の一点から緑〜乳白色の変色水が広がり、4 回とも同じ位置に出て前後の通過でも見える。6-15 には湧出点に白い筋があり、雲から離れている。
note_en: Green to milky discoloured water spreads from a single point near the vent (about 0.7-1.2 km from the centre), appearing in the same position all 4 times and visible on the earlier and later passes too. On 6-15 there is a white streak at the source point, and it is away from cloud.

note_ja: 区域の中心の南 1.8 km に、南北 4 km・幅 1 km ほどの淡い緑の斑 2.3 km2。雲から離れ、短波長赤外では暗い。同じ位置に 04-11、08-24、10-08、10-13 にも小さな緑の候補 (0.03〜0.14 km2) が出ており、08-24 は頭に白い画素 (砕波とみられる) がある。前後の快晴日 (05-01、05-11) には候補が無い。浅い山頂の海底が見えている可能性が高いが、この日だけ 10 倍以上の広さで明るいので、変色水を否定できない。最浅部は区域の中心ではなくこの位置にあるとみられる。
note_en: A pale green patch of 2.3 km2, about 4 km north-south and 1 km wide, 1.8 km south of the zone centre. It is away from cloud and dark in SWIR. Small green candidates (0.03 to 0.14 km2) appear at the same position on 04-11, 08-24, 10-08 and 10-13 as well, and on 08-24 there are white pixels at its head (probably breaking waves). The clear days before and after (05-01, 05-11) have no candidate. Most likely the seafloor of the shallow summit is showing, but only on this day is it more than ten times larger and bright, so discoloured water cannot be excluded. The shallowest point appears to be at this position, not at the zone centre.

note_ja: 2 回とも北の島の西岸に沿って青緑の水の帯があり、09-26 は岸から沖へ膨らむ斑、10-06 は岸沿いの細い帯。岸の濁りか砕波と見られるが、09-26 に高温画素 14 があり場所を画像から確かめられない。
note_en: Both times there is a band of blue-green water along the west shore of the northern island: on 09-26 a patch bulging offshore from the shore, on 10-06 a thin band along the shore. Looks like turbid water at the shore or breaking waves, but 09-26 has 14 hot pixels and their location cannot be confirmed from the image.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: Maugカルデラ内の中央〜西側の水が明るい乳青色で候補になっている(中心から0.2 km)。周りに雲と靄があり(glint caution)靄の可能性が高いが、熱水のあるカルデラの中なので確認を推す。
note_en: The water from the middle to the west side of the Maug caldera is a bright milky blue and is a candidate (0.2 km from the centre). There are cloud and haze around it (glint caution) and haze is most likely, but as it is inside a caldera with hydrothermal activity I recommend checking.

note_ja: 雲もグリントもない日に、カーティス島の北東岸に接して淡い青緑の斑がいくつかある。島を源とする変色水の可能性があり、2014-04-25 の島を通る緑がかった帯と合わせて見たい。
note_en: On a day with no cloud and no glint, there are several faint blue-green patches adjoining the north-east shore of Curtis Island. Possibly discoloured water with the island as its source; I would like to look at it together with the greenish band running through the island on 2014-04-25.

note_ja: Maug のカルデラ内から西の水面が周りより暗い青で候補になっている。この束の 2014-05 と 2023-04 にも同じ場所が出ており、風の当たらない湾内のグリント差とみられるが一度まとめて確かめたい。
note_en: The water surface from inside the Maug caldera westward is darker blue than its surroundings and has become a candidate. The same place also appears in 2014-05 and 2023-04 in this batch; it looks like a glint difference in the sheltered bay, but I would like to check them together once.

note_ja: 06-04に島の北と東に黄褐色の筋状の浮遊物候補(SWIRでは明るくなく、藻類か煙の可能性)。06-14は島の南西岸に沿う淡いターコイズの帯で浅瀬の濁りらしい。浮遊物の正体が画像だけでは決めきれない。
note_en: On 06-04, yellow-brown streaky floating matter candidates north and east of the island (not bright in SWIR; possibly algae or smoke). 06-14 is a faint turquoise band along the south-west shore of the island, seemingly turbid water on the shoal. The identity of the floating matter cannot be determined from the image alone.

note_ja: Banua Wuhu の島の東側に接して、島の青緑の浅瀬の外へ約 1 km の淡い灰青の斑が伸びている。色は弱く風下の静穏域の可能性があるが、島を起点にしているため確認したい。
note_en: Touching the east side of the Banua Wuhu island, a pale grey-blue patch extends about 1 km beyond the island's blue-green shoal. The colour is weak and it may be a calm area downwind, but it starts from the island, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 真色のパネルで海面が黒く潰れ、候補の色と形を確かめられない。輪郭は南東の雪の積もった海岸と北東の雲に沿って広がっており、海岸近くの水か雲の縁の可能性が高い。
note_en: In the true colour panel the sea surface is crushed to black, so the colour and shape of the candidate cannot be checked. The outline spreads along the snow-covered coast to the south-east and the cloud to the north-east, so it is most likely near-shore water or a cloud edge.

note_ja: Home Reef の島から北西へ伸びる緑の変色水の帯 (3.3 km2)。島に湧出点があり雲から離れている。常時変色する区域なので、継続中の活動の可能性が高い。
note_en: A band of green discoloured water extending north-west from the Home Reef island (3.3 km2). There is a source point on the island and it is away from cloud. The zone is discoloured all the time, so most likely ongoing activity.

note_ja: 雪の残るカルデラ湾の湾口付近に暗い青の細長い斑。雲のもやや凪のむらの可能性が高いが、はっきりしない。
note_en: A dark blue elongated patch near the mouth of the caldera bay, with lingering snow. Cloud haze or unevenness in calm water is likely, but it is not clear.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた島に囲まれたカルデラ湾の中に淡い青の斑 (1.21 km2) があり、SWIR では暗い。冬の湾内の薄氷か濁りの可能性が高いが、周りは雲で前後の通過も湾内が見えず、判断材料が少ない。
note_en: A pale blue patch (1.21 km2) inside the caldera bay surrounded by snow-covered islands, dark in SWIR. Most likely thin ice or turbid water in the bay in winter, but the surroundings are cloudy and the bay is not visible on the earlier and later passes either, so there is little to judge by.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 08-04, 08-20 and 08-21, all three.

note_ja: この通過は表示が島と雲を除いてほぼ真っ黒で、水の色が読めない。候補は島の東に接する輪の形 (1.04 km2)。後の 06-26 は晴れて変色は見えない。表示の伸張の失敗の可能性が高いが、噴気のある島の脇なので元の画像で確認を。
note_en: The display of this pass is almost completely black except for the island and clouds, and the water colour cannot be read. The candidate is a ring shape adjoining the east of the island (1.04 km2). On the later 06-26 it is clear and no discolouration is visible. A failure of the display stretch is likely, but it is beside an island with fumaroles, so please check in the original image.

note_ja: 7月12日は快晴(clear 1.00)で、中心の北北西約1.5 kmに青緑の斑(0.46 km2)があり、南へ淡い緑の暈が広がる。雲から離れている。7月14日も薄霞の下で同じ付近に小さな緑の斑が2つ出ており、2021年の同じ領域の斑とも位置が近い。
note_en: 12 July is clear (clear 1.00), with a blue-green patch (0.46 km2) about 1.5 km north-north-west of the centre and a pale green halo spreading to the south. It is away from cloud. On 14 July too, two small green patches appear around the same area under thin haze, and they are also close in position to the 2021 patches in the same area.

note_ja: 太陽光反射の中で島の風下に暗い風の影と淡い面ができ、候補は島の南西の淡い面。色はなく島から伸びる変色水でもない。
note_en: In sun glint, a dark wind shadow and a pale surface form in the lee of the island; the candidate is the pale surface south-west of the island. It has no colour and is not discoloured water extending from the island.

note_ja: 真色の画像は暗く処理され、候補は南を覆う層積雲の北縁の手前の暗い水に散る細い輪郭 (0.53 km2) と浮遊物の点 1 つで、色は見えない。雲の縁の誤検出の可能性が高いが、熱画素が 824 と多く、図からは位置を確かめられない。
note_en: The true-colour image is processed dark, and the candidates are thin outlines scattered in the dark water just short of the northern edge of the stratocumulus covering the south (0.53 km2) and one floating-matter point; the colour cannot be seen. A false detection at the cloud edge is most likely, but there are many hot pixels (824) and their position cannot be checked from the figure.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島の岸から青緑の変色水が数 km の帯になって流れ出し、10/5〜11/24 の各回と前後の回に繰り返し見える。2016-17 年噴火でできたテフラの島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、熱水による変色水を否定できない。
note_en: Blue-green discoloured water flows out in a band several km long from the shore of Bogoslof Island, seen repeatedly on each pass from 10/5 to 11/24 and on the passes before and after. Turbid water from erosion of the tephra island formed in the 2016-17 eruption is most likely, but hydrothermal discoloured water cannot be ruled out.
2026-11-14: 2021-08-04 to 08-24: cannot be confirmed by eye except on 08-17.

note_ja: Landsatの場面で、ゾーン全体に黄緑の細い筋が網目状に走り、SWIRでも明るい線として見える(浮遊物の可能性)。6月10日の通過にも黄緑の筋がある。ブルームの浮遊群体か薄い雲の筋かもしれないが、2022年のフンガ・トンガ噴火後の軽石の可能性もあるので確認したい。
note_en: A Landsat scene; thin yellow-green streaks run in a network across the whole zone and also appear as bright lines in SWIR (possibly floating matter). The 10 June pass also has yellow-green streaks. They may be floating colonies of a bloom or thin cloud streaks, but they may also be pumice from the 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption, so I would like them checked.

note_ja: この通過は真の色でも SWIR でも海面が黒く写り、南東の小さな雲片の周りの不規則な候補 5.98 km2 に色の違いが見えない。雲の周りの薄い霞の可能性が高いが、表示が暗く判断できない。後の 08-15 に変色はない。
note_en: On this pass the sea surface appears black in both true colour and SWIR, and no colour difference is visible in the irregular 5.98 km2 candidate around a small cloud fragment to the south-east. Most likely thin haze around the cloud, but the display is dark and it cannot be judged. No discolouration on the later 08-15.

note_ja: 円の南東、積雲の列の東に淡い水色の小さな塊があり、その南に淡い斑が続く。SWIR では目立たず雲かどうか決めきれない。カルデラ内の 2001 年の変色水域に近い可能性がある。
note_en: In the south-east of the circle, east of a row of cumulus, there is a small pale light-blue mass, with pale patches continuing to its south. It is inconspicuous in SWIR and whether it is cloud cannot be decided. It may be close to the 2001 discoloured-water area inside the caldera.

note_ja: 場面全体に霞と色の滲みのある薄雲の筋がかかり、候補は円の中央南の 0.23 km2 の小さな青緑の斑。薄雲の下の模様の可能性が高いが、通常の見え方でも同じ所がかすかに緑がかって見え、山頂の浅所と重なるので確かめたい。
note_en: Haze and streaks of thin cloud with colour bleeding cover the whole scene; the candidate is a small blue-green patch of 0.23 km2 south of the middle of the circle. A pattern under thin cloud is likely, but in the usual appearance too the same place looks faintly greenish and it overlaps the shallow part of the summit, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 区域中心の南に淡い斑点の集まり（6.8 km2）が 1 回。暗い海面の画素雑音らしく SWIR に何もないが、中心付近に集まっているため念のため。
note_en: A cluster of pale speckles (6.8 km2) south of the zone centre, once. It seems to be pixel noise on a dark sea and there is nothing in SWIR, but it is clustered near the centre, so just in case.

note_ja: パナレア島の南東岸から南へ淡い白っぽい水 (2.0 km2)、区域中心から 0.4 km。グリント注意の通過で風の影の可能性があるが、ガス噴出のある区域なので確かめたい。
note_en: Pale whitish water to the south from the south-east shore of Panarea (2.0 km2), 0.4 km from the zone centre. It is a glint-caution pass and may be a wind shadow, but the zone has gas emissions, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 円の中心の明るい青緑の斑 (0.87 km2) に白く砕ける波の点があり、2019 年の島の跡の浅瀬と見られる。後の 08-25 にはこの点から北東へ楔形の青緑の尾と広い淡い暈が写る。浅瀬の濁りの可能性もあるが、同じ点から変色水が出ているので確認を。
note_en: The bright blue-green patch at the centre of the circle (0.87 km2) has points of white breaking waves and is seen as the shoal left by the 2019 island. On the later 08-25 a wedge-shaped blue-green tail extending north-east from this point and a wide faint halo are captured. It could be turbid water on the shoal, but discoloured water is coming out from the same point, so please check.

note_ja: 山頂付近に鮮やかな緑〜黄緑の変色水が広がり、中に環状の縁（火口状）があって西と南西へ尾を引く。雲は無くSWIRで暗い。Kavachiの噴出活動による変色水とみられる（frequent のゾーン、継続中の活動として扱う）。
note_en: Vivid green to yellow-green discoloured water spreads near the summit, with a ring-shaped rim (vent-like) inside, trailing to the west and south-west. No cloud, dark in SWIR. Seen as discoloured water from the eruptive activity of Kavachi (a frequent zone; treated as ongoing activity).

note_ja: 3 回とも中央の島と北の島の間、円の中心付近の同じ所に淡い緑の斑 (0.84, 0.18, 0.46 km2) があり、その中か脇に白く光る小さな点が毎回写る。浅い岩に砕ける波とその周りの濁りの可能性が高いが、2011-12 年の火口の近くで同じ所に繰り返し出るので確認を。
note_en: All 3 times there is a pale green patch (0.84, 0.18, 0.46 km2) in the same place between the central island and the northern island, near the centre of the circle, and a small shining white dot appears in it or beside it every time. Waves breaking on a shallow rock and the turbid water around it are most likely, but as it is near the 2011-12 vent and appears repeatedly in the same place, please check.

note_ja: 雲の無い通過で、カーティス島とチーズマン島のすぐ北に淡い小斑が数個ある。島に接しており岸の波や影の可能性が高いが、噴気のある島なので念のため。
note_en: On a cloud-free pass there are several small pale patches just north of Curtis Island and Cheeseman Island. They touch the islands and are most likely waves on the shore or shadows, but as these are islands with fumaroles, to be safe.

note_ja: 画面全体の海が乳白色のターコイズに変わり (sc)、島の西の雲の脇に網目状の候補が広がる。点源は無く、南約 90 km の Ruang 火山の 2024-04-30 の噴火の降灰で海が濁った可能性が高いが、Banua Wuhu 自身の活動は否定できないので念のため。
note_en: The sea across the whole scene has turned milky turquoise (sc), and mesh-like candidates spread beside cloud west of the island. There is no point source; the sea was likely made turbid by ashfall from the 2024-04-30 eruption of Ruang volcano, about 90 km to the south, but activity of Banua Wuhu itself cannot be ruled out, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 2015 年にできた Hunga の新島 (通常の見え方は 2022 年以降で島が無い) の周りに青緑の縁取りが毎回あり、12-09 は島の東 1 km に乳青色の斑が離れて浮く。新島の浸食による濁りと浅い台地とみられるが、島を源に同じ位置で繰り返すので念のため。
note_en: There is a blue-green fringe every time around the new Hunga island formed in 2015 (the usual appearance is from 2022 onwards, with no island), and on 12-09 a milky blue patch floats separately 1 km east of the island. Seen as turbid water from erosion of the new island and a shallow platform, but it recurs at the same position with the island as its source, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: カルデラ湾の東寄りに細い淡い筋 (湾内の滑らかな筋と見られる) がある。前後の通過 (2019-10-22、2020-01-19) も湾内で L3 なので、湾内に繰り返し出る候補として一度見たい。
note_en: A thin pale streak in the eastern part of the caldera bay (it looks like a smooth streak in the bay). The passes before and after (2019-10-22, 2020-01-19) are also L3 in the bay, so I would like to look at it once as a candidate that recurs in the bay.

note_ja: 中心から 1-2 km の位置に小さな緑の斑(0.14-0.18 km2)が 3 回の警報通過と 12月15日の通過に出て、南へ淡く尾を引く。SWIRでは暗く雲から離れ、通常の見え方には無いので浅所ではない。
note_en: A small green patch (0.14-0.18 km2) 1-2 km from the centre appears on 3 alert passes and on the 15 December pass, trailing faintly to the south. It is dark in SWIR, away from cloud, and not in the usual appearance, so it is not a shallow area.

note_ja: 厚い雲の間で、Port Foster の南東部と湾口の外に青緑の水（3.9 km²）。融氷水の懸濁か海氷・雪泥の可能性が高いが、通常の見え方が無く比較できない。
note_en: Between thick clouds, blue-green water (3.9 km²) in the south-eastern part of Port Foster and outside the bay mouth. Suspended matter in meltwater or sea ice and slush is most likely, but there is no usual-appearance image to compare with.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water is seen on 05-21 as well.

note_ja: 08-04・08-21 は位置の違う色のない淡い斑（霞・スリック）だが、09-05 と 09-14 はパナレア島の南〜南東の同じ所に淡い水が出ており、2016-02-05 にも島の南東岸に同様の斑がある。風下の静穏域の可能性が高いが、同じ場所に繰り返すため確認したい。
note_en: 08-04 and 08-21 are colourless pale patches at different positions (haze, slicks), but on 09-05 and 09-14 pale water appears at the same place south to south-east of Panarea, and 2016-02-05 also has a similar patch on the island's south-east shore. Most likely a calm area downwind, but it recurs at the same place, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 画像を確認 (火山性ではない)
note_en: 2026-11-14: reviewed from the images (not volcanic)

note_ja: カルデラ湾の南岸の浅い縁の外に緑がかった斑。2015-04-02 にもほぼ同じ南岸の場所が囲まれており、岸の浅い棚の可能性が高いが繰り返すので確認したい。
note_en: A greenish patch outside the shallow margin of the south shore of the caldera bay. Almost the same place on the south shore was also outlined on 2015-04-02; a shallow shelf along the shore is most likely, but as it repeats I would like it checked.

note_ja: 火口の小さな白い岩点から乳青緑の変色水が弧状・渦状に流れ出し、08-11・08-21・09-05 の 3 回とも同じ点が起点。2019-10 の噴火 (新島形成) の約 2 か月前に当たる。
note_en: Milky blue-green discoloured water flows out in arcs and swirls from a small white rock point at the vent, starting from the same point all 3 times (08-11, 08-21, 09-05). This is about 2 months before the 2019-10 eruption (new island formation).

note_ja: Jadid 島と西の小島の間から青緑の濁りが渦を巻いて北東へ広がり、既知の浅瀬 (cyan) の外まで 2.72 km2 に及ぶ。2013 年噴火から 2 年で、島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、火口そのものを起点とする変色水と区別できない。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water swirls out from between Jadid Island and the small island to its west and spreads north-east, reaching 2.72 km2 beyond the known shoal (cyan). Two years after the 2013 eruption, turbid water from erosion of the island is likely, but it cannot be distinguished from discoloured water originating at the vent itself.

note_ja: 円の南から北東へ白い点を伴う水色の細い筋が延び、南端の円の外に SWIR でも明るい白い扇形がある。船とその航跡の見込みが高いが、前の通過 (12/31) にも同じ辺りに同様の筋があるので念のため。
note_en: A thin light-blue streak with a white point extends from the south of the circle to the north-east, and outside the circle at the south end there is a white fan shape that is bright in SWIR too. Most likely a ship and its wake, but the previous pass (12/31) also has a similar streak around the same area, so just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-19には海水変色があるがサークル外か北東からたなびいているので無関係。08-08,11には明らかにサークル内北西に明るい点が生じ、変色水がたなびいている。他の画像には異常は見られない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: On 07-19 there is discoloured water, but it is outside the circle or trails from the north-east, so it is unrelated. On 08-08 and 08-11 a bright point has clearly appeared in the north-west inside the circle, with discoloured water trailing from it. The other images show nothing unusual.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 12-13: 微かに変色水を視認できる。 12-15: 変色水を明確に視認できる。 12-22: 微かに変色水を視認できる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 12-13: discoloured water faintly visible. 12-15: discoloured water clearly visible. 12-22: discoloured water faintly visible.

note_ja: 島の西岸に接して淡い青白の斑。2021-05 の 2 回もほぼ同じ位置に同じ斑があり、島の風下の凪の可能性はあるが、年をまたいで同じ場所に出ている。
note_en: A faint bluish-white patch adjoining the west shore of the island. The two passes in 2021-05 also have the same patch at almost the same position; it could be calm water in the lee of the island, but it appears at the same place across years.

note_ja: 2015 年にできた島の南 4 km ほど、積雲と影の散る中に U 字形の鮮やかな青緑の斑 (3.10 km2) がある。SWIR では暗く雲ではない。後の 12-05 には島の周りに青緑の水が出る。島の侵食の濁りが流れた可能性もあるが、カルデラの上の離れた所の変色なので確認を。
note_en: About 4 km south of the island formed in 2015, amid scattered cumulus and shadows, there is a U-shaped vivid blue-green patch (3.10 km2). Dark in SWIR, so not cloud. On the later 12-05 blue-green water appears around the island. Turbid water from erosion of the island may have drifted there, but it is discolouration at a separate place above the caldera, so please check.

note_ja: 雲と霞の多い場面で、白い候補は筋状の雲の間の淡い斑。雲の縁の色ずれで説明できそうだが熱画素が147と多いので、熱画素の位置だけ確かめたい。
note_en: A scene with much cloud and haze; the white candidate is a pale patch between streaky clouds. It can probably be explained by colour misregistration at cloud edges, but there are many hot pixels (147), so I would like just the position of the hot pixels checked.

note_ja: 2回とも積雲の隙間に淡い白い斑があり、雲の縁の霞で説明できそうだが、ゾーン中心の南の近い位置(1-2km違い)に出ているので念のため確認。色や起点はない。
note_en: Both times there is a faint white patch in a gap between cumulus; it can probably be explained by haze at the cloud edge, but it appears at close positions south of the zone centre (1-2 km apart), so checking just in case. No colour or origin.

note_ja: 北西の沖の極小の淡い斑（0.06 km2）で、上空に薄い霞と小さな積雲がありその名残の可能性が高い。ただし hot px 19 の理由が画像からは分からない。
note_en: A tiny faint patch offshore to the north-west (0.06 km2); thin haze and small cumulus lie above it, and a remnant of these is likely. However, the reason for hot px 19 cannot be seen from the image.

note_ja: 雲もグリントもない日に区域中心の 1.3 km 横に淡い白い斑が一つある。まだら状で海面の粗さの違いにも見えるが、ほかに説明がつかない。
note_en: On a day with no cloud and no glint, there is a single faint white patch 1.3 km to the side of the zone centre. It is mottled and also looks like a difference in sea-surface roughness, but nothing else explains it.

note_ja: 新しい陸地 (nl) の理由だが、真色にも SWIR にも明るい塊は見えず、中心の淡い緑の斑は通常の見え方と同じ持続的な変色水。箱の東に小さな黒い点が 2 つあり何を拾ったか判別できないので念のため。
note_en: The reason is new land (nl), but no bright mass is visible in either true colour or SWIR, and the pale green patch at the centre is the same persistent discoloured water as in the usual appearance. There are two small black dots east of the box and what was picked up cannot be distinguished, so to be safe.

note_ja: 鳥島の南岸に接するターコイズの小斑（0.33 km2）で、すぐ西に積雲がある。海岸の濁りや波打ち際の可能性が高いが、活火山の島に接し色もはっきりしている。
note_en: A small turquoise patch (0.33 km2) touching the south shore of Torishima, with cumulus just to the west. Most likely shore turbidity or the surf line, but it touches an active volcanic island and the colour is distinct.

note_ja: Lateiki の浅瀬 (SWIR では暗く水面下) の明るい青緑の点から長さ 2-3 km の青緑の尾が下流へ伸び、09-13・09-23・09-28 と前後の通過でも毎回同じ点から出る。2019-20 年噴火の跡の浅瀬の侵食か熱水か、点源の変色水として確認したい。
note_en: A blue-green tail 2-3 km long extends downstream from a bright blue-green point on the Lateiki shoal (dark in SWIR, below the water surface), and on 09-13, 09-23, 09-28 and the passes before and after it comes out of the same point every time. Whether it is erosion of the shoal left by the 2019-20 eruption or hydrothermal, I would like it checked as point-source discoloured water.

note_ja: 03-20 に島の北端から北へ青緑の細い帯 (1.64 km2)、03-13 は北西の浅瀬周辺の小斑 (glint caution)。05-06 の 3.92 km2 は glint severe の積雲域の縁、05-09 は暗い画面の小さな暗斑。沿岸の濁りの可能性が高い。
note_en: On 03-20 a thin blue-green band (1.64 km2) extends north from the northern tip of the island; 03-13 is small patches around the shoal to the north-west (glint caution). The 3.92 km2 on 05-06 is the edge of a cumulus area under glint severe, and 05-09 is a small dark patch in a dark scene. Coastal turbid water is most likely.

note_ja: Zubair の島々の周りから南東へ広く青緑の変色水が広がる。2013-09〜の Jadid 島の噴火の時期に当たる。
note_en: Blue-green discoloured water spreads widely to the south-east from around the Zubair islands. This falls in the period of the Jadid Island eruption from 2013-09.

note_ja: 晴れた海面で、中心から 1.4 km に緑の小斑が 2 つ並び (0.25 km2)、その南へ淡い緑が尾を引く。雲から離れている。2016 年・2018 年に East Epi B の火口付近に出た緑の斑と似る。
note_en: On a clear sea, two small green patches side by side 1.4 km from the centre (0.25 km2), with pale green trailing a tail to the south. It is away from cloud. Similar to the green patches near the East Epi B vent in 2016 and 2018.

note_ja: ラウル島の北西端から西へ弧を描いて伸びる水色の水 (2.4 km2)。岸の浅瀬に接しており、浅瀬の水や堆積物の可能性もあるが、湧出点のある色の付いた帯。
note_en: Light-blue water (2.4 km2) extending in an arc west from the north-west tip of Raoul Island. It touches the shoal at the shore and could be shoal water or sediment, but it is a coloured band with a source point.

note_ja: 4/30は北の雲の縁、5/31は南岸の雲影と光沢の白い帯で説明できる。5/15はカルデラ湾の内側に褐色の斑と浮遊物候補があり、融氷や堆積物の可能性が高いが確信はない。
note_en: 4/30 can be explained by the edge of the cloud to the north, and 5/31 by a cloud shadow on the south shore and a glossy white band. 5/15 has a brown patch and a floating-matter candidate on the inner side of the caldera bay; melting ice or sediment is most likely, but this is not certain.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 09-16の中央西側は青緑色のぼんやりとした海水変色がみえる。09-13のサークル外南西側にも似たような海水変色が見える。
note_en: 2026-11-14: On 09-16 hazy blue-green discoloured water is visible west of the centre. On 09-13 similar discoloured water is visible outside the circle to the south-west.

note_ja: 火口湾のある南の島の北岸、北東の島との間の海峡に緑の斑 (0.22 km2)。2022 年 9-11 月の 3 回と同じ位置で、年をまたいで繰り返す。浅い海峡の底の可能性があるが、熱水の出口の可能性も消せない。
note_en: A green patch (0.22 km2) on the north shore of the southern island with the crater bay, in the strait between it and the north-eastern island. Same position as the three in September-November 2022, recurring across years. It could be the bottom of the shallow strait, but a hydrothermal outlet cannot be ruled out either.

note_ja: 09-15と10-05にBogoslof島の周りから南東・東へ渦を巻いて伸びる乳白色〜ターコイズの水。島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島自体が火口なので区別できない。
note_en: On 09-15 and 10-05, milky to turquoise water swirls and extends south-east and east from around Bogoslof Island. Turbid water from erosion of the island is most likely, but as the island itself is a vent, it cannot be distinguished.

note_ja: 中心の北北東約1.6-1.9 kmに小さな緑の斑(0.1-0.16 km2)が4回、ほぼ同じ位置に出る。多くは小さな積雲の脇だが、8月3日は雲から離れて淡い緑の暈を伴い、6月24日は南東へ淡い筋を引く。
note_en: A small green patch (0.1-0.16 km2) appears 4 times in almost the same position about 1.6-1.9 km north-north-east of the centre. Mostly beside small cumulus, but on 3 August it is away from cloud with a pale green halo, and on 24 June it trails a pale streak to the south-east.

note_ja: 中心の南約 3 km、筋状の薄い巻雲がかかる範囲に淡い青緑の水が広がり、その中に小さな候補が散る。山頂の浅瀬が霞を通して見えている可能性が高いが、通常の見え方には浅瀬の輪郭がない。
note_en: About 3 km south of the centre, in an area under streaky thin cirrus, pale blue-green water spreads, with small candidates scattered in it. Most likely the summit shoal seen through haze, but the normal appearance has no shoal outline.

note_ja: 雲の無い晴れた海で、中心の東約 1.5 km に小さなターコイズの斑 (0.15 km2) があり、西へ淡い尾を引く。雲や画像の継ぎ目 (西の斜めの線) から離れていて、1 回だけだが源のある色の斑に見える。後の通過 (04-16) は雲で見えない。
note_en: On a clear, cloud-free sea, a small turquoise patch (0.15 km2) about 1.5 km east of the centre, trailing a faint tail to the west. Away from cloud and from the image seam (the diagonal line to the west); only once, but it looks like a coloured patch with a source. The later pass (04-16) is obscured by cloud.

note_ja: Sholan 島まわりの棚に緑の斑が繰り返し出る (08-02 島の南東、05-14 島の北西に細い緑の筋、警報 62 回)。侵食の進むテフラ島の浅瀬・濁りの可能性が高いが、08-24 の島東方の暗い青の斑 (0.95 km2) は説明しきれない。
note_en: Green patches appear repeatedly on the shelf around Sholan Island (08-02 south-east of the island, 05-14 a thin green streak north-west of the island; 62 alerts). A shoal or turbid water around the eroding tephra island is most likely, but the dark blue patch east of the island on 08-24 (0.95 km2) cannot be fully explained.

note_ja: マウグ諸島の西の島の縁に沿って濃い青の帯（0.7 km2）がある。前の通過（06-04）にもカルデラ内に濃い青が写り、深い水か影らしいが確かではない。
note_en: A dark blue band (0.7 km2) along the edge of the western island of the Maug Islands. On the previous pass (06-04) dark blue was also captured inside the caldera; it seems to be deep water or shadow, but this is not certain.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北端から北東へ数 km 伸びる青緑の細い筋が 03-14・03-16 と前後のパスに同じ位置で続く。若い火砕丘の浸食による濁りの尾の可能性が高いが、島からの熱水の流れも否定できない。04-05 と 05-28 の候補は北の小島の浅瀬と島周りの浅い台地。
note_en: A thin blue-green streak extending several km north-east from the north tip of Jadid Island continues in the same position on 03-14 and 03-16 and on the passes before and after. A tail of turbid water from erosion of the young pyroclastic cone is likely, but a hydrothermal flow from the island cannot be ruled out. The 04-05 and 05-28 candidates are the shoal of the small northern island and the shallow platform around the island.

note_ja: 候補は波立った面と静穏な面の境界。ただし中心付近の青みがかった斑が前の通過(2016-03-06)とこの通過にも見え、気になる。
note_en: The candidate is the boundary between a rough surface and a calm surface. However, a bluish patch near the centre is visible on the previous pass (2016-03-06) and on this pass, which is a concern.

note_ja: Yankicha 島と Ryponkicha 島の間の浅い海峡（Yankicha 北岸）に淡緑の小斑が 09-11・10-09・10-11・10-16 の 4 回ほぼ同じ位置に出る（03-23 の組も同じ位置）。浅瀬の底や潮流の濁りかもしれないが、繰り返すので確認したい。
note_en: In the shallow strait between Yankicha and Ryponkicha islands (north shore of Yankicha), a small pale green patch appears in almost the same position 4 times, on 09-11, 10-09, 10-11 and 10-16 (the 03-23 set is also in the same position).
