It may be the shoal bottom or turbid water from tidal currents, but as it repeats I would like it checked.

note_ja: Garove 島のカルデラ湾の中から湾口を出て南へ広がる淡い水。2015年2月・2014年11月と普段の姿にも同じ形があり、サングリント注意下の湾内の凪 (風影) らしいが、火山のカルデラ湾で毎回同じ位置なので確認したい。
note_en: Pale water spreading from inside Garove Island's caldera bay out through the bay mouth to the south. The same shape is present in February 2015, November 2014 and the usual appearance; it looks like calm water in the bay (wind shadow) under a sun glint caution, but as it is in the same position every time in a volcanic caldera bay I would like it checked.

note_ja: 中央の島の北端から北東へ伸びる青緑の斑が 03-01・04-05・04-20 に同じ位置に出る (0.9-1.7 km2)、既知浅瀬の輪郭の外側。浅瀬の延長や沿岸の濁りの可能性もあるが、形が通過ごとに変わる。03-14 の 8.01 km2 は雲の縞。
note_en: A blue-green patch extending north-east from the north tip of the central island appears in the same position on 03-01, 04-05 and 04-20 (0.9-1.7 km2), outside the outline of the known shoal. It could be an extension of the shoal or coastal turbid water, but its shape changes from pass to pass. The 8.01 km2 on 03-14 is cloud stripes.

note_ja: 雲のない日に、バヌア・ウフの小島の北東岸から細い淡い帯が北東へ伸びる。風下のスリックとも見えるが、島を起点としているので確かめたい。
note_en: On a cloud-free day, a thin faint band extends north-east from the north-east shore of the Banua Wuhu islet. It could be a slick in the lee, but it starts from the island, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 活動イベントと判断
note_en: 2026-11-14: judged to be activity events

note_ja: 山頂の浅瀬の近く(中心から 0.75 km)に南北に細長い淡い斑があり、細かい白点を含む。砕波か波立ちの可能性が高いが、変色水が繰り返す浅瀬なので確認したい。
note_en: Near the summit shoal (0.75 km from the centre) there is a pale patch elongated north-south containing fine white dots. Breaking waves or choppy water are most likely, but as this is a shoal where discoloured water recurs I would like it checked.

note_ja: 円を北西から南東へ横切る細いターコイズの筋が数本あり、南東の円の外で広がる。短波赤外では見えず浮遊物ではなく、源の点も見当たらないので、ブルームか海面のスリックの可能性が高い。前後の通過には無い。
note_en: Several thin turquoise streaks cross the circle from north-west to south-east and widen outside the circle to the south-east. They are not visible in SWIR, so not floating matter, and no source point is found; most likely a bloom or sea-surface slicks. Not present on the passes before and after.

note_ja: 円の東側に南北に伸びる淡い黄褐色のまだらの帯が浮遊物候補になる (7.61 km2)。縁はぼやけ、SWIR では淡い青灰色、帯の西に雲の影らしい暗い筋が並ぶので薄雲の可能性が高い。ただ 2022 年はトンガ周辺に軽石が漂っていた年で、面積も大きいので確認を。前後の 08-27 と 09-04 は晴れて何もない。
note_en: A pale yellow-brown mottled band running north-south on the east side of the circle is a floating matter candidate (7.61 km2). The edges are blurred, it is pale blue-grey in SWIR, and dark streaks that look like cloud shadows line up west of the band, so most likely thin cloud. However, 2022 was a year when pumice drifted around Tonga, and the area is large, so please check. The neighbouring 08-27 and 09-04 are clear with nothing.

note_ja: 中心付近に淡い緑の斑があり、そこから西へ細い帯が伸びる (1.21 km2)。通常の見え方と前の通過 (02-20) にも中心に淡い緑の点があり浅瀬の可能性があるが、今回は範囲が広く西へ流れる形。周りは雲に囲まれグリント注意。
note_en: A pale green patch near the centre, with a thin band extending west from it (1.21 km2). The normal appearance and the previous pass (02-20) also have a pale green point at the centre, so it may be a shoal, but this time it is wider and shaped as a westward flow. It is surrounded by cloud; glint caution.

note_ja: 12-21 は既知の浅瀬 (シアン枠) の南東に淡い青緑の斑が拡散した縁取りを伴って出ており、円内の他の場所にも淡い緑の筋がある。12-11 は Epi 島東端の岬に接する青緑の渦。Karua の山頂付近の変色水の可能性を否定できない。
note_en: On 12-21, a pale blue-green patch with a diffuse fringe appears south-east of the known shoal (cyan frame), and there are pale green streaks elsewhere in the circle too. 12-11 is a blue-green swirl touching the cape at the eastern end of Epi Island. Discoloured water near the summit of Karua cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 常時変色水のある福徳岡ノ場で、中心の北東約1.3 kmに淡い青緑の斑と周りに広がる淡い帯がある。既知の活動の続きと見られ、規模は小さい。
note_en: At Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, which always has discoloured water, there is a faint blue-green patch about 1.3 km north-east of the centre with faint bands spreading around it. Seen as a continuation of known activity; small in scale.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた島の北端の湾 (水没したカルデラ) の周り。02-14 は南東の外海側の岸に沿う細い帯、03-06 は氷片の散る湾内の灰色の水と南岸沖の雲の切れ間、03-26 と 03-31 は湾内西部の明るい灰色の斑 (1.24, 1.16 km2)。晩冬の湾内の薄氷か雪解け水の可能性が高いが、湾内の同じ所に 3 回出るので確認を。
note_en: Around the bay (a submerged caldera) at the north end of the snow-covered island. On 02-14 a thin band along the south-east shore on the open-sea side; on 03-06 grey water in the bay with scattered ice fragments and a gap in the cloud off the south shore; on 03-26 and 03-31 bright grey patches in the western part of the bay (1.24, 1.16 km2). Most likely late-winter thin ice or snowmelt water in the bay, but it appears 3 times at the same place in the bay, so please check.

note_ja: 2/25 に円の中心 (中心から 0.04 km) に明るい緑の小斑があり、その東と南東に淡い緑の塊が流れる。2/23 と前後の通過 (2/20) にも中心の近くに緑の小斑と筋が見える。雲から離れ SWIR で暗い。
note_en: On 2/25 there is a small bright green patch at the centre of the circle (0.04 km from the centre), with pale green masses flowing to its east and south-east. On 2/23 and on the earlier pass (2/20) too, a small green patch and streak are visible near the centre. Away from cloud and dark in SWIR.

note_ja: 雪に覆われたカルデラ湾の中に淡い灰白色の水面（3.6 km2）と小さな浮遊物候補。前の通過（04-02）にも候補があり、薄氷か海霧の可能性が高いが確かではない。
note_en: Inside the snow-covered caldera bay, a pale grey-white water surface (3.6 km2) and a small floating matter candidate. The previous pass (04-02) also had a candidate; most likely thin ice or sea fog, but not certain.

note_ja: 雪の Yankicha 島と Ryponkicha 島の間の海峡に青緑の斑が出る。09-11 からの組と同じ位置で、浅い海峡の底や氷の可能性もあるが繰り返している。
note_en: A blue-green patch appears in the strait between snowy Yankicha and Ryponkicha Islands. Same position as the set from 09-11; it may be the bottom of the shallow strait or ice, but it recurs.

note_ja: Yankicha 島と Ryponkicha 島の間の地峡北西側の岸沿いに約 0.1 km2 の緑の斑が 3 回同じ位置に出る (10-03 は雲)。浅い海峡の浅瀬の可能性が高いが、島に温泉・噴気があるので一応見る。
note_en: A green patch of about 0.1 km2 appears in the same position 3 times along the shore on the north-west side of the isthmus between Yankicha and Ryponkicha islands (10-03 is cloud). A shoal in the shallow strait is most likely, but as the islands have hot springs and fumaroles, worth a look.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 09-13以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 09-13. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 円の中央付近にごく淡い緑の小斑が 3 つ (計 0.15 km2) あり、周りに淡いターコイズの霞のような色がある。グリント注意の下で色が弱く、ブルームかグリントの残りの可能性が高いが、雲からは離れている。後の通過 (10-16) も変色 0.03 km2。
note_en: There are 3 very pale small green patches (0.15 km2 in total) near the middle of the circle, with a pale turquoise haze-like colour around them. The colour is weak under glint caution, and a bloom or residual glint is most likely, but it is away from cloud. The later pass (10-16) also has discolouration of 0.03 km2.

note_ja: 雲に覆われた Panarea 島の東約 0.5 km に南北に細い淡緑の筋（0.14 km²）と小片。雲の隣接か島の浅い棚の可能性が高いが、東岸の噴気域に近い。
note_en: About 0.5 km east of cloud-covered Panarea, a thin north-south pale green streak (0.14 km²) and small fragments. Most likely cloud adjacency or the island's shallow shelf, but it is close to the fumarole area on the east shore.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 少なくとも変色域の源はサークル内ではない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: At the least, the source of the discoloured area is not inside the circle.

note_ja: 01-02 に西側からターコイズの水塊が鋭い前線で入り込み、01-17・01-22 は海域全体がターコイズに変わっている (sc)。2021-22 年 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai 噴火の変色水・火山灰の流入と見られ、輪郭そのものは雲の縁が多い。
note_en: On 01-02 a mass of turquoise water enters from the west with a sharp front, and on 01-17 and 01-22 the whole sea area has turned turquoise (sc). Seen as discoloured water and an influx of volcanic ash from the 2021-22 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai eruption; the outlines themselves are mostly cloud edges.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 10-03以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 10-03. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-23には特異なものは移っていない。07-24は高速船の様なものが航跡と共に映っている。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Nothing unusual is visible on 07-23. On 07-24 something like a fast boat is visible with its wake.

note_ja: ゾーン南西に径約2 kmの青緑がかった水域があり、候補はその中の小斑で周りに小さな積雲がある。薄い雲による色の可能性が高いが、SWIRではその水域に雲が見えず断定できない。
note_en: In the south-west of the zone there is a bluish-green area of water about 2 km across, and the candidate is a small patch within it, with small cumulus around. Most likely colour from thin cloud, but no cloud is visible over that water in SWIR, so it cannot be settled.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 08-04, 08-20 and 08-21, all three.

note_ja: Sholan 島 (2011-12 年の新島) の南に青緑の濁りが尾を引き、03-30・04-09 とも同じ形 (1.1-1.7 km2、グリント注意・強)。侵食中のテフラ島の沿岸濁りと浅瀬の可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口なので一応見る。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water trails south of Sholan Island (a new island of 2011-12), with the same shape on both 03-30 and 04-09 (1.1-1.7 km2, glint caution: strong). Coastal turbid water and a shoal around the eroding tephra island are most likely, but as the island itself is a vent, worth a look.

note_ja: 04-19・05-04・05-09 は島々を囲むターコイズの浅い島棚で、通常の見え方のシアン輪郭とほぼ一致する。06-01 だけ北の島の北西約1 kmに小さなターコイズの斑があり、周りは小さな積雲で判断しきれない。
note_en: 04-19, 05-04 and 05-09 are the turquoise shallow island shelf surrounding the islands, almost matching the cyan outline in the normal appearance. Only on 06-01 is there a small turquoise patch about 1 km north-west of the northern island, surrounded by small cumulus, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: グリント注意の快晴の回で、中心のすぐ北東から南西へ細い暗い線が延び、その先に暗い不規則な斑(SWIRでも暗い)があり、候補はこの斑の縁にある。色はなく、船の航跡と海面のスリックの可能性が高いが、位置が火口丘のほぼ中心なので確認したい。
note_en: A clear pass with glint caution; a thin dark line extends south-west from just north-east of the centre, ending in a dark irregular patch (also dark in SWIR), and the candidate is at the edge of this patch. No colour; a ship wake and a surface slick are likely, but the position is almost at the centre of the cone, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 区域中央に北西-南東に伸びる淡い黄緑の帯が見え、後の回 (08-28) にも区域内に緑がかった筋がある。2021 年噴火後の変色水の可能性。
note_en: A pale yellow-green band extending north-west to south-east is visible in the middle of the zone, and the later pass (08-28) also has a greenish streak within the zone. Possibly discoloured water after the 2021 eruption.

note_ja: ラウル島西岸のデナム湾の岸沿いに青緑の帯があり、10-07 の通過と同じ位置。岸の浅瀬や濁りの可能性もある。
note_en: A blue-green band along the shore of Denham Bay on the west coast of Raoul Island, in the same position as on the 10-07 pass. It may also be a shoal along the shore or turbid water.

note_ja: ガロベ島のカルデラ湾の中に周りよりやや灰色の水があり、候補はそれを囲む。湾内の普段の濁りの可能性が高いが、後の通過 (2020-09-16, L3) では湾口から南へ乳白色の水が出ている。
note_en: Inside the caldera bay of Garove Island the water is slightly greyer than its surroundings, and the candidate surrounds it. Most likely the usual turbid water of the bay, but on the later pass (2020-09-16, L3) milky-white water comes out south from the mouth of the bay.

note_ja: 2019-20 年の火口付近に青緑の斑 (1.95 km2) があり、南東へ尾を引く。積雲の間だが雲の脇ではなく、2020-07/08 の斑と同じ場所。侵食で消えた島の浅瀬の濁りか熱水の変色。
note_en: There is a blue-green patch (1.95 km2) near the 2019-20 vent, trailing to the south-east. It is among cumulus but not beside a cloud, and at the same place as the 2020-07/08 patches. Either turbid water on the shoal of the island lost to erosion, or hydrothermal discolouration.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 07-22 and 07-24 as well.

note_ja: 候補は北の小島群の周りの青緑の浅い棚 (既知の浅瀬の輪郭) に沿うもので、それ自体は浅瀬。ただし同じ通過で島群の北に細い暗い灰色の筋が北へ延びており、船や飛行機雲の影の可能性が高いが確かめられない。
note_en: The candidate follows the blue-green shallow shelf around the northern islets (outline of the known shoal), and is itself a shoal. However, on the same pass a thin dark grey streak extends north from north of the islands; most likely the shadow of a ship or a contrail, but it cannot be confirmed.

note_ja: 09-25 の候補は西側を縦に走る二本のグリント縞で無視できる。10-02 の S2 では Jadid 島の北に淡い灰色の帯 (ap) が島から伸びており、後の 2025-10 からの帯と同じ種類か確かめたい。
note_en: The candidate on 09-25 is two vertical glint stripes on the western side and can be ignored. On 10-02 in S2 a pale grey band (ap) extends from Jadid Island to its north; I would like to check whether it is the same kind as the band from 2025-10 onwards.

note_ja: 積雲と薄雲の多い場面で、候補は雲の間の暗い水の小片 (0.53 km2) で源の点は無い。雲の誤検出の可能性が高いが、熱画素が 546 と多く、図からは位置を確かめられない (Izena Hole は深いので海面の熱は考えにくい)。
note_en: A scene with much cumulus and thin cloud; the candidate is a small fragment of dark water between clouds (0.53 km2) with no source point. A false detection from cloud is most likely, but there are many hot pixels (546) and their position cannot be checked from the figure (Izena Hole is deep, so heat at the sea surface is unlikely).

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 帯は大気中の現象 (薄い雲・砂塵・噴気のどれかは判別できない)。記録に残す (db/records/airborne_bands.csv)
note_en: 2026-11-14: The band is an airborne phenomenon (whether thin cloud, dust or a fumarolic plume cannot be determined). Kept on record (db/records/airborne_bands.csv).

note_ja: 05-08 と 05-15 にゾーン中心から 1 km 前後の開けた海に緑〜ターコイズの斑 (0.76・0.91 km2) が同じ位置に出て、SWIR では暗く雲から離れ、05-08 は高温画素 4。04-18 は雲ともやの下の灰色の広がりで判断できない。East Epi 火口丘群の上の変色水の可能性がある。
note_en: On 05-08 and 05-15 a green to turquoise patch (0.76, 0.91 km2) appears in the same position in open sea about 1 km from the zone centre; it is dark in SWIR and away from cloud, and 05-08 has 4 hot pixels. 04-18 is a grey spread under cloud and haze and cannot be judged. It may be discoloured water above the East Epi cone group.

note_ja: 01-07 は北西の小島群の間の浅い台地の青緑の水に散る輪郭 (2.34 km2)、04-24 も北の小島の南の浅い水 (0.80 km2)。03-05 と 03-30 は Jadid 島の北から北東に接する青緑の斑 (0.65, 0.86 km2) で、島から北北西へ伸びる暗い筋 (風下の静穏域と見る) の縁にある。浅瀬と風下の水の見え方の可能性が高いが、島が 2013 年の火口なので確認を。
note_en: 01-07 is outlines scattered over blue-green water on the shallow platform between the islets to the north-west (2.34 km2), and 04-24 is also shallow water south of the small northern island (0.80 km2). 03-05 and 03-30 are blue-green patches adjoining Jadid Island to the north to north-east (0.65, 0.86 km2), at the edge of a dark streak running north-north-west from the island (read as calm water in the lee). The appearance of the shoal and the lee water is likely, but the island is the 2013 vent, so please check.

note_ja: 12-31 は区域東側の色のないスリック状の淡い斑、01-16 は積雲の間の緑がかった水で雲の縁の色に見える。ただし 02-17 の通過で区域南西外に青緑の細い筋があり、念のため確認したい。
note_en: 12-31 is a colourless slick-like pale patch on the eastern side of the zone, and 01-16 is greenish water between cumulus, which looks like the colour of cloud edges. However, on the 02-17 pass there is a thin blue-green streak outside the zone to the south-west, so I would like it checked to be safe.

note_ja: 中心の北から南へ幅数百 m の褐色がかった直線状の帯が数 km 続く。飛行機雲の影か船の航跡の可能性が高いが、雲から離れており断定できない。
note_en: A brownish straight band a few hundred m wide continues for several km from north of the centre to the south. Most likely the shadow of a contrail or a ship wake, but it is away from cloud and cannot be settled.

note_ja: Ushishir 島の南東岸のすぐ沖に青緑の小斑 (0.56 km2) が岸から南へ伸びる。浅瀬や砕波の可能性が高いが、通常の姿に浅瀬の輪郭がなく、1 回だけなので判断しきれない。
note_en: Just off the south-east shore of Ushishir Island, a small blue-green patch (0.56 km2) extends south from the shore. Most likely a shoal or breaking waves, but the normal appearance has no shoal outline and it is only once, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: 円の南、Grenada 側の浅い陸棚の縁に沿って広い青緑の水が帯状に広がり、北側の境がはっきりしていて筋状の模様がある。陸棚の水が流れで張り出したもの (潮目) の可能性が高いが、火口 (円の中心) の南 4 km にかかるので確かめたい。
note_en: South of the circle, wide blue-green water spreads in a band along the edge of the shallow shelf on the Grenada side, with a sharp northern boundary and streaky patterns. Most likely shelf water pushed out by currents (a current front), but it reaches 4 km south of the vent (circle centre), so I would like it checked.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 05-16 and 06-01.

note_ja: 候補 (0.20 km2) は雲がかかる島の南岸、二つの山の間の入り江に接する淡い青緑の浅い水で、雲に接する (cloud-adjacent 0.54)。岸から離れて広がる変色や尾はなく、後の 07-16 にも何もない。
note_en: The candidate (0.20 km2) is pale blue-green shallow water touching a cove between two hills on the south coast of the island, which is under cloud; it touches cloud (cloud-adjacent 0.54). No discoloured water spreads away from the shore and there is no tail; the later pass of 07-16 shows nothing either.

note_ja: 上空の帯 (ap) の候補は区域中央の小さな雲の脇から西へ伸びる細い帯で、周りの海面にも緑がかった筋が広がる。薄雲かブルームの可能性が高いが決めきれない。
note_en: The band in the air (ap) candidate is a thin band extending west from beside a small cloud in the middle of the zone, and greenish streaks also spread over the surrounding sea surface. Most likely thin cloud or a bloom, but it cannot be settled.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: AIの初見が正しいと考えられる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: The first reading by the AI is thought to be correct.

note_ja: 雲の無い通過で区域中央に 68 km2 の淡く乳白色の水塊が入り組んだ縁で広がる。湧出点は見えずブルームや薄い霧の可能性が高いが、断定できない。
note_en: On a cloud-free pass, a pale milky water mass of 68 km2 with intricate edges spreads in the middle of the zone. No source point is visible and a bloom or thin fog is most likely, but this cannot be stated firmly.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 11-08: これは雲。 11-09: 微かに大きくて深い海水変色があり北東に流れているようにみえるが判然としない。 11-17,29: サークルの北の外に明瞭な海水変色が見られる。他の火山からのものか？ 11-26: NWからSEにたなびく海水変色の帯が幾つも見えるが、カバレッジが限られておりどこから来たものか不明。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 11-08: this is cloud. 11-09: faint, large and deep discoloured water seems to flow north-east, but it is not clear. 11-17 and 11-29: clear discoloured water outside the circle to the north; from another volcano? 11-26: several bands of discoloured water trail from north-west to south-east, but the coverage is limited and where they come from is unknown.

note_ja: 区域の中心近くに乳白色がかった緑の水の斑(7.7 km2)がはっきり広がり、雲から離れている。後の 2014-12-10 の通過でも緑の帯が見え、Kavachi の活動による変色水とみられる。
note_en: A patch of milky green water (7.7 km2) spreads clearly near the zone centre, away from cloud. A green band is also visible on the later pass of 2014-12-10, and it appears to be discoloured water from Kavachi's activity.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 自動判定を目視で追認
note_en: 2026-11-14: The automatic detection is confirmed by eye.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 2022-04-18: L3は雲の誤認とみられる。 2022-04-30: 中央東に小さい海水変色あり 2022-05-06: 中央西(05-08と同じ地点)に小さな海水変色あり
note_en: 2026-11-14: 2022-04-18: the L3 seems to be cloud taken for a detection. 2022-04-30: small discoloured water east of the centre. 2022-05-06: small discoloured water west of the centre (the same place as on 05-08).

note_ja: ゾーンの北西と南に淡い黄緑の水が広がり、南には北東へ延びる縁のはっきりした帯がある。起点は見えず、沿岸の水塊の前線かブルームの可能性が高いが、いつもの見え方にはないので念のため確認。
note_en: Faint yellow-green water spreads in the north-west and south of the zone, and in the south there is a sharp-edged band extending north-east. No origin is visible; a front between coastal water masses or a bloom is likely, but it is not in the usual appearance, so checking just in case.

note_ja: 円の中央 (2019-20 年火口) に青緑の斑があり、南西端に明るい点 (浅瀬か島の残骸) が付き、東へ淡い筋が延びる。03-08 と 03-28 の通過にも同じ場所に緑の斑が見え、2019 年 11 月の噴火後に続く変色水と見られる。
note_en: There is a blue-green patch in the middle of the circle (the 2019-20 vent), with a bright dot (a shoal or the remains of the island) at its south-west end and a pale streak extending east. A green patch is also visible in the same place on the 03-08 and 03-28 passes, and it appears to be the discoloured water continuing after the November 2019 eruption.

note_ja: Kavachi 山頂の北東に明るい緑〜青緑の変色水が 6.9 km2 広がり、10-01 と 10-11 にも同じ色の斑と帯が出ている。SWIR では暗く雲ではない。活動中の Kavachi の変色水の続きと見られる。
note_en: Bright green to blue-green discoloured water spreads over 6.9 km2 north-east of Kavachi's summit, and patches and bands of the same colour also appear on 10-01 and 10-11. It is dark in SWIR, so not cloud. Read as continuation of the discoloured water of active Kavachi.

note_ja: グリントなし、雲から離れた位置に北西-南東に細長い淡い緑の筋 (1.4 km2) が 1 本。湧出点ははっきりせずスリックかブルームの可能性が高い。
note_en: No glint; a single thin pale green streak (1.4 km2) elongated north-west to south-east, away from cloud. There is no clear source point; most likely a slick or a bloom.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島から青緑の水が 03-18 は西へ約 3 km の帯、03-25 は東側から鉤形に、03-30 は島全周に広がる。2016-17 年噴火でできた未固結の島の浸食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島を源とする流れが 3 回続くので念のため。
note_en: Blue-green water spreads from Bogoslof Island: on 03-18 as a band about 3 km to the west, on 03-25 in a hook from the east side, and on 03-30 all around the island. Turbid water from erosion of the unconsolidated island formed in the 2016-17 eruption is most likely, but as the flow from the island as source continues 3 times, to be safe.

note_ja: 03-01 に火口中心付近から東へ伸びる青緑の変色水の帯（2.6 km2）、03-11 と 03-21 も中心付近に緑の斑。福徳岡ノ場の持続的な変色水の続きと見られるが、噴出点のある帯がはっきり写っている。
note_en: On 03-01 a band of blue-green discoloured water (2.6 km2) extends east from near the vent centre, and 03-11 and 03-21 also have green patches near the centre. Read as continuation of the persistent discoloured water of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, but a band with an emission point is clearly captured.

note_ja: 群島北部の島から灰色の帯（空中 2.11 km2）が南へ細長く伸び、SWIR でもかすかに褐色の筋が見える。2013 年の噴火の数か月後で、島からの噴気か灰の可能性がある（塵との区別は第一段階ではできない）。
note_en: A grey band (airborne, 2.11 km2) extends long and thin to the south from an island in the northern part of the group, and a faint brownish streak is visible in SWIR too. It is a few months after the 2013 eruption, and it may be fumarolic emission or ash from the island (it cannot be told from dust at the first stage).

note_ja: McDonald島の北東岸から北東へ舌状に伸びる明るいターコイズの水(3.6 km2)。既知の浅瀬の輪郭を越えて広がり、後の回(11-03)にもdw 1.88。島の侵食の濁りか火山性の変色か判断できない。
note_en: Bright turquoise water (3.6 km2) extending north-east in a tongue from the north-east shore of McDonald Island. It spreads beyond the outline of the known shoal, and the later pass (11-03) also has dw 1.88. Whether it is turbid water from erosion of the island or volcanic discolouration cannot be judged.

note_ja: ゾーン南西部、Epi島の北の沖に小さな淡い緑の斑が12月16日・21日・26日の3回同じ位置に出ている(12月21日は周りに淡い暈)。雲から離れており、いつもの見え方にもかすかに同じ点があるので持続的な熱水変色の可能性がある。
note_en: In the south-west of the zone, offshore north of Epi Island, a small pale green patch appears in the same position 3 times, on 16, 21 and 26 December (with a pale halo around it on 21 December). It is away from cloud, and the same point is faintly present in the usual appearance too, so it may be persistent hydrothermal discolouration.

note_ja: 火口付近の一点から青白〜緑の変色水が西へ尾を引き、3 回とも同じ湧出点。2021 年噴火後の活動の続きとみられる。
note_en: Bluish-white to green discoloured water trails west from a single point near the vent, from the same source point all 3 times. It appears to be the continuation of activity after the 2021 eruption.

note_ja: 09-10 と 09-15 は画像端の黒い直線に沿う帯。08-26 は円の北西で雲に囲まれた隙間の中央に淡い緑灰色の斑があり、周りの雲片に浮遊物候補が付く。薄雲か霞の可能性が高いが、雲からやや離れた斑で確かめきれない。
note_en: 09-10 and 09-15 are bands along the black straight line at the image edge. On 08-26 there is a faint green-grey patch in the middle of a gap surrounded by cloud in the north-west of the circle, with floating matter candidates attached to the surrounding cloud fragments. Thin cloud or haze is likely, but the patch is somewhat away from cloud and this cannot be fully confirmed.

note_ja: 常時区分。島の周りの濁り。
note_en: "Persistent" class. Turbid water around the island.

note_ja: 火口の近く (中心から 0.8 km) に白い明るい斑が出るが、グリント注意の中で積雲と影に囲まれており、グリントの可能性が高い。2024 年に変色水の既報がある火山なので念のため。
note_en: A bright white patch appears near the vent (0.8 km from the centre), but it is surrounded by cumulus and shadows under glint caution, and glint is most likely. As this is a volcano with a prior report of discoloured water in 2024, to be safe.

note_ja: 島の北東約3 kmにターコイズの C 字形の渦があり、島の南東側からも雲沿いに輪郭が延びる。前の 02-23 にも島の周りに乳白色〜ターコイズの水が広がっており、Heard 島の氷河由来の濁りやブルームの可能性もあるが、活動的な火山島の周りなので見たい。
note_en: About 3 km north-east of the island there is a C-shaped turquoise swirl, and an outline also extends along the cloud from the south-east side of the island. On the previous pass, 02-23, milky-white to turquoise water also spread around the island; it may be turbid water from Heard Island's glaciers or a bloom, but it is around an active volcanic island, so I would like to look at it.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water can be seen on 01-26 and on 02-04, 07, 08, 11, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 26. The other days are doubtful.

note_ja: 島の東岸の礁 (通常の姿の水色の輪郭) の外に接する淡い青紫の斑 (1.03 km2)。熱異常が 2895 px と非常に多いが、SWIR では雲の群れの縁がどこも黄色く縁取られており (雲の移動による帯の時間差)、それを拾った可能性が高い。前後の通過に変色はない。礁の縁の見え方と見るが、熱異常の位置を確かめたい。
note_en: A pale bluish-purple patch (1.03 km2) touching the outside of the reef on the island's east shore (the light-blue outline in the usual-appearance image). There are very many thermal anomalies (2895 px), but in SWIR the edges of the cloud groups are rimmed with yellow everywhere (band time lag due to cloud motion), and it most likely picked those up. There is no discolouration on the earlier and later passes. I take it to be the appearance of the reef edge, but I would like the position of the thermal anomaly checked.

note_ja: 区域中央（2021 年の火口付近）に小さな緑〜青緑の斑があり、04-22 の通過にも同じ位置に緑の点がある。常時区分の区域で続いている変色水とみられる。
note_en: A small green to blue-green patch in the middle of the zone (near the 2021 vent), and the 04-22 pass also has a green dot at the same position. Seen as the continuing discoloured water of a zone in the "persistent" class.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 海水変色。既知の変色源から伸びているように見え、異常ではない
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured sea water. It appears to extend from the known source of discolouration, and is not anomalous.

note_ja: Landsat 9 の強いサングリントの下で、候補は雲塊の間の切れ間の水と雲の縁で、色の分類が無い。雲とグリントで説明できそうだが、高温画素が 40 あり位置が絵から分からないので念のため。
note_en: Under strong Landsat 9 sun glint, the candidate is water in a gap between cloud masses and cloud edges, with no colour class. It can probably be explained by cloud and glint, but there are 40 hot pixels and their position cannot be seen from the image, so just in case.

note_ja: 2019-20 年火口の位置 (区域の中心から 1 km 以内) から出る緑〜青緑の変色水。回ごとに形と向きが変わり (06-10 は南東へ伸びる帯、07-10 は幅のある斑、07-20 は一点から南西へ尾を引く筋)、動かない浅瀬の見え方ではない。短波長赤外では暗く、雲から離れている。2026-04-11 から 10-08 まで 53 回の観測のうち 16 回で候補が出ており、面積は 6〜7 月が最大 (0.7〜0.9 km2)。2025-11 から 2026-03 までは出ていない。軽石・噴煙・新しい陸地は見えない。
note_en: Green to blue-green discoloured water coming from the position of the 2019-20 vent (within 1 km of the zone centre). Its shape and direction change from pass to pass (06-10 a band extending south-east, 07-10 a broad patch, 07-20 a streak trailing south-west from a single point), which is not the appearance of a stationary shoal. It is dark in short-wave infrared and away from cloud. Of 53 observations from 2026-04-11 to 10-08, candidates appeared on 16, with the largest area in June-July (0.7-0.9 km2). None appeared from 2025-11 to 2026-03. No pumice, eruption plume or new land is visible.

note_ja: 南西の外側から入って北東へ細く延びる黄緑の濁った帯(5.3km2)がゾーンを横切る。起点は画面の外で、川の濁りか近くの火山(Kavachiなど)の変色水かは判断できないので確認したい。
note_en: A yellow-green turbid band (5.3 km2) enters from outside to the south-west and extends thinly north-east across the zone. Its origin is off-screen, and it cannot be judged whether it is river turbidity or discoloured water from a nearby volcano (such as Kavachi), so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 中央の小島群の周りの浅い台地の青緑の暈と、島の岸から北東へ伸びる緑の渦 (12-23 に 4.12 km2)。前後の通過にも暈は写り、新しい島の岸の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、既知浅瀬の輪郭の外へ広がる。12-03 の新陸判定は画像端の黒い直線沿い。
note_en: A blue-green halo over the shallow platform around the central islets, and a green swirl extending north-east from the island shore (4.12 km2 on 12-23). The halo is also seen on the passes before and after; most likely turbid water from shore erosion of the new island, but it spreads beyond the outline of the known shoal. The new land detection on 12-03 is along a black straight line at the image edge.

note_ja: 03-25はJadid島北西端から北東へ伸びる帯状のターコイズの水、04-21と05-04は北西の小島の南東の浅い棚の上に同じ形の淡い斑。浅瀬の巻き上げや島の侵食の濁りらしいが、03-25の帯は確認を推す。
note_en: 03-25 is band-shaped turquoise water extending north-east from the north-west tip of Jadid Island; 04-21 and 05-04 are faint patches of the same shape on the shallow shelf south-east of the islet to the north-west. Seems to be sediment stirred up on the shoal or turbid water from erosion of the island, but the 03-25 band is recommended for checking.

note_ja: 中心の南約 2 km に南北 4 km ほどの淡い緑の細長い斑があり、SWIR では暗く雲ではない。04-11 にも同じ位置に小さな候補が出ており、浅い山頂の底か変色水か確かめたい。
note_en: About 2 km south of the centre, an elongated pale green patch about 4 km north-south; it is dark in SWIR, so not cloud. A small candidate also appeared at the same position on 04-11; I would like to check whether it is the bottom of the shallow summit or discoloured water.

note_ja: 雪氷に覆われた 2 つの島の岸をぐるりと取り巻く青緑の縁で、東の島の北岸からは淡緑の舌が北へ約 1 km 伸びる。夏の氷河の融け水の濁りか雪の明るさのにじみとみられるが、1 回だけで比べられる晴れたパスが無いので念のため。
note_en: A blue-green fringe running all round the shores of two snow- and ice-covered islands, and from the north shore of the eastern island a pale green tongue extends about 1 km north. Seen as turbid summer glacial meltwater or bleeding of snow brightness, but it is only once and there is no clear pass to compare with, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 02-02は他の時期にもある謎の光芒。火山性の可能性はなさそう。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 02-02 is an unexplained streak of light that is there at other times as well. Volcanic origin seems unlikely.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた島の Brouton 湾 (カルデラ) の中で、04-04 は湾の内岸に沿う淡い灰青色の帯、04-07 は湾の中の小さな斑の列。外海側の候補は岸沿いの細い帯。4 月の高緯度で湾内の薄氷か融雪水の可能性が高いが、04-07 は熱異常画素 3 を伴うので確かめたい。
note_en: In Brouton Bay (caldera) of the snow-covered island: on 04-04 a pale grey-blue band along the inner shore of the bay, on 04-07 a row of small patches inside the bay. The candidate on the open-sea side is a thin band along the shore. In April at high latitude it is most likely thin ice or snowmelt water in the bay, but 04-07 comes with 3 thermal anomaly pixels, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 候補は雲の塊の間の暗い水で色の分類が無く、雲の影か薄雲とみられる。ただ高温画素 20 があり、その位置が絵から分からないので念のため。
note_en: The candidate is dark water between cloud masses with no colour class, and looks like cloud shadow or thin cloud. However, there are 20 hot pixels and their position cannot be seen from the image, so just in case.

note_ja: 雲の少ない日に、ラテイキの小島に接して淡い青緑の斑がある（中心から 0.7 km）。2019 年噴火前の変色水の可能性があり、確かめたい。
note_en: On a day with little cloud, there is a faint blue-green patch adjoining the Lateiki islet (0.7 km from the centre). Possibly discoloured water before the 2019 eruption; I would like to check.

note_ja: 福徳岡ノ場の区域中心の小さな積雲の南に緑の変色水の斑があり、02-17 と 03-13 の前後の通過でも中心付近にかすかな緑の筋が見える。継続する変色水と見られる。
note_en: A patch of green discoloured water south of a small cumulus at the zone centre of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, and the neighbouring passes on 02-17 and 03-13 also show faint green streaks near the centre. Read as continuing discoloured water.

note_ja: 雲のない日に、パナレア島東の岩礁群（2002 年のガス噴出域付近）の南 0.5 km に淡い斑がある。ガスによる白濁か海面の違いか画像だけでは決められない。
note_en: On a cloud-free day there is a pale patch 0.5 km south of the reefs east of Panarea (near the 2002 gas emission area). Whether it is whitening by gas or a difference in the sea surface cannot be decided from the image alone.

note_ja: 南北に長い乳青緑の帯 (10-21 西側 13.35 km2、11-05 東側 3.13 km2) が枠を横切り、点源は見えない。プランクトンの帯状ブルームか潮目の可能性が高いが、色は火山性の乳青緑と区別しきれない。
note_en: A milky blue-green band elongated north-south (10-21 on the western side 13.35 km2, 11-05 on the eastern side 3.13 km2) crosses the frame, and no point source is visible. A band-shaped plankton bloom or a tide line is most likely, but the colour cannot be fully distinguished from volcanic milky blue-green.

note_ja: 中央の小島の南西にターコイズの小斑と小さな明るい点(nl)があり、小島周りの浅い台地の色に近い。たぶん浅瀬だが、新しい陸の判定が出ているので念のため。
note_en: A small turquoise patch and a small bright point (nl) south-west of the central islet, close to the colour of the shallow platform around the islet. Probably a shoal, but a new land detection was triggered, so just in case.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた北の島の北岸から数百 m 沖に、岸と平行な青緑の細い帯がある。そのすぐ西には岸から北西へ延びる灰色の楔形の帯があり、冬の沿岸の濁りや風による海面の筋の可能性が高いが確かめられない。
note_en: A thin blue-green band parallel to the shore a few hundred m off the north shore of the snow-covered northern island. Just west of it is a grey wedge-shaped band extending north-west from the shore; winter coastal turbid water or wind streaks on the sea surface are most likely, but this cannot be confirmed.

note_ja: 島の南岸から南へ約 4 km 流れる乳白の青緑のプルーム (4.57 km2)。前の通過 (09-26) にも島の東に淡いプルームがある。2016-17 年噴火の砕屑物の島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島から出るプルームで熱水の可能性も消せない。
note_en: A milky blue-green plume flowing about 4 km south from the island's south shore (4.57 km2). The previous pass (09-26) also has a faint plume east of the island. Most likely turbid water from erosion of the island of clastic material from the 2016-17 eruption, but it is a plume coming from the island and hydrothermal water cannot be excluded.

note_ja: Panarea 島の東、岩礁群のすぐ西 (2002 年のガス噴出域の近く、中心から 0.2 km) に小さな水色の斑。島の北東を覆う厚い雲と薄雲のすぐ脇で霞の可能性が高いが、位置が火口域なので確認したい。
note_en: East of Panarea, just west of the group of rocks (near the 2002 gas emission area, 0.2 km from the centre), a small light-blue patch. Right beside the thick cloud and thin cloud covering the north-east of the island, so most likely haze, but the location is the vent area, so I would like it checked.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 10-15 and 10-17 as well.

note_ja: ゾーン中心（2021 年火口）に青緑の変色水の斑があり、北東へ淡い筋が伸びる。前後の回にも中心にかすかな斑が見え、福徳岡ノ場の持続的な変色水の続きと見られる。
note_en: A patch of blue-green discoloured water at the zone centre (the 2021 vent), with a faint streak extending north-east. A faint patch is visible at the centre on the passes before and after too; seen as a continuation of the persistent discoloured water of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba.

note_ja: パナレア島の南岸から南へ淡い水色の斑が 2 km ほど延びる。グリントなし。島の風下の静穏域か浅い棚の可能性もあるが、ガス噴出の知られる場所なので確認したい。
note_en: A pale light-blue patch extends about 2 km south from the south shore of Panarea. No glint. It may be a calm area downwind of the island or a shallow shelf, but as this is a place known for gas emissions I would like it checked.

note_ja: 10-23 は筋状の巻雲の下の小斑、11-07 は積雲の間と影の灰色の小斑で、候補そのものは雲によるものとみられる。ただし 11-07 に高温画素が 51 あり、シートからは位置が分からないので念のため。
note_en: 10-23 is a small patch under streaky cirrus, and 11-07 a small grey patch between cumulus and shadow, so the candidates themselves seem to be due to cloud. However, on 11-07 there are 51 hot pixels and their position cannot be found from the sheet, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: Hunga Ha'apai 島の南西に島に接して淡い白っぽい斑(14 km2)。反射注意の通過で風下の凪の可能性が高いが、島に接しているので念のため。
note_en: A pale whitish patch (14 km2) touching the island south-west of Hunga Ha'apai Island. A pass under reflection caution, and calm water downwind is most likely, but as it touches the island, to be safe.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 02-26以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 02-26. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 円の西縁に長さ 3 km ほどの緑の細い直線状の筋があり、東端がやや太く明るい。雲から離れており、トリコデスミウムの帯か船の航跡の可能性が高いが、どちらとも決めきれない。
note_en: On the western edge of the circle there is a thin, straight green streak about 3 km long, its eastern end somewhat thicker and brighter. It is away from cloud, and a Trichodesmium band or a ship wake is most likely, but it cannot be decided which.

note_ja: 宝島の北岸のすぐ沖、浅い台地 (平常図の水色の輪郭) の外縁に緑の小斑 (0.08 km2)。岸の濁りか礁が有力だが、高温画素が 53 と多く、どこに出たのかシートからは分からない。
note_en: Just off the north shore of Takara-jima, a small green patch (0.08 km2) on the outer edge of the shallow platform (light-blue outline in the normal-appearance image). Shore turbidity or reef is the likeliest, but there are as many as 53 hot pixels and the sheet does not show where they are.

note_ja: 02-19 は中央の島の北の島棚のすぐ外にターコイズの斑 (中心から 0.5 km)、06-07 は北の小島の島棚の縁に沿う斑で、島棚の浅い水の色が流れに引かれたものの可能性が高い。04-03 はサングリントが強く、06-04 (最大 4.93 km2) は霞と雲の中。15 回の警報が島の周りに繰り返すので念のため。
note_en: 02-19 is a turquoise patch just outside the island shelf north of the central island (0.5 km from the centre), and 06-07 is a patch along the edge of the island shelf of the northern islet; the colour of the shallow shelf water drawn out by the current is most likely. 04-03 has strong sun glint, and 06-04 (maximum 4.93 km2) is in haze and cloud. As the 15 alerts repeat around the islands, to be safe.

note_ja: この回の褐色の候補は北西の小さな積雲の影の縁に散るもので、雲影による。ただし直後の 4月29日の回 (L1) で、区域南端に暗い楕円の物体と北へ伸びる白い筋が写っており、雲とその影か確かめたい。
note_en: The brown candidates on this pass are scattered along the shadow edges of small cumulus to the north-west, due to cloud shadow. However, on the pass immediately after, on April 29 (L1), a dark oval object and a white streak extending north are captured at the south end of the zone, and I would like to check whether they are cloud and its shadow.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 06-28以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 06-28. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 既知の浅瀬の周りの水色に加え、Sholan 島の北 (ゾーン中心付近) の小さな緑の点が平常像・01-29・01-31 にあり、02-05 はそこから北東へ水色の斑 0.45 km2 が伸びる。2017-06-28 の回ではこの位置に小島が見えるので、侵食された小島の跡の浅瀬と懸濁の見込みが高い。
note_en: In addition to the light blue around the known shoal, a small green dot north of Sholan Island (near the zone centre) is present in the normal image and on 01-29 and 01-31, and on 02-05 a light-blue patch of 0.45 km2 extends north-east from it. On the 2017-06-28 pass a small island is visible at this position, so a shoal left by an eroded islet with suspended sediment is likely.

note_ja: ゾーン中心から 0.55 km、East Epi B (Cioan) の真上に小さな緑の斑があり、その北西に淡いターコイズのかすみが広がる。雲から離れ SWIR では暗く、通常の見え方には浅瀬の色が無い。08-16 にも中心の南東に淡い水色が見える。
note_en: A small green patch 0.55 km from the zone centre, directly over East Epi B (Cioan), with faint turquoise haze spreading to its north-west. Away from cloud, dark in SWIR, and the usual appearance has no shoal colour. On 08-16 too, faint light blue is visible south-east of the centre.

note_ja: ゾーン中心の北約1.6 kmに緑の斑があり、8-4は2つの斑から南へ淡い尾、8-19は同じ位置の斑から南東へ長いプルームが伸びる。雲から離れ、SWIRでは暗く、15日おいて同じ点から出ている。
note_en: A green patch about 1.6 km north of the zone centre; on 8-4 faint tails run south from two patches, and on 8-19 a long plume extends south-east from a patch at the same position. Away from cloud, dark in SWIR, and coming out of the same point 15 days apart.

note_ja: Raoul 島の西岸 (Denham 湾付近) 沿いに淡い水が 02-10・02-26 と同じ位置に出ており、2013-05 と 2019-12 にも同じ西側に候補がある。浅い沿岸や風下の静穏域とみられるが、繰り返し同じ場所なので確認したい。
note_en: Pale water appears along the west coast of Raoul Island (near Denham Bay) in the same position on 02-10 and 02-26, and there were also candidates on the same west side in 2013-05 and 2019-12. It appears to be shallow coastal water or a calm area downwind, but as it repeats in the same place I would like it checked.

note_ja: 旧島 (通常の見え方の黒い点) の周りと南西に緑の変色水の斑・筋があり、前後の 12-29・01-03・01-23 にも中心から延びる緑の筋が見える。変色の多い区域なので、いつもの継続か規模の変化かを見比べたい。
note_en: There are patches and streaks of green discoloured water around and south-west of the old island (the black dot in the usual appearance), and green streaks extending from the centre are also visible on 12-29, 01-03 and 01-23, before and after. It is a zone with frequent discolouration, so I would like to compare whether it is the usual continuation or a change in scale.

note_ja: 南縁の須美寿島 (岩礁) を囲む青緑の暈が南北にのび、南東へわずかに尾を引く (0.23 km2)。岩の周りの浅い台地や砕波でも説明できるが、変色の多いゾーンなので、ふだんより広いかを確かめたい。
note_en: A blue-green halo surrounding Sumisujima (rocks) on the southern edge extends north-south and trails slightly to the south-east (0.23 km2). It can also be explained by the shallow platform around the rocks or breaking waves, but as this zone has frequent discolouration, I would like to check whether it is wider than usual.

note_ja: トゥルマンの小島から南へ伸びる淡い白い帯（長さ約 3 km）。グリントはなく島の風下の風の陰とも見えるが、2016-11-06 にも同じ場所に帯があり、一点から伸びているので確かめたい。
note_en: A pale white band (about 3 km long) extending south from the islet of Tuluman. There is no glint and it could look like the wind shadow downwind of the island, but there was also a band in the same place on 2016-11-06, and it extends from a single point, so I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 04-26 は円の北半分の淡い乳白の広がりの中に候補 (2.25 km2)、05-11 は積雲の間の小片。前の 04-11 にも円の中央を東西に横切る同じ乳白の広がりが写り、04-26 には東縁に緑の細い弧もある。起点は見えずブルームか薄い霞の可能性が高いが、同じ辺りに 1 か月続くので確認を。
note_en: 04-26 has the candidate (2.25 km2) within a pale milky spread over the northern half of the circle, and 05-11 is a small fragment between cumulus. The earlier 04-11 also shows the same milky spread crossing the middle of the circle east-west, and 04-26 also has a thin green arc on the eastern edge. No origin is visible and a bloom or thin haze is most likely, but as it continues in the same area for a month, please check.

note_ja: 03-12 と同じ西岸の青緑の帯に加え、中央の雪をかぶった島を青緑の暈が囲む。岸の濁りや浅瀬の可能性が高いが、島の周りの暈は平常図より濃く見える。
note_en: In addition to the same blue-green band on the west shore as on 03-12, a blue-green halo surrounds the snow-capped island in the centre. Turbid water at the shore or a shoal is likely, but the halo around the island looks denser than in the normal view.

note_ja: 晴天率 0.97 の静かな海面で、中央の 2 つの小島 (Curtis 島と Cheeseman 島) の北側から乳白の青緑の水が北北西へ 3 km ほど広がる (4.19 km2)。雲から離れ SWIR では暗い水で、前後の通過には見えない。冬の荒天による島の侵食の濁りの可能性もあるが、噴気のある火山島から出る点源の変色なので確認を。
note_en: On a calm sea with a clear-sky fraction of 0.97, milky blue-green water spreads about 3 km north-north-west from the north side of the two central islets (Curtis and Cheeseman Islands) (4.19 km2). It is away from cloud and is dark water in SWIR, and is not seen on the passes before and after. It may be turbid water from erosion of the islands in winter storms, but it is point-source discolouration from a volcanic island with fumaroles, so please check.

note_ja: 4/17と5/24は島周りの既知浅瀬（シアン枠）の縁、3/3は霞と雲の縁、5/4は強いグリントと霞の中の斑点。どの回も島の浅い台地か雲・グリントで説明できる。
note_en: 04-17 and 05-24 are the edge of the known shoals around the islands (cyan frame), 03-03 is haze and the edge of cloud, 05-04 is specks within strong sun glint and haze. Every pass can be explained by the shallow platform of the islands or by cloud and sun glint.

note_ja: 06-27 はゾーン中心付近の白い点 (岩か浅瀬) から北西へ水色の流れが 1 km あまり尾を引き、07-17 も同じ点から北へ水色の帯が伸びる。2 回とも同じ源点で雲から離れている。
note_en: On 06-27 a light-blue flow trails a little over 1 km north-west from a white dot (rock or shoal) near the zone centre, and on 07-17 a light-blue band also extends north from the same dot. Both times from the same source point, away from cloud.

note_ja: ゾーン中心のすぐ近くに北東-南西に並ぶ白っぽい細い小斑 (0.34 km2、グリント注意)。グリントの残りか海面の筋の可能性が高いが、位置が山頂に重なるので一応見る。
note_en: Thin whitish small patches (0.34 km2, glint caution) lined up north-east to south-west right near the zone centre. Residual glint or sea-surface streaks are most likely, but as the position overlaps the summit, worth a look.

note_ja: 04-20・04-28 は Jadid 島北端の北東側に付く青緑の扇形の水で、2018 年・2021 年の同じ場所の候補と同じもの。島の浸食による濁りとみられるが島に付着して繰り返すので念のため。04-03・06-07 は北西の小島群の既知の浅瀬。
note_en: 04-20 and 04-28 are fan-shaped blue-green water attached to the north-east side of the north tip of Jadid Island, the same thing as the candidates at the same place in 2018 and 2021. Seen as turbid water from erosion of the island, but it is attached to the island and recurs, so flagged just in case. 04-03 and 06-07 are the known shoals of the islets to the north-west.

note_ja: 火口のすぐ北から北へ約 3 km 伸びる細長い緑の変色水の帯（1.36 km2）で、南端が火口位置に付いている。雲から離れており、高温画素 7 も出ている。Home Reef の 2016 年の活動として確認を。
note_en: A long, thin band of green discoloured water (1.36 km2) extending about 3 km north from just north of the vent, its south end attached to the vent position. Away from cloud, and 7 hot pixels also appear. Please check as Home Reef activity in 2016.

note_ja: 2 回の候補は強い光沢下の雲の縁と、11-17 の霞の中の色ずれしたまだらで、どちらも通常の原因で説明できる。ただし間の 11-07 (候補なし) に島の南西約1.5 kmで暗い縁取りのある淡い青の丸い斑が見え、小さな雲と影とも言い切れない。
note_en: The two candidates are a cloud edge under strong sheen and colour-shifted mottling in haze on 11-17, both explainable by usual causes. However, on 11-07 in between (no candidate), a pale blue round patch with a dark rim is visible about 1.5 km south-west of the island, and it cannot be said for sure to be a small cloud and its shadow.

note_ja: 2回とも Mánáreyjar の南の雲の間にターコイズの斑があり、位置が近い。SWIRでは薄い霞がかかり薄雲の可能性が高いが、同じ場所なので雲と断定しない。
note_en: Both times there is a turquoise patch between clouds south of Mánáreyjar, in close positions. In SWIR thin haze lies over it and thin cloud is most likely, but as it is in the same place I do not conclude that it is cloud.

note_ja: 2015年の島の南側に淡い水色の斑 (2.4 km2、輝き注意)。島の火口湾の開口部の明るい水色に続き、浸食による濁りか浅い台地が有力。平常図は 2022年以降の島の無い姿なので比べられない。
note_en: A faint light-blue patch south of the 2015 island (2.4 km2, glint caution). It continues from the bright light blue at the opening of the island's crater bay, and turbid water from erosion or a shallow platform is the strongest explanation. The normal view shows the state from 2022 onwards with no island, so they cannot be compared.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 03-19と04-04には同心円状の波が見える。05-15は海水変色の可能性もあるが色が悪く判然としない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Concentric waves are visible on 03-19 and 04-04. 05-15 may be discoloured water, but the colour is poor and it is not clear.

note_ja: 常時区分。火口付近のいつもの変色水。南の明るい点は南硫黄島。
note_en: "Persistent" class. The usual discoloured water near the vent. The bright point to the south is Minami-Ioto.

note_ja: 島の西に淡い青の斑。2015、2018、2021 にも同じく島の西に出ており、同じ場所に繰り返し出ている。
note_en: A pale blue patch west of the island. It also appeared west of the island in 2015, 2018 and 2021, recurring at the same place.

note_ja: 2015 年にできた Hunga の新島 (緑の火口湖が見える) の南岸に接して明るいシアンの水が帯状に出る。通常の見た目は 2022 年以降で島が無いため島と岸が拾われている。若いテフラ島の侵食の濁りの可能性が高いが、島自体が火口なので念のため。前の通過 (08-11) にも変色 1.29 km2。
note_en: Bright cyan water appears as a band touching the south shore of the new Hunga island formed in 2015 (a green crater lake is visible). The usual appearance is from 2022 onwards when the island no longer exists, so the island and its shore are picked up. Turbid water from erosion of the young tephra island is most likely, but as the island itself is a vent, to be safe. The previous pass (08-11) also has discolouration of 1.29 km2.

note_ja: 03-19 は雪をかぶった北の島を取り巻く岸沿いの白っぽい帯、03-29・04-03 は同じ島の南〜南東岸の沖の淡い斑で、03-24 は雲間。雪の島の明るさのにじみか岸の氷とみられるが、同じ島の南岸に繰り返し、03-29 に高温画素 2 があるので念のため。
note_en: On 03-19 a whitish band along the shore surrounding the snow-capped northern island; on 03-29 and 04-03 pale patches offshore of the south to south-east shore of the same island; 03-24 is between clouds. Looks like brightness bleeding from the snowy island or shore ice, but it recurs on the south shore of the same island and there are 2 hot pixels on 03-29, so just in case.

note_ja: 09-22・09-25・11-16 の緑の斑は小島の南南東、通常の見え方で水色の輪 (既知の浅瀬) の位置にあり浅瀬の色とみられる。09-12 は積雲の間の薄い斑。ただ Karua の山頂浅瀬で 09-22 に高温画素 2、11-16 は輪より少し広いので念のため。
note_en: The green patches on 09-22, 09-25 and 11-16 are south-south-east of the islet, at the position of the light-blue ring (known shoal) in the normal appearance, and look like the colour of the shoal. 09-12 is a faint patch between cumulus. However, this is the summit shoal of Karua, 09-22 has 2 hot pixels, and 11-16 is slightly wider than the ring, so just in case.

note_ja: 一面の積雲の隙間に小さな斑 0.16 km2 があるだけだが、熱画素が 343 と多い。画像では雲以外に何も見えず、熱画素が雲によるものか確かめたい。
note_en: There is only a small patch of 0.16 km2 in a gap in widespread cumulus, but there are many hot pixels (343). Nothing other than cloud is visible in the image, and I would like to confirm whether the hot pixels are due to cloud.

note_ja: 円の北東、中心から約 6 km に長さ 3 km ほどの緑の細長い筋が 1 本ある。雲から離れており、南半球の夏のトリコデスミウムの帯の可能性が高いが、噴出の流れとも区別できない。
note_en: In the north-east of the circle, about 6 km from the centre, there is a single long, thin green streak about 3 km long. Away from cloud; a Trichodesmium band in the southern-hemisphere summer is likely, but it cannot be distinguished from an eruptive outflow either.

note_ja: 島の北に小さな茶色の斑があり、区域に灰色の薄い霞が島を囲む弧状にかかる。島も通常より灰色がかって見える。たぶん薄雲だが、形が気になるので念のため。
note_en: There is a small brown patch north of the island, and a thin grey haze lies over the zone in an arc surrounding the island. The island also looks greyer than usual. Probably thin cloud, but the shape is a concern, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 円の中央に大きな積雲の塊が載り、その南東縁に黄緑がかった霞の広がり (幅 1 km ほど) があって、縁に浮遊物候補 0.17 km2 と茶色の小片が並ぶ。背の高い雲の縁の色ずれにしては幅が広く、雲に半ば隠れた変色水か噴気かを図から決められない。前 (07-01) と後 (07-06) には何もない。
note_en: A large cumulus mass sits in the middle of the circle, with a spread of yellow-greenish haze (about 1 km wide) along its south-east edge, and along that edge lie a 0.17 km2 floating matter candidate and small brown fragments. It is too wide for colour fringing at the edge of a tall cloud, and the figures cannot decide whether it is discoloured water half hidden by cloud or a fumarolic plume. Nothing before (07-01) or after (07-06).

note_ja: 域全体の海水が乳白の青緑に変わっている (sc)。2022-01-15 の Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai 大噴火の 2 日後で、その降灰が海に入ったものとみられ、この火山自体の活動ではない可能性が高い。前のパス 01-12 の海は普通の色。
note_en: The sea water over the whole zone has turned milky blue-green (sc). It is two days after the major 2022-01-15 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai eruption and looks like its ashfall entering the sea; most likely not activity of this volcano itself. On the previous pass, 01-12, the sea has its normal colour.

note_ja: McDonald 島の東側に乳白の青緑の水が島から流れ出す形で広がり (15.7 km2、5 日後も 9.5 km2)、普段の浅瀬の枠より大きい。雪氷の流出や浅瀬の濁りの可能性もあるが、活火山の島を起点にした変色水に見える。
note_en: Milky blue-green water spreads on the east side of McDonald Island in a shape flowing out from the island (15.7 km2, still 9.5 km2 five days later), larger than the usual shoal outline. It could be snow and ice runoff or turbid water on the shoal, but it looks like discoloured water originating at the active volcanic island.

note_ja: 島のすぐ脇に青緑の変色水。OLCI の 2 機に連日出る。高解像度の 1 回目の調査では島の周りのいつもの変色とした区域。
note_en: Blue-green discoloured water right beside the island. It appears on both OLCI satellites on consecutive days. In the first high-resolution survey this zone was judged to have the usual discolouration around the island.

note_ja: 05-17 は円の東半分を覆う薄い霞の下の明るい水 (5.6 km2)、05-19 は積雲の間の小片で、どちらも雲の縁の明るい水に見える。ただ熱画素が 05-17 に 5、05-19 に 100 あり、雲の中か判別できないので念のため。後の 05-22 は薄い筋雲だけ。
note_en: 05-17 is bright water (5.6 km2) under thin haze covering the eastern half of the circle, and 05-19 is a small fragment between cumulus; both look like bright water at cloud edges. However, there are hot pixels, 5 on 05-17 and 100 on 05-19, and whether they are within the cloud cannot be distinguished, so to be safe. The later 05-22 has only thin streaky cloud.

note_ja: 福徳岡ノ場の区域中心の南東に淡い緑白色の筋があり、06-17 の通過でも候補が出ている。2021 年噴火後の変色水の続きの可能性があるが、雲の近くで淡い。
note_en: A pale greenish-white streak south-east of the zone centre of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, and a candidate also appears on the 06-17 pass. It may be continued discoloured water after the 2021 eruption, but it is near cloud and faint.

note_ja: 3 回とも候補は西の雪氷に覆われた島 (SWIR で青) の岸に接する青緑の水で、雲の切れ間にある。氷河の融け水か岸の砕氷の可能性が高いが、04-13 11:21 に熱異常 5 px があり位置は図から読めないので確認を。
note_en: All three times the candidate is blue-green water touching the shore of the snow- and ice-covered island to the west (blue in SWIR), in gaps in the cloud. Glacial meltwater or broken ice along the shore is most likely, but on 04-13 11:21 there is a 5 px thermal anomaly whose position cannot be read from the figure, so please check.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島から青緑の濁りが南東へ渦を巻いて広がり (10-01 に 12.23 km2)、10-09 も島の周りと北東に同色の帯が残る。前後の通過にも島起点の濁りがあり、侵食による懸濁の可能性が高いが熱水由来を否定できない。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water swirls and spreads south-east from Bogoslof Island (12.23 km2 on 10-01), and on 10-09 too bands of the same colour remain around the island and to the north-east. The earlier and later passes also have turbid water originating at the island; suspended matter from erosion is most likely, but a hydrothermal origin cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 山頂の北東に緑の変色水 6.9 km2。前後の 10-01・10-11 にも同じ色の斑と帯が出ている。Kavachi は 2025-11 から 2026-11 まで断続的に変色水を出している (候補が出た回: 2025-11-20〜12-27 の各回、2026-02 に小さく、05-09〜05-29 に約 1 km2、07-05 に 6.8 km2、09-21 以降は 11-10 までほぼ毎回)。頻発区域 (frequent) の継続中の活動。
note_en: Green discoloured water of 6.9 km2 north-east of the summit. The passes before and after, 10-01 and 10-11, also show patches and bands of the same colour. Kavachi released discoloured water intermittently from 2025-11 to 2026-11 (passes with a candidate: every pass from 2025-11-20 to 12-27, a small one in 2026-02, about 1 km2 from 05-09 to 05-29, 6.8 km2 on 07-05, and almost every pass from 09-21 to 11-10). Ongoing activity of a zone of the frequent class.

note_ja: マウグのカルデラ湾の中に淡い斑がある（区域中心から 0.3 km）。2022-10-10 にもほぼ同じ位置に斑があり、湾内の熱水の可能性がある。
note_en: There is a pale patch inside the Maug caldera bay (0.3 km from the zone centre). There was also a patch in almost the same position on 2022-10-10, and it may be hydrothermal water in the bay.

note_ja: Panarea 島の南東岸から数百 m 沖に海岸と平行な細い青緑の帯で、2019-01-03 とほぼ同じ位置・形。雲はなく、浅い海底の帯の可能性が高いが、繰り返す位置なので確認したい。
note_en: A thin blue-green band parallel to the coast a few hundred m off the south-east shore of Panarea, in almost the same position and shape as on 2019-01-03. No cloud; a band on the shallow sea floor is likely, but the position recurs, so I would like to check.

note_ja: Jadid 島の周りと北側に付く青緑の濁りが 4 回とも同じ位置にあり、前後のパスにも見える。2013 年の新島の浸食か浅い台地の色とみられるが、火口島に付着して繰り返すので念のため。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water around and north of Jadid Island is at the same position all 4 times, and is also visible on the passes before and after. Looks like erosion of the 2013 new island or the colour of the shallow platform, but it recurs attached to a vent island, so just in case.

note_ja: 晴れた海面の円の南東端 (中心から 4.9 km) に、縁の柔らかい青緑の斑がいくつも集まり、円外の南東へ続く。通常の見え方には何もなく、雲とも離れている。起点は円外にあるらしく、近くの火山 (Kavachi など) からの変色水かブルームか確認したい。
note_en: At the south-east end of the circle on a clear sea (4.9 km from the centre), many soft-edged blue-green patches cluster and continue south-east outside the circle. There is nothing in the usual appearance, and it is away from cloud. The origin seems to be outside the circle, and I would like to check whether it is discoloured water from a nearby volcano (such as Kavachi) or a bloom.

note_ja: 05-23 は 2015 年の新島の東に青緑の渦巻く濁りが 15.9 km2 広がり、島の岸から出ている。若い火砕丘の浸食による濁りが最も考えやすいが、大きいので念のため。06-12 は雲の切れ間の小さな斑。
note_en: On 05-23, blue-green swirling turbid water spreads over 15.9 km2 east of the 2015 new island, coming from the island's shore. Turbid water from erosion of the young pyroclastic cone is the most plausible, but it is large, so just in case. 06-12 is a small patch in a gap in the cloud.

note_ja: 区域北部のグリントの縞の中の淡い斑で、火口の位置には変色が見えない。
note_en: A pale patch among the streaks of glint in the north of the zone; no discoloured water is visible at the position of the vent.

note_ja: 中心から 0.7〜1.7 km に緑〜青緑の斑と、そこから南東へ伸びる帯状の変色水が 5〜10 月に繰り返し出ている (後のパス 05-15 にも緑斑)。雲から離れて点源から流れており、East Epi 海底火口の変色水に見える。
note_en: Green to blue-green patches 0.7-1.7 km from the centre, and band-shaped discoloured water extending south-east from them, appear repeatedly from May to October (a green patch also on the later pass 05-15). Flowing from a point source away from cloud, it looks like discoloured water from the East Epi submarine vent.

note_ja: East Epi B (Cioan) の中心から 2.25 km の外洋に淡い緑の細長い斑 (0.09 km2) が 1 つ、雲から離れてある。小さく淡いが、2004 年・2023 年に噴火した火口の近くなので確かめたい。
note_en: A single pale green elongated patch (0.09 km2) in the open sea 2.25 km from the centre of East Epi B (Cioan), away from cloud. It is small and pale, but as it is near the vent that erupted in 2004 and 2023 I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 04-10以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 04-10. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 03-26 は島が雪に覆われ、湾内の東岸寄りに大きな候補と熱異常画素 11 があるが、真色では湾の水は一様に黒く変色は見えない。雪の多い場面での誤検出か薄氷の可能性が高いが、熱異常の位置がわからないため確認したい。04-10 は雲の縁の小片。
note_en: On 03-26 the island is snow-covered, and there is a large candidate and 11 thermal anomaly pixels near the east shore of the bay, but in true colour the bay water is uniformly black and no discolouration is visible. Most likely a false detection in a snowy scene or thin ice, but the location of the thermal anomaly is unknown, so I would like it checked. 04-10 is a small fragment at a cloud edge.

note_ja: 1回目は島の南西岸 (デナム湾付近) に鋭い縁の水色の斑、上に雲がかかり薄雲の可能性が高い。2回目は島の北の淡い斑で風影らしいが、水色の斑を念のため確認。
note_en: The first is a sharp-edged light-blue patch on the south-west shore of the island (near Denham Bay) with cloud over it, most likely thin cloud. The second is a pale patch north of the island that looks like wind shadow, but I would like the light-blue patch checked to be safe.

note_ja: 強いグリントの場面で、グリント除去後の海がほぼ黒く、島の西の候補(0.92 km2)に何が写っているか見えない。夏の砂塵の霞とグリント残りの可能性が高いが、北の小島の縁にも候補が付いており、画像からは判断できない。
note_en: A scene with strong sun glint; after glint removal the sea is almost black and what is in the candidate west of the island (0.92 km2) cannot be seen. Summer dust haze and residual glint are likely, but a candidate is also attached to the edge of the small northern island, and it cannot be judged from the image.

note_ja: ラウル島の西 (デナム湾沖) に淡い青白の広い斑。岸沿いには水色の浅い縁があり、島の風下の凪の可能性が高いが、熱水の変色水が出る側でもある。
note_en: A wide, faint bluish-white patch west of Raoul Island (off Denham Bay). Along the shore there is a light-blue shallow fringe, and calm water in the lee of the island is likely, but it is also the side where hydrothermal discoloured water comes out.

note_ja: ラウル島の西岸 (デナム湾) の岸沿いの水色の水。薄雲のもやに覆われており、浅瀬の色の可能性が高いが、2016 年などにも同じ西側に出ている。
note_en: Light-blue water along the west shore of Raoul Island (Denham Bay). It is covered by a haze of thin cloud and the colour of the shoal is likely, but it has also appeared on the same west side in 2016 and other years.

note_ja: 乳白色の青緑の水が渦を巻いて円の大半と外側まで広がり、02-19 から 03-08 の 4 回とも見える。源点はなく植物プランクトンか懸濁物らしいが、冬季で季節外れなため念のため確認したい。
note_en: Milky blue-green water swirls and spreads over most of the circle and beyond, visible all 4 times from 02-19 to 03-08. There is no source point and it seems to be phytoplankton or suspended matter, but as it is winter and out of season I would like it checked to be safe.

note_ja: McDonald 島の北西のすぐ脇から南へ伸びる幅の狭い濃い白い噴煙状の帯があり、SWIR では紫がかった筋に見える。候補はその東の島の南の淡い斑（14.57 km2）。島の後流の雲の可能性もあるが、活火山の島から出る水蒸気の可能性を否定できない。
note_en: A narrow, dense white plume-like band extends south from just beside the north-west of McDonald Island, appearing as a purplish streak in SWIR. The candidate is the faint patch to the east of it, south of the island (14.57 km2). It could be cloud in the island's wake, but water vapour coming from the active volcanic island cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: ゾーン北西部の開水面に緑の小斑 (0.09 km2) があり、南西へ淡い緑の暈が伸びる。すぐ北に小さな積雲があり、プランクトンの斑の可能性もあるが、同じ年の 08-18 にも同じゾーンで緑の小斑が出ている。
note_en: A small green patch (0.09 km2) in open water in the north-west of the zone, with a pale green halo extending south-west. There is a small cumulus just to the north, and it may be a plankton patch, but a small green patch also appeared in the same zone on 08-18 of the same year.

note_ja: 01-28 は北の小島の間の浅い水路に沿う緑の帯、02-02 は中央の若い島の北岸から北西へ伸びる青緑の舌、02-19 は北の小島の際の緑の斑 (雲の縁)。どれも島の浅い台地の際で前後の通過にも暈が写り、浅瀬と侵食の濁りの可能性が高いが、既知浅瀬の輪郭の外に出る。
note_en: 01-28 is a green band along a shallow channel between the northern islets, 02-02 a blue-green tongue extending north-west from the north shore of the young central island, and 02-19 a green patch at the edge of a northern islet (cloud edge). All are at the edge of the islands' shallow platform and the halo is also seen on the passes before and after; most likely shoal and erosion turbidity, but they extend outside the outline of the known shoal.

note_ja: 2015年にできた島の南岸に接する水色の帯が 9-12 月の毎回同じ位置に出る。平常像は島の消えた 2022 年以降なので、島の浅い台地か侵食による懸濁を拾っている見込みが高いが、08-26 の 9.4 km2 は島から南へ広がる淡い面で台地だけでは説明しきれない。
note_en: A light-blue band adjoining the south shore of the island formed in 2015 appears at the same position every time from September to December. The normal image is from 2022 onwards, after the island had gone, so it is likely picking up the island's shallow platform or suspended sediment from erosion, but the 9.4 km2 on 08-26 is a faint surface spreading south from the island that the platform alone cannot fully explain.

note_ja: Landsat の場面で、円の南半分を覆う広い薄紫の明るい面の北縁に白っぽい斑が散らばる。SWIR では暗く、点源も色も無いので薄いもやかグリントの名残とみられるが、普段の様子が無く比べられないので念のため。
note_en: In a Landsat scene, whitish patches are scattered along the north edge of a wide, pale purple bright surface covering the southern half of the circle. Dark in SWIR, with no point source and no colour, so seen as thin haze or residual glint, but there is no usual appearance to compare with, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: マウグ諸島のカルデラ内の水面に淡い斑。2023-09 にも同じカルデラ内に候補が出ており、静かな深い水の見え方の可能性が高いが、同じ場所に繰り返している。
note_en: A pale patch on the water inside the caldera of the Maug Islands. A candidate also appeared inside the same caldera in 2023-09; most likely the appearance of calm deep water, but it recurs at the same place.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 10-28,30以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 10-28 and 10-30.

note_ja: 高根礁の北側に色のない淡い斑がまだらに広がり、同日の明神礁カルデラ全体の区域と同じもの。海面の粗さか霞とみられるが念のため。
note_en: A colourless faint patch spreads in mottles on the north side of Takane-sho, the same thing as in the zone covering the whole Myojinsho caldera on the same day. Seen as sea-surface roughness or haze, but flagged just in case.

note_ja: Maug のカルデラ内の水面が暗い青で候補になり、後の回 (04-28) でもカルデラ内と西側が暗い。2014・2016 と同じ場所なので、湾内のグリント差か熱水かまとめて確かめたい。
note_en: The water inside the Maug caldera is dark blue and became a candidate, and on the later pass (04-28) the inside of the caldera and the west side are also dark. It is the same place as in 2014 and 2016, so I would like to check together whether it is a difference in glint within the bay or hydrothermal.

note_ja: 雪をかぶった北の島の南岸に沿って、雲の間に明るい灰青色の帯が東西に延びる。島の風下の凪や薄い海氷の可能性が高いが、色の違う帯が島に接するので念のため。
note_en: Along the south shore of the snow-capped northern island, a bright grey-blue band extends east-west between clouds. Calm water in the lee of the island or thin sea ice is likely, but a band of a different colour touches the island, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: パナレア島東の小岩礁群 (2002 年のガス噴出域) の付近に色のない淡い面があり、東側の暗い水と境を作る。雲の近くの霞の可能性が高いが位置が噴気域に重なる。
note_en: A colourless pale surface near the group of small reefs east of Panarea (the 2002 gas emission area), forming a boundary with the dark water to the east. Haze near the cloud is most likely, but the position overlaps the fumarolic area.

note_ja: Maug カルデラ内の西寄りに淡い灰色の斑。2017年3月にもカルデラ中央に斑があり、同じカルデラ内で繰り返す。
note_en: A pale grey patch in the western part of the Maug caldera. In March 2017 there was also a patch in the middle of the caldera; it recurs in the same caldera.

note_ja: Epi 島北東沖のゾーン中心付近に小さな緑の斑 (0.12〜0.19 km2) が 12-12・12-30・01-06 と 3 回出て、短い緑の尾を引く。雲から離れ、参照画像には無く、12-15 の後の画像にも同じ付近に淡い緑の点がある。
note_en: A small green patch (0.12-0.19 km2) near the zone centre off the north-east of Epi Island appears 3 times, on 12-12, 12-30 and 01-06, trailing a short green tail. Away from cloud, not in the reference image, and on the later image of 12-15 there is also a faint green dot near the same place.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 04-23のカルデラ内半島の西に、暗い緑色の円形のパッチがみられ、島のような形をしている。前後の画像にはなく、短波長赤外だと雲のような色になっているため、火山性の可能性は低いと考えられる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: On 04-23 a dark green round patch, shaped like an island, lies west of the peninsula inside the caldera. It is absent on the images before and after, and in the short-wave infrared it has the colour of cloud, so volcanic origin is thought unlikely.

note_ja: 雪に覆われたカルデラ湾の中にわずかに明るい水の斑（2.3 km2）が 1 回。周りに雲が多く霞の可能性が高いが、湾の中の斑なので念のため。
note_en: A slightly bright patch of water (2.3 km2) inside the snow-covered caldera bay, once. There is a lot of cloud around and haze is likely, but it is a patch inside the bay, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 06-04 は島の風下の陽光反射と風陰の白い面で説明できるが、06-20 に島の東脇に細い灰色の帯 (ap、0.43 km2) が島に沿って一本ある。薄い雲の筋か砕波と思われるが確かめたい。
note_en: 06-04 can be explained by sunlight reflection downwind of the island and a white wind-shadow surface, but on 06-20 there is a single thin grey band (ap, 0.43 km2) along the east side of the island. It is thought to be a thin cloud streak or breaking waves, but I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 円の東の小島 (Laika 島) の東側に南北に延びる明るい灰青色の帯があり、島に接する。島の風下の凪か薄雲の見込みが高い。高温画素 49 は同じ時刻の East Epi の通過でも雲の多い所で 199 と出ており、雲由来とみる。
note_en: On the east side of the islet east of the circle (Laika Island), a bright grey-blue band runs north-south, touching the island. Most likely a calm downwind of the island or thin cloud. The 49 hot pixels are read as cloud-derived, since the East Epi pass at the same time also showed 199 in cloudy areas.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-22以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 07-22. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: 区域中心の北西約 1.4 km、積雲の間に細長い明るい青緑の筋がある。雲に近いが、11-06 の通過にも区域中央に青緑の小斑があり、浅瀬か噴火前の変色水の可能性がある。
note_en: About 1.4 km north-west of the zone centre, between cumulus, there is an elongated bright blue-green streak. It is close to cloud, but the 11-06 pass also has a small blue-green patch in the middle of the zone, so it may be a shoal or pre-eruption discoloured water.

note_ja: 区域の南東に小さな淡い斑が群れている。雲はなく湧出点もはっきりせず、白波や海面のむらの可能性が高い。
note_en: Small faint patches cluster in the south-east of the zone. No cloud and no clear source point; whitecaps or unevenness of the sea surface are likely.

note_ja: Simushir 島の Broutona 湾 (カルデラ湾) の内部に緑の細長い筋 (1.36 km2)。閉じた湾の植物プランクトンか泡の筋の可能性が高いが、参照画像がなく、2019 年にも同じ湾で候補が出ている。
note_en: A long, narrow green streak (1.36 km2) inside Broutona Bay (a caldera bay) on Simushir Island. Most likely phytoplankton or a foam streak in the enclosed bay, but there is no reference image, and a candidate also appeared in the same bay in 2019.

note_ja: 鮮やかな緑の変色水 6.8 km2 の東端に、直径約 0.5 km の環 (縁が明るく中が暗い) がある。噴出点の上の湧昇か噴出そのものとみられ、この 1 年の Kavachi で最も活発に見える回。快晴、短波長赤外では暗い。前の 07-03 は曇天、次の 08-07 には何も無い。Kavachi は 2025-11 から 2026-11 まで断続的に変色水を出している (候補が出た回: 2025-11-20〜12-27 の各回、2026-02 に小さく、05-09〜05-29 に約 1 km2、07-05 に 6.8 km2、09-21 以降は 11-10 までほぼ毎回)。頻発区域 (frequent) の継続中の活動。
note_en: At the eastern end of vivid green discoloured water of 6.8 km2 there is a ring about 0.5 km across (bright rim, dark centre). It appears to be upwelling above the vent or the eruption itself, and this is the pass on which Kavachi looks most active in this year. Clear sky, dark in SWIR. The pass before, 07-03, was overcast; the next, 08-07, shows nothing. Kavachi released discoloured water intermittently from 2025-11 to 2026-11 (passes with a candidate: every pass from 2025-11-20 to 12-27, a small one in 2026-02, about 1 km2 from 05-09 to 05-29, 6.8 km2 on 07-05, and almost every pass from 09-21 to 11-10). Ongoing activity of a zone of the frequent class.

note_ja: 快晴(clear 1.00)の回で、中心の南東約1.8 kmに小さな青緑の斑(0.16 km2)があり、そこから南南西へ淡い緑の筋が延びる。雲から離れ、SWIRには何も写らない。起点のある小さな変色水の形。
note_en: On a clear pass (clear 1.00), a small blue-green patch (0.16 km2) about 1.8 km south-east of the centre, with a pale green streak extending south-south-west from it. It is away from cloud, and nothing appears in SWIR. It has the shape of small discoloured water with a starting point.

note_ja: 雪の残る島のブロートン湾の内側の灰色の面が囲まれた。薄い海氷の可能性が高いが、2013-07-28 にも湾内が囲まれており確認したい。
note_en: A grey surface inside Broutona Bay on the island with lingering snow was outlined. Thin sea ice is likely, but the bay was also outlined on 2013-07-28, so I would like to check.

note_ja: マクドナルド島の周り一帯に水色の水が広がり、北西へも帯が伸びる。常時区分の区域で自分の履歴の閾値を越えており、岸の濁りか湧出か画像だけでは決められない。
note_en: Light-blue water spreads all around McDonald Island, with a band also extending north-west. This zone is in the "persistent" class (judged by its own history) and exceeds the threshold of its own history; whether it is shore turbid water or upwelling cannot be decided from the image alone.

note_ja: 冬季で島は雪に覆われ、12-10・12-30 の候補は雪の海岸に沿う細い帯（隣接効果）だが、01-17 は湾内北寄りの淡い斑。湾内は 04-09・04-14・雪の無い 07-11 にも拾われており、通常の見え方が無いため湾の水そのものの色か判断できない。
note_en: Winter, with the island under snow. The candidates on 12-10 and 12-30 are thin bands along the snowy coast (adjacency effect), but 01-17 is a pale patch in the northern part of the bay. The bay was also picked up on 04-09, 04-14 and the snow-free 07-11, and as there is no usual-appearance image it cannot be judged whether this is the colour of the bay water itself.

note_ja: 当時の Hunga 島 (2015 年の火砕丘と緑の火口湖が見える) の南に乳青色の濁りが渦を巻いて約 2 km 広がる (8.93 km2)、前の 09-30 にも島まわりに青緑。新しい火砕丘の侵食濁りの可能性が高いが、島から広がる面積が大きいので見る。
note_en: Milky blue turbid water swirls and spreads about 2 km south of the Hunga island of the time (the 2015 pyroclastic cone and green crater lake are visible) (8.93 km2), and the previous 09-30 also has blue-green around the island. Turbid water from erosion of the new pyroclastic cone is most likely, but the area spreading from the island is large, so worth a look.

note_ja: 区域南東に輪郭のはっきりした水色の斑（0.7 km2）が晴れた海に 1 回。雲から離れた色のついた水で、山頂の浅瀬の変色水か砕波の可能性があり確認したい。
note_en: A sharply outlined light-blue patch (0.7 km2) in the south-east of the zone, once, on a clear sea. Coloured water away from cloud; it may be discoloured water over the summit shoal or breaking waves, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: Kavachi 山頂付近から北東へ黄緑色の濃い変色水のプルームが広がる。前 (12-31) と後 (02-17) の回にも山頂から伸びる緑の筋があり、噴火活動とみられる。
note_en: A plume of dense yellow-green discoloured water spreads north-east from near the summit of Kavachi. The passes before (12-31) and after (02-17) also have green streaks extending from the summit; read as eruptive activity.

note_ja: 中心から 0.4 km の積雲の間にターコイズ〜緑の斑があり、候補の西に広がる。積雲の周りの霞の可能性もあるが、2018年12月の同ゾーンの緑の斑と近い位置で、雲と断定できない。
note_en: A turquoise to green patch between cumulus 0.4 km from the centre, spreading west of the candidate. It may be haze around the cumulus, but it is close to the position of the green patch in the same zone in December 2018, and cannot be called cloud with certainty.

note_ja: 候補はロウ島西岸沖の暗い斑だが、南東岸から南へ淡い白っぽい水も延びる (区域中心 Tuluman から 1.5 km)。同じ付近の淡い水は 2014-12・2017-08・2019-03・2024-03 にも出ている。
note_en: The candidate is a dark patch off the west shore of Lou Island, but pale whitish water also extends south from the south-east shore (1.5 km from the zone centre, Tuluman). Pale water near the same place also appeared in 2014-12, 2017-08, 2019-03 and 2024-03.

note_ja: 2019-20 年火口のすぐ近く (中心から 1.2 km) に緑の細長い斑が北西-南東に伸びる。前の通過 (2020-08-15) にも中心付近に同じ緑の斑が写っている。
note_en: A long, thin green patch running north-west to south-east right next to the 2019-20 vent (1.2 km from the centre). The same green patch near the centre is also captured on the previous pass (2020-08-15).

note_ja: 02-06 は島々の周りの既知の浅瀬。02-26 は Sholan 島のすぐ北 (中心から 0.14 km) の小さな緑の筋、03-05 は島の東の細い緑の筋で、どれも 0.1〜0.2 km2 と小さく浅い台地の色とみられるが、2011-12 年の噴火島に近いので念のため。
note_en: 02-06 is the known shoal around the islands. 02-26 is a small green streak just north of Sholan Island (0.14 km from the centre) and 03-05 a thin green streak east of the island; all are small, 0.1-0.2 km2, and look like the colour of the shallow platform, but they are close to the island of the 2011-12 eruption, so just in case.

note_ja: 中心から 1.5 km、雲の無い開けた海に小さな緑の斑があり、東西に淡い緑の筋がにじむ。浅瀬の枠は無く、East Epi の海底火口丘群の上にあたる。岸沿いの赤枠は Epi 島の浅い岸。
note_en: 1.5 km from the centre, in cloud-free open sea, a small green patch, with pale green streaks bleeding east-west. There is no shoal outline, and it lies over the East Epi submarine cone group. The red outline along the shore is the shallow coast of Epi Island.

note_ja: 中央の島群（Sholan・Jadid 付近）の浅い台地から青緑の筋が沖へ伸び、4 回とも島の縁が起点。若い火山砕屑物の島の侵食による濁りと見られるが、11 回続いているので念のため。
note_en: Blue-green streaks extend offshore from the shallow platform of the central island group (near Sholan and Jadid), starting at the island edges all 4 times. It appears to be turbid water from erosion of the young pyroclastic islands, but as it has continued 11 times, to be safe.

note_ja: 島の西に淡い青の斑があり、積雲の影と混じる。2015-08 と 2021-05 にも同じく島の西に斑が出ており、同じ場所に繰り返し出ている。
note_en: A faint blue patch west of the island, mixed with cumulus shadows. In 2015-08 and 2021-05 patches also appeared west of the island in the same way; it recurs at the same place.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 自動判定を目視で確認できた
note_en: 2026-11-14: The automatic detection could be confirmed by eye.

note_ja: ゾーン中心の北約1.6 kmに緑の斑があり、そこから北東へ淡い緑のプルームが長く伸びる。2017年8月の2回とほぼ同じ位置で、SWIRでは暗い。
note_en: A green patch about 1.6 km north of the zone centre, from which a faint green plume extends a long way north-east. Almost the same position as the two in August 2017, and dark in SWIR.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 白い点とそこから伸びる海水変色域が明瞭。船舶とも考えにくく火山活動である可能性が高い。
note_en: 2026-11-14: The white point and the area of discoloured water extending from it are clear. A ship is hard to imagine, and volcanic activity is likely.

note_ja: Raoul 島の西〜北西岸から青緑の水が沖へ舌状に広がり、普段の様子の浅瀬の枠 (北西端) よりずっと広い。岸から出ているので荒天後の濁りの可能性が高いが、1 回だけで前後は雲が多いので念のため。
note_en: Blue-green water spreads offshore in a tongue from the west to north-west coast of Raoul Island, much wider than the shoal frame (north-west tip) in the usual appearance. As it comes from the shore, turbid water after rough weather is most likely, but it is only one occurrence and the passes before and after are cloudy, so to be safe.

note_ja: グリントの強い場面で、中央の島々から北西へ広がりながら伸びる淡い灰褐色の帯 (13.73 km2) があり、島を起点にした尾にも見える。SWIR では見えず、霞か島の風下の凪ぎの模様の可能性が高いが、噴煙や変色水の帯も否定できない。北西から斜めに走る赤い直線は検出の筋。
note_en: In a scene with strong glint, a faint grey-brown band (13.73 km2) widens as it extends north-west from the central islands, and also looks like a tail starting at the islands. Not visible in SWIR; haze or a pattern of calm water in the lee of the islands is likely, but an eruption plume or a band of discoloured water cannot be ruled out. The red straight line running diagonally from the north-west is a detection streak.

note_ja: 中心の北西に緑の細長い変色水 (0.89 km2) が東西に伸び、雲から離れている。2021 年噴火後の福徳岡ノ場で常在する変色水の続きと見られる。
note_en: Elongated green discoloured water (0.89 km2) north-west of the centre, extending east-west, away from cloud. Read as continuation of the discoloured water that is always present at Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba after the 2021 eruption.

note_ja: 晴れた海の区域東部にまとまった淡い斑（1.7 km2）が 1 回。雑音か海面のスリックらしいが、雲から離れた単独の斑なので念のため。
note_en: A coherent pale patch (1.7 km2) in the eastern part of the zone on a clear sea, once. It seems to be noise or a sea-surface slick, but as it is an isolated patch away from cloud, to be safe.

note_ja: Kavachi 山頂の真上に円い緑色の変色水の斑 (6.8 km2) があり、前 (08-23) の回にも同じ位置にターコイズの斑、後の回にも淡い緑が残る。噴火活動とみられる。
note_en: A round patch of green discoloured water (6.8 km2) right over the summit of Kavachi; on the previous pass (08-23) there was a turquoise patch at the same position, and faint green remains on the later pass. Seen as eruptive activity.

note_ja: 04-14 は小島 (Laika) の南西に淡い緑の筋が尾を引き、その上に 0.16 km2 の青緑の候補が乗る。雲は無い開けた海面で、同じ 2018 年 2 月にも円の南西に緑の斑が出ている。03-27 の候補は南の雲の帯の縁の色の滲みと北からの薄雲の筋に沿う。
note_en: On 04-14 a pale green streak trails south-west of the islet (Laika), with a 0.16 km2 blue-green candidate sitting on it. It is open sea with no cloud, and in February 2018 too a green patch appeared in the south-west of the circle. The candidate on 03-27 follows colour bleeding at the edge of the band of cloud to the south and streaks of thin cloud from the north.

note_ja: リッター島の南端に接して濃い青の斑が南へ延びる。島の風下の静穏域に見えるが、次の通過(2017-03-07)も L3 なので確認したい。
note_en: A dark blue patch touching the south end of Ritter Island extends south. It looks like a calm area downwind of the island, but the next pass (2017-03-07) is also L3, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 強いサングリントの下で、ゾーン北縁から西へ約6 km の蛇行した緑〜ターコイズの細い筋があり、西端に明るい緑の塊がある。SWIRでは暗く浮遊軽石ではなく、Trichodesmium などのブルームの筋の可能性が高いが、1回だけで前後の比較ができない。
note_en: Under strong sun glint, there is a thin meandering green to turquoise streak running about 6 km west from the north edge of the zone, with a bright green mass at its west end. Dark in SWIR, so not floating pumice; a bloom streak such as Trichodesmium is likely, but it is only once and cannot be compared with before and after.

note_ja: 火口中心から 1.2 km (11-07) と 0.55 km (11-17) に、周囲の海と色の違う緑の小斑 (0.25 km2, 0.11 km2) が 10 日おいて 2 回出る。11-07 は南へ淡い緑の斑が点々と続き、11-17 は雲から離れた晴れた海面にある。
note_en: Small green patches of a colour different from the surrounding sea (0.25 km2, 0.11 km2) appear twice, 10 days apart, 1.2 km (11-07) and 0.55 km (11-17) from the vent centre. On 11-07 faint green patches continue in dots to the south, and on 11-17 it is on a clear sea surface away from cloud.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 01-28以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。たなびき方から島の真東、2つの岩礁の南が給源だと断定できる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 01-28. From the way it trails, the source can be identified with certainty: due east of the island, south of the two reefs.

note_ja: 島の南東岸に沿って礁の外側を南東へ帯状に伸びる淡い青緑の水(中心から0.4 km)。礁原からの濁りらしいが、火口近くで形が通常の浅瀬と一致しない。
note_en: Pale blue-green water extending as a band to the south-east outside the reef along the island's south-east shore (0.4 km from the centre). It seems to be turbid water from the reef flat, but it is near the vent and its shape does not match the usual shoal.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 12-16: 島近傍の海水変色と南西にたなびく白色噴煙がみられる。12-18は近傍の海水変色のみ。01-12は雲の合間に海水変色が見える。01-27は微かに海水変色のようなものがみえる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 12-16: discoloured water near the island and a white plume trailing south-west. 12-18: only the discoloured water near the island. 01-12: discoloured water visible between clouds. 01-27: something like faint discoloured water.

note_ja: ゾーン中心から約 1 km の同じ位置に、ターコイズ〜緑の変色水の斑が 6/24・7/12・9/2・10/7 と前後の 6/27・7/9 にも繰り返し出る。9/2 は一点から尾を引いて流れ、雲から離れている。
note_en: Turquoise to green patches of discoloured water recur at the same position about 1 km from the zone centre on 6/24, 7/12, 9/2 and 10/7, and on the neighbouring 6/27 and 7/9 too. On 9/2 it trails a tail flowing from one point, away from cloud.

note_ja: 島の東端の沖、礁の輪の近くに淡い斑。2017-01-25 にもほぼ同じ場所に出ており、礁か沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが繰り返すので確認したい。
note_en: A faint patch off the east end of the island, near the ring of the reef. It also appeared at almost the same place on 2017-01-25; reef or coastal turbid water is likely, but it recurs, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 03-24 に Panarea 東方の小島群付近から北東へ白っぽい斑（3.1 km²）が伸びる。南部に薄い巻雲の筋があり霞の可能性が高いが、2002 年のガス噴出域と重なる。03-14 は雲縁の小片。
note_en: On 03-24 a whitish patch (3.1 km²) extends north-east from near the islets east of Panarea. There are thin cirrus streaks in the south and haze is likely, but it overlaps the 2002 gas emission area. 03-14 is a small piece at a cloud edge.
2026-11-14: 05-06: discoloured water on the south-west side.

note_ja: 小島の南、通常の見え方で既知の浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) の位置に青緑の斑があり、周りに淡い暈が広がる。2021-02-09 と同じ位置・同じ見え方で、Karua の火口付近にあたる。
note_en: A blue-green patch south of the islet, at the position of the known shoal (cyan outline) in the usual appearance, with a faint halo spreading around it. Same position and same appearance as on 2021-02-09, and near the Karua vent.

note_ja: 10-16・10-26・11-05 の 3 回、中央の小島の南東、既知浅瀬（シアン）の脇に淡い緑〜青緑の斑が同じ位置で出る。雲から離れ縁はぼやけており、浅瀬の海底色か変色水かは判別できない（09-19 の 6.3 km² は雲間の誤検出）。
note_en: Three times, on 10-16, 10-26 and 11-05, faint green to blue-green patches appear at the same position south-east of the central islet, beside the known shoal (cyan). Away from cloud and with blurred edges; whether it is the sea-floor colour of the shoal or discoloured water cannot be determined (the 6.3 km² on 09-19 is a false detection between clouds).
2026-11-14: 09-21: discoloured water. 10-01: discoloured water.

note_ja: 中心の南約 3 km に青緑の細長い斑があり、小さな雲のそばだが雲そのものではない。源点ははっきりせず、2024-04-19 にも別の位置に似た青緑の水が出ている。
note_en: There is a long, narrow blue-green patch about 3 km south of the centre, beside a small cloud but not the cloud itself. The source point is not clear, and similar blue-green water also appeared in a different position on 2024-04-19.

note_ja: 03-28 は雲の縁の茶色の小片、04-04 は雲と霞の間の淡い斑で、どちらも雲による。04-12 はゾーン南東の薄茶色のもや状の面に浮遊物候補 3.28 km2 が散り、筋や帯の形はなく SWIR でも薄雲と同じ淡さなので、薄雲か霞の可能性が高い。2019 年に軽石筏を出した火山なので軽石は確かめたい。
note_en: 03-28 is a small brown piece at a cloud edge and 04-04 a faint patch between cloud and haze, both due to cloud. On 04-12 floating matter candidates of 3.28 km2 are scattered over a pale brown hazy surface in the south-east of the zone, with no streak or band shape and as faint as thin cloud in SWIR, so thin cloud or haze is likely. This volcano produced a pumice raft in 2019, so I would like pumice checked.

note_ja: ゾーン中心の開水面に緑の小斑 (0.21-0.26 km2) が 2 回とも同じ位置に出て、すぐ南に白い点がある。侵食で沈んだ Sholan 島の跡の浅瀬の可能性が高いが、通常の姿には出ていないので一度見る。
note_en: A small green patch (0.21-0.26 km2) appears in open water at the zone centre at the same position both times, with a white point just to the south. Most likely the shoal left where Sholan Island sank through erosion, but it does not appear in the normal appearance, so I will look once.
