note_ja: 区域の中心に 1〜10 km2 の変色水が繰り返し出る。高解像度の調査と同じ場所。
note_en: Discoloured water of 1-10 km2 appears repeatedly at the zone centre. Same place as in the high-resolution survey.

note_ja: 区域の中心に小さな変色水が繰り返し出る。高解像度の調査と同じ場所。
note_en: Small discoloured water appears repeatedly at the zone centre. Same place as in the high-resolution survey.

note_ja: 区域の北西寄り、小さな雲の脇に淡い緑の丸い斑 (1.2 km2) と南西にもう 1 つ。薄い雲か霞の可能性が高いが確かではない。
note_en: In the north-western part of the zone, beside a small cloud, there is a round pale green patch (1.2 km2) and another one to the south-west. Thin cloud or haze is most likely, but this is not certain.

note_ja: 画面が暗すぎて候補 (中心の西 3.6 km の東西に細い小片) の色が見えず、判断できない。域外の北には浮遊物の小さな候補も描かれており、2022 年 1 月の Hunga 噴火後の時期なので念のため。
note_en: The scene is too dark for the colour of the candidate (a thin east-west fragment 3.6 km west of the centre) to be seen, so it cannot be judged. A small floating-matter candidate is also drawn outside the zone to the north, and as this is the period after the January 2022 Hunga eruption, to be safe.

note_ja: マクドナルド島から東へ水色の帯が細長く伸び、島を起点にしている。常時区分の区域だが自分の履歴の閾値を越えた。周りは積雲が多い。
note_en: A light-blue band extends long and thin to the east from McDonald Island, starting at the island. The zone is in the "persistent" class, but this exceeded the threshold from its own history. There is a lot of cumulus around.

note_ja: Lateiki 2019-20 年火口の位置から緑〜青緑の帯が一点を起点に北へ (01-22)、さらに曲がりくねって北東へ (01-27) のび、SWIR では暗い。前後の 01-07・02-06 にも同じ起点の緑の筋があり、火口からの変色水と見られる。
note_en: A green to blue-green band starts from one point at the position of the Lateiki 2019-20 vent and extends north (01-22), then winds on to the north-east (01-27); it is dark in SWIR. The neighbouring 01-07 and 02-06 also have a green streak from the same starting point; read as discoloured water from the vent.

note_ja: 3月15日と4月11日に、群島中央の浅瀬を持つ島の縁から水色の帯 (2.2〜2.7 km2) が北西・北へ伸びる。若い火山島の浸食による濁りが有力だが、警報 19 回で同じ島に付く。6月の 2 回は表示が暗く、縁の散在と雲際の小片だけ。
note_en: On March 15 and April 11, light-blue bands (2.2-2.7 km2) extend north-west and north from the edge of the island with a shoal in the middle of the group. Turbid water from erosion of the young volcanic island is the strongest explanation, but there have been 19 alerts, all on the same island. The two in June are dark in the display, with only scattered bits along the edge and small pieces at a cloud edge.

note_ja: 4 回とも 2019 年の島の跡と見られる明るい青緑の点 (浅瀬) があり、05-27 はそこから南へ弧を描く緑の尾、06-01 は北東へ広がる緑の斑 (2.26 km2)、06-16 は北へ伸びる淡い尾、06-21 は点の周りの緑の暈。2019 年の噴火の 7 か月後も同じ点から変色水が出続けており、熱水か浅瀬の濁りかを確かめたい。
note_en: All 4 times there is a bright blue-green point (shoal) that looks like the remains of the 2019 island; on 05-27 a green tail arcs south from it, on 06-01 a green patch spreads north-east (2.26 km2), on 06-16 a pale tail extends north, and on 06-21 a green halo surrounds the point. Seven months after the 2019 eruption, discoloured water keeps coming from the same point; I would like to check whether it is hydrothermal or shoal turbidity.

note_ja: Kavachi山頂付近の一点から西〜北西へ流れる緑〜ターコイズの変色水が3回とも、前後の晴れた回にも写る。継続中の活動と見る。
note_en: Green to turquoise discoloured water flowing west to north-west from a single point near the summit of Kavachi appears all 3 times and on the clear passes before and after. I take it to be ongoing activity.

note_ja: 中心の既知の小さな浅瀬の近くに東西に細長い淡い青白い斑。グリントなし、雲から離れている。
note_en: A pale bluish-white patch elongated east-west near the small known shoal at the centre. No glint, away from cloud.

note_ja: ゾーン南西の隅に乳白色の青緑の水が入り込み、斑と筋になって北東へ広がる。ゾーン内に起点はなく、南西約 10 km の Kavachi から流れてきた変色水と見られる。
note_en: Milky blue-green water enters the south-west corner of the zone and spreads north-east as patches and streaks. There is no origin within the zone; seen as discoloured water that flowed from Kavachi, about 10 km to the south-west.

note_ja: 10-18 (2 回) と 10-23 に、北側の島の南東の風下に同じ形の淡いターコイズの斑が出る。通常の見た目でもこの島の周りに浅瀬の輪郭があり、島棚の色か島の侵食による濁りが流れに引かれたものの可能性が高い。11-07 は暗く処理された画像に赤い点が散らばるだけ。
note_en: On 10-18 (twice) and 10-23 a faint turquoise patch of the same shape appears downwind, south-east of the northern island. In the usual appearance too there is a shoal outline around this island, and the colour of the island shelf, or turbid water from erosion of the island drawn out by the current, is likely. 11-07 is only red dots scattered on a darkly processed image.

note_ja: 常時区分。島の脇のいつもの変色水。
note_en: "Persistent" class. The usual discoloured water beside the island.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 10-14以外は目視確認できない
note_en: 2026-11-14: Cannot be confirmed by eye except on 10-14.

note_ja: 02-14 は東を覆う霞と南の雲の縁の間の候補で雲による。02-17 は円の南西、通常の姿にも淡い緑の点がある位置の青緑の小斑 (0.15 km2) で、02-19 には小島の南東の既知浅瀬に濃い緑の点が見える。浅い頂部の見え方の可能性が高いが Karua の火口付近なので確認を。
note_en: 02-14 is a candidate between the haze covering the east and the edge of cloud to the south, due to cloud. 02-17 is a small blue-green patch (0.15 km2) in the south-west of the circle, at a position where the usual appearance also has a faint green dot, and on 02-19 a dark green dot is visible on the known shoal south-east of the islet. The appearance of the shallow summit is likely, but it is near the Karua vent, so please check.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 09-13 as well.

note_ja: 中心から約 1 km の位置に青緑の斑が南北に 2〜3 個並び、間を淡い筋がつなぐ。近くに小さな積雲はあるが色が緑で影の縁の茶色ではない。2020 年 4〜5 月にも同じゾーンで緑の斑と筋があった。
note_en: Two or three blue-green patches line up north-south about 1 km from the centre, joined by faint streaks. There is small cumulus nearby, but the colour is green, not the brown of shadow edges. In April-May 2020 there were also green patches and streaks in the same zone.

note_ja: 3/16 に Sholan 島の北約 1 km に緑がかった水色の斑と、島の北端から広がる淡い水色の扇。4/5 と前後の通過 (3/31) にも同じ位置に小さな緑の斑が見える。島の北側で繰り返す。
note_en: On 3/16, a greenish light-blue patch about 1 km north of Sholan Island and a pale light-blue fan spreading from the north tip of the island. A small green patch is also visible at the same position on 4/5 and on the neighbouring pass (3/31). It recurs on the north side of the island.

note_ja: 中央の若い島 (橙の縁) の北岸から北西へ伸びる青緑の舌が 4 回とも同じ位置に出て、既知浅瀬の輪郭の外へはみ出す (01-15 に 2.93 km2)。前後の通過にも同じ舌が写り、島の浅い台地と侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島の熱水による変色も否定できない。
note_en: A blue-green tongue extending north-west from the north shore of the young central island (orange outline) appears at the same position all 4 times and extends beyond the outline of the known shoal (2.93 km2 on 01-15). The same tongue appears on the passes before and after; most likely the island's shallow platform and erosion turbidity, but discolouration from the island's hydrothermal activity cannot be ruled out either.

note_ja: 中心から約 1 km の所に東西に長い小さな青緑の斑 (0.05 km2) が 1 つ。雲から離れていて船の航跡の形でもない。2019 年・2021 年にも山頂付近に小さな斑が出ている。
note_en: A single small blue-green patch (0.05 km2), elongated east-west, about 1 km from the centre. It is away from cloud and is not the shape of a ship wake. Small patches also appeared near the summit in 2019 and 2021.

note_ja: Port Foster の中と南東の湾口付近の外側に、岸に沿って青緑の水が広がる（9.4 km²）。夏季の融氷水の懸濁で説明できる可能性が高いが、通常の見え方が無く比較できない。
note_en: Blue-green water spreads along the shore inside Port Foster and outside near the south-east bay mouth (9.4 km²). Likely explained by suspended sediment in summer ice meltwater, but there is no usual appearance to compare with.
2026-11-14: 2025-11-20: clear discoloured water. Missed by the detection?

note_ja: ゾーン中心から0.7〜1.1 kmに青緑〜乳白色の変色水が4回とも同じ所に出て、7/20は一点から南西へ尾を引く。前後の通過にも見え、雲から離れSWIRで暗い。2019-20年火口の熱水性変色水とみられる。
note_en: Blue-green to milky discoloured water appears at the same place, 0.7-1.1 km from the zone centre, all 4 times, and on 7/20 trails a tail south-west from one point. It is also seen on the passes before and after, is away from cloud and is dark in SWIR. Looks like hydrothermal discoloured water from the 2019-20 vent.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 11-27および12-17にも旺盛な海水変色がみられる。01-31は深い微かな海水変色が南にたなびいているように見える。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Vigorous discoloured water is seen on 11-27 and 12-17 as well. On 01-31 deep, faint discoloured water seems to trail south.

note_ja: ゾーン中央付近に緑の小斑が 11-07 (0.24 km2、雲の脇だが南へ淡い緑の筋) と 11-17 (0.11 km2、雲のない開水面) に出る。2019-05 の緑の斑とほぼ同じ場所で、小さいが点状の変色の可能性があるので見る。
note_en: Small green patches near the middle of the zone on 11-07 (0.24 km2, beside cloud but with a pale green streak to the south) and 11-17 (0.11 km2, cloud-free open water). Almost the same place as the green patch in 2019-05; small, but it may be point-like discolouration, so I will look.

note_ja: Lateiki の浅瀬の白い点から青緑の尾が北西へ 1.5 km ほど伸びる。2018 年・2024 年と同じ形で、前後の通過にも同じ位置に青緑の点がある。南東の赤い斑は雲の影の縁。
note_en: A blue-green tail extends about 1.5 km north-west from the white dot of the Lateiki shoal. It has the same shape as in 2018 and 2024, and there is a blue-green dot in the same position on the earlier and later passes too. The red patch to the south-east is the edge of a cloud shadow.

note_ja: 03-16 は島の北岸の沖に、積雲の小塊の間で淡い灰青色の水域 (3.79 km2) が広がる。縁は柔らかく SWIR で特徴はなく、雲の周りの霞の可能性が高いが、岸に接する出所を否定できない。04-05 の浮遊物 0.10 km2 は南西の雲の縁の小片。
note_en: On 03-16 a pale grey-blue water area (3.79 km2) spreads between small cumulus masses off the north shore of the island. Its edges are soft and it has no features in SWIR; haze around cloud is most likely, but an origin touching the shore cannot be ruled out. The floating matter of 0.10 km2 on 04-05 is a small fragment at the edge of the cloud to the south-west.

note_ja: 05-20 にゾーン中心から 0.3 km の位置に緑の斑があり、そこから北東へ淡い緑の筋が数 km 伸びる。04-30 も中心の北東に小さな緑の斑と同じ向きの淡い筋がある。どちらも積雲のそばだが、色が緑で筋が続くので雲の縁だけとは言えない。
note_en: On 05-20 there is a green patch 0.3 km from the zone centre, from which a pale green streak extends several km to the north-east. 04-30 also has a small green patch north-east of the centre and a pale streak in the same direction. Both are beside cumulus, but as the colour is green and the streaks continue, they cannot be said to be only cloud edges.

note_ja: 候補は Tongoa 北岸の礁縁と画像端 (03-04, 05-05)、雲の縁 (03-06)、Laika 南東の既知の浅瀬 (cyan) の上の小さな青緑斑 (03-16)。いずれも礁・浅瀬で説明できそうだが、Karua の浅瀬そのものなので一度見てほしい。
note_en: The candidates are the reef edge on the north shore of Tongoa and the image edge (03-04, 05-05), a cloud edge (03-06), and a small blue-green patch on the known shoal (cyan) south-east of Laika (03-16). All seem explainable by reef and shoal, but it is the Karua shoal itself, so please take a look once.

note_ja: 中央の小島 (Sholan) の北端から南東へ伸びる緑の縁取りが 51 回出る。前後の通常の通過でも同じ青緑の暈があり、若いテフラ島の浅い台地か侵食の濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口なので熱水由来を否定しきれない。
note_en: A green fringe extending south-east from the north tip of the small central island (Sholan) appears 51 times. The same blue-green halo is present on the usual passes before and after; a shallow platform of the young tephra island or turbid water from erosion is likely, but the island itself is the vent, so a hydrothermal origin cannot be fully ruled out.

note_ja: 区域北西から南の海岸沿いに乳白色がかった青緑の水が広く渦を巻いて広がる。湧出点は見えず植物プランクトンのブルームか沿岸の濁りとみられるが、49 km2 と広く色があるため確認したい。
note_en: Milky blue-green water spreads widely in swirls along the coast from the north-west of the zone to the south. No source point is visible and it appears to be a phytoplankton bloom or coastal turbid water, but as it is large (49 km2) and coloured, I would like it checked.

note_ja: Jadid 島の東端の砂嘴から乳白〜青緑の水が北東へ扇形に広がるのが 03-12・03-25・04-11 と同じ位置に続く。2013 年の新島の浸食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島を源とする流れなので念のため。04-24 は北西の小島の周りの浅瀬。
note_en: Milky to blue-green water spreading north-east in a fan from the spit at the east end of Jadid Island continues in the same position on 03-12, 03-25 and 04-11. Turbid water from erosion of the 2013 new island is most likely, but as it is a flow with the island as its source, to be safe. 04-24 is the shoal around the small island to the north-west.

note_ja: 白い候補はどの回も薄い霧や筋状の雲の下で、07-14 は南東寄りに筋が並ぶ。位置は毎回ゾーン東側の海岸寄りに偏るため雲と断定しきれない。
note_en: The white candidates are under thin fog or streaky cloud every time; on 07-14 streaks line up towards the south-east. Their position is biased towards the coast on the east side of the zone every time, so cloud cannot be stated with certainty.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 06-18: 深い微かな海水変色が、中心から北にたなびき、途中で東に向きを変えている。06-21: 明瞭な海水変色があるが面積は小さい。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 06-18: deep, faint discoloured water trails north from the centre and turns east on the way. 06-21: clear discoloured water, but of small area.

note_ja: ラウル島西岸の Denham 湾に水色の水が出る (cyan 分類)。2017-08・09 と同じ位置で、浅い台地や岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、繰り返し出るので一度まとめて見たい。
note_en: Light-blue water appears in Denham Bay on the west coast of Raoul Island (cyan class). It is in the same position as in 2017-08 and 09, and a shallow platform or shore turbid water is most likely, but as it appears repeatedly I would like to look at them all together once.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 少なくともサークル外から流れてきている海水変色である。
note_en: 2026-11-14: At the least, this is discoloured water that has drifted in from outside the circle.

note_ja: パナレア島の南東岸から沖へ、わずかに明るい青の水が約 2 km 広がる。2024-09 の 2 回の通過にも島の南〜南東の同じ所に淡い水があり、風下の静穏域とみられるが繰り返すため確認したい。
note_en: Slightly bright blue water spreads about 2 km offshore from the south-east shore of Panarea. On two passes in 2024-09 there was also faint water at the same place south to south-east of the island; seen as calm water in the lee, but it recurs, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 雪に覆われたカルデラ湾の南岸沿いに白っぽい筋。2014-10-08 にもほぼ同じ南岸の場所に緑がかった斑が出ており、岸の浅い棚か雪解け水の可能性が高いが確認したい。
note_en: A whitish streak along the south shore of the snow-covered caldera bay. On 2014-10-08 a greenish patch also appeared at almost the same place on the south shore; a shallow shelf at the shore or snowmelt water is likely, but I would like to check.

note_ja: Landsat 8。厚い雲に囲まれた晴れ間の薄く霞んだ水に色の無い候補があり、熱異常画素が 94 と多い。雲縁に緑黄の色ずれが目立つのでその誤検出の可能性が高いが、熱異常の位置を確かめたい。
note_en: Landsat 8. A colourless candidate in thinly hazy water in a clear patch surrounded by thick cloud, with as many as 94 thermal anomaly pixels. Green-yellow colour fringing at the cloud edges is prominent, so most likely a false detection from that, but I would like the position of the thermal anomaly checked.

note_ja: 島の北東に開いたカルデラ湾の中に小さな緑の斑 (0.11 km2) がある。湾の水は暗い緑のまだらで、通常の見え方の参照がなく、浅瀬か湾内の濁りか判断できない。
note_en: There is a small green patch (0.11 km2) in the caldera bay that opens to the north-east of the island. The bay water is mottled dark green and there is no reference for the usual appearance, so it cannot be judged whether it is a shoal or turbid water in the bay.

note_ja: ロウ島南の小島付近から南東へ淡い白っぽい水が広がり、区域中心 (Tuluman) から 1 km。北は雲の帯に接しグリント注意だが、同じ付近で 2017-08・2019-03 にも淡い水が出ている。
note_en: Faint whitish water spreads south-east from near the small island south of Lou Island, 1 km from the zone centre (Tuluman). To the north it touches a band of cloud and glint needs caution, but faint water also appeared near the same place in 2017-08 and 2019-03.

note_ja: 中心の北北西 2.2 km に淡い緑の弧状の筋 0.4 km2 (グリント注意)。前の 04-15 にも中心付近に淡い緑の斑が見える。福徳岡ノ場でふだんから見える弱い変色の範囲内とみられ、大きさや色の変化は無い。
note_en: A pale green arc-shaped streak of 0.4 km2, 2.2 km north-north-west of the centre (glint caution). The pass before, 04-15, also shows a pale green patch near the centre. It appears to be within the range of the weak discolouration usually seen at Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba; there is no change in size or colour.

note_ja: この通過の候補は光沢と積雲の間の白い斑で色ははっきりしない。ただし前の 8/15 に中央の水色の円い斑、後の 9/08 に南西へ水色の帯があり、活動期の通過として見直す価値がある。
note_en: The candidate on this pass is a white patch between sheen and cumulus, with no clear colour. However, on the previous 8/15 there is a round light-blue patch at the centre and on the later 9/08 a light-blue band to the south-west, so it is worth reviewing as a pass during an active period.

note_ja: 08-16 は太陽光反射の中の積雲の影の間の明るい海面で、色や湧出点はない。ただし 08-09 (sc) の通過は区域全体が緑がかり中央に紫に写る明るい物体があり、雲の描画とみられるが帯として示されていないので確認したい。
note_en: 08-16 is a bright sea surface between cumulus shadows within sun glint, with no colour and no source point. However, on the 08-09 (sc) pass the whole zone is greenish with a bright object rendered purple in the centre; it looks like a cloud rendering, but it is not flagged as a band, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: カルデラ中心の南 3.5 km に縁のぼやけた青緑の斑があり、南東へ細い青緑の筋が数 km 伸びる (SWIR では暗く浮遊物ではない)。後の通過 (11-29) の北縁にも緑の斑が見える。北縁の赤い線は画像端の直線。
note_en: A blue-green patch with blurred edges 3.5 km south of the caldera centre, with a thin blue-green streak extending several km to the south-east (dark in SWIR, so not floating matter). A green patch is also visible on the northern edge on the later pass (11-29). The red line on the northern edge is a straight line at the image edge.

note_ja: カルデラ中央の北側に色のない淡い斑がまだらに広がる (同日の高根礁の区域でも候補)。海面の粗さの斑か薄い霞とみられるが、明神礁なので念のため。
note_en: Colourless pale patches spread in a mottle on the north side of the middle of the caldera (also a candidate in the Takane-sho zone on the same day). Looks like patches of sea-surface roughness or thin haze, but this is Myojinsho, so just in case.

note_ja: 01-02 は円の南西、通常の姿にも淡い緑の点がある位置に緑の斑と暈 (0.39 km2)、02-01 は小島の南東の既知浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) の位置に緑の斑と暈 (0.20 km2)。01-22 は Tongoa 島の北岸の礁縁に沿う帯で、熱異常 13 px の位置は図から読めない。浅い頂部の見え方の可能性が高いが Karua の火口付近なので確認を。
note_en: 01-02 is a green patch with a halo (0.39 km2) in the south-west of the circle, at a position where the usual appearance also has a faint green dot; 02-01 is a green patch with a halo (0.20 km2) at the position of the known shoal (cyan outline) south-east of the islet. 01-22 is a band along the reef edge on the north shore of Tongoa Island, and the position of the 13 px thermal anomaly cannot be read from the figure. The appearance of the shallow summit is likely, but it is near the Karua vent, so please check.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた島の南東沖に大きな入り組んだ候補があるが、島の外の海が黒く写り何があるか見えない。春先の海氷・氷片か雪の明るさの回り込みの可能性が高いが、画像からは判断できない。
note_en: There is a large, intricate candidate off the south-east of the snow-covered island, but the sea outside the island appears black and what is there cannot be seen. Early-spring sea ice or ice fragments, or spill-over of the snow's brightness, is most likely, but it cannot be judged from the image.

note_ja: 島から西へ伸びる淡い帯(14 km2)が中心近くにかかる。島の風下の凪とみられるが、変色水の多い区域なので念のため。
note_en: A pale band (14 km2) extending west from the island reaches near the centre. It appears to be calm water downwind of the island, but as this zone has much discoloured water, to be safe.

note_ja: 候補は雪氷に覆われた中央の島の東岸に接する青緑の水と岸の褐色の岩の脇で、島の上は厚い雲。後の 03-25 には島を囲んで青緑の水が広く写る。氷河の融け水の濁りか砕氷の可能性が高いが、火山島の岸から出る色のある水なので確認を。
note_en: The candidate is blue-green water touching the east shore of the snow- and ice-covered central island and beside brown rock on the shore, with thick cloud over the island. The later 03-25 shows blue-green water widely surrounding the island. Most likely glacial meltwater turbidity or brash ice, but it is coloured water coming from the shore of a volcanic island, so please check.

note_ja: 候補は雲の黒い影の縁に沿う茶色の帯で影の縁と見られるが、火口付近の上空に灰色のもやが北東へ薄く広がって見える。2022-09 の噴火前の時期なので念のため。
note_en: The candidate is a brown band along the edge of a black cloud shadow and appears to be the shadow edge, but a grey haze appears to spread thinly north-east in the air above the vent area. As this is the period before the 2022-09 eruption, to be safe.

note_ja: 1 月の千島。北の雲の縁から南へ広い範囲が青緑に見え、北東に緑の斑と浮遊物の小片。薄雲か海氷の可能性が高いが、雲から離れた部分もあり決めきれない。
note_en: The Kurils in January. A wide area south of the cloud edge to the north looks blue-green, with a green patch and small fragments of floating matter to the north-east. Most likely thin cloud or sea ice, but some parts are away from cloud, so it cannot be settled.

note_ja: 2014-05-09 と同じく、トゥルマンの小島付近から南へ淡い白い帯が伸びる。今回はグリント注意でロウ島の風下の筋もあり風の陰の可能性が高いが、同じ場所に繰り返すので確かめたい。
note_en: As on 2014-05-09, a pale white band extends south from near the Tuluman islets. This time it is a glint-caution pass and there is also a streak downwind of Lou Island, so most likely a wind shadow, but it recurs at the same place, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: Landsat の 1 パスで、中心付近から東西に淡い灰青色の斑がいくつも並ぶ (5.0 km2)。色は付いておらず風による海面の粗さのむらとみられるが、普段の様子が無く中心に近いので念のため。
note_en: One Landsat pass; several pale grey-blue patches line up east-west from near the centre (5.0 km2). They are colourless and look like unevenness in sea-surface roughness due to wind, but there is no normal-appearance image and they are close to the centre, so just in case.

note_ja: Raoul 島西端（Denham 湾側）の岸から南西へ青緑の帯が 01-26 と 02-05 にほぼ同じ位置で出る。04-16 にも同じ岸に帯があり海岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、02-05 は岬から沖へ伸びている。01-31 は雲の隙間。
note_en: A blue-green band running south-west from the shore at the west end of Raoul Island (Denham Bay side) appears on 01-26 and 02-05 at almost the same position. There is also a band at the same shore on 04-16 and coastal turbid water is likely, but on 02-05 it extends offshore from the headland. 01-31 is a gap in the clouds.

note_ja: Maug のカルデラ内の西半分と西の島の外側に淡い青白い斑(2.4 km2)。2022-03-24 にもカルデラ内に斑があり、同じ場所に繰り返す。風下の凪か中央の浅いドームの可能性もある。
note_en: Faint bluish-white patches (2.4 km2) in the western half of the Maug caldera and outside the western island. There was also a patch inside the caldera on 2022-03-24, recurring at the same place. It could be calm water in the lee or the shallow central dome.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 11-17以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 11-17.

note_ja: 南西の角から北東へゾーンを横切る長い緑〜ターコイズの帯 (7.7 km2) が柔らかい縁で流れ、SWIR では暗く雲から離れている。ゾーン内に源は見えず、05-05 にも南西の角に同じ色の筋があるので、域外の島や近くの火山から流れてきた変色水か濁水の可能性がある。
note_en: A long green to turquoise band (7.7 km2) flows across the zone from the south-west corner to the north-east with soft edges; it is dark in SWIR and away from cloud. No source is visible in the zone, and 05-05 also has a streak of the same colour at the south-west corner, so it may be discoloured water or turbid water flowing in from islands outside the zone or a nearby volcano.

note_ja: ゾーン中心のすぐ近く（0.36 km）に青緑の斑が2つ並ぶ。周りに小さな積雲はあるが色が雲の影とは違い、2017年・2020年にも同じ火口丘群で緑の斑が出ている。
note_en: Two blue-green patches side by side very close to the zone centre (0.36 km). There are small cumulus around, but the colour differs from cloud shadow, and green patches also appeared over the same cone group in 2017 and 2020.

note_ja: この通過の真色パネルがほぼ黒く描かれ、候補 (8.34 km2) の海面が見えないため判断できない。SWIR では円内に薄い巻雲と霞がかかっており雲の可能性が高いが、2 月のオホーツク側なので海氷の有無も含めて見直したい。
note_en: The true colour panel of this pass is rendered almost black and the sea surface of the candidate (8.34 km2) cannot be seen, so it cannot be judged. In SWIR thin cirrus and haze lie over the circle and cloud is likely, but it is February on the Sea of Okhotsk side, so I would like to review it again, including whether sea ice is present.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-02から14までは目視で確認できる。それ以降は判然としない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Can be confirmed by eye from 07-02 to 07-14. After that it is not clear.

note_ja: 09-17・10-20・11-16 の 3 回、火口湾のある南の島の北岸と北東の島の間の海峡に 0.1-0.2 km2 の小さな青緑の斑が同じ位置に出る。岸に接していて浅い海峡の底の可能性が高いが、熱水の出口も否定できない。08-31 は霞の中の候補。
note_en: On 3 passes (09-17, 10-20, 11-16), a small blue-green patch of 0.1-0.2 km2 appears at the same position in the strait between the north shore of the southern island with the crater bay and the north-eastern island. It touches the shore and is most likely the bottom of the shallow strait, but a hydrothermal outlet cannot be ruled out either. 08-31 is a candidate in haze.

note_ja: Panarea 島の岸をぐるりと縁取る青緑の帯で、01-18 に 1.76 km2 へ広がる。冬の時化で浅い棚の堆積物が舞い上がったものとみられるが、01-18 は島の東、2002 年のガス噴出域に近い小島の間にも小さな候補があるので一度見てほしい。
note_en: A blue-green band fringing the whole shore of Panarea, which spreads to 1.76 km2 on 01-18. Seen as sediment on the shallow shelf stirred up by winter storms, but on 01-18 there is also a small candidate east of the island, between the islets near the 2002 gas emission area, so please take a look once.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北端から青緑の舌が 4 回とも出て、01-08・01-10 は北へ、01-13・01-15 は北東へ向きを変えて伸びる (最大 2.48 km2)。12-31 と 01-20 には無い。2013 年の島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口なので確認を (同じ日の GVP221020-W と同じ現象)。
note_en: A blue-green tongue comes out of the north tip of Jadid Island all 4 times, extending north on 01-08 and 01-10 and turning north-east on 01-13 and 01-15 (up to 2.48 km2). Not present on 12-31 and 01-20. Turbid water from erosion of the 2013 island is likely, but the island itself is the vent, so please check (the same phenomenon as GVP221020-W on the same day).

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 自動認定をすべて目視で確認できた
note_en: 2026-11-14: All the automatic detections could be confirmed by eye.

note_ja: 09-11 と 10-21 の大きな白い候補 (1.88, 2.94 km2) は場面が終わる黒い直線の縁に沿う帯。09-23 は小島の南東の既知浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) の位置に淡い緑の斑と薄い暈 (0.23 km2)、11-02 は南西の既知浅瀬の近くに青緑の小斑 (0.17 km2) が出る。浅い頂部の見え方の可能性が高いが、Karua の火口付近で 11 回の警報が続くので確認を。
note_en: The large white candidates on 09-11 and 10-21 (1.88, 2.94 km2) are bands along the edge of the black straight line where the scene ends. On 09-23 a faint green patch and thin halo (0.23 km2) appear at the position of the known shoal (cyan outline) south-east of the islet, and on 11-02 a small blue-green patch (0.17 km2) near the known shoal to the south-west. The appearance of the shallow summit is likely, but it is near the Karua vent and alerts have continued 11 times, so please check.

note_ja: 12-12 は小島の南東の既知浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) の位置に緑の斑と淡い暈 (0.19 km2、熱異常 2 px)、01-31 は円の南西、通常の姿にも淡い緑の点がある位置の緑の小斑 (0.31 km2)。02-25 は南の大きな島の北岸と雲の脇の小片で、熱異常 10 px の位置は図から読めない。03-20 は霞と薄雲の下の白い筋 (1.08 km2)。浅い頂部の見え方の可能性が高いが、Karua の火口付近で警報が 11 回続くので確認を。
note_en: 12-12 is a green patch with a pale halo at the position of the known shoal (cyan outline) south-east of the islet (0.19 km2, thermal anomaly 2 px); 01-31 is a small green patch south-west of the circle (0.31 km2), at a position where the normal appearance also has a pale green point. 02-25 is small fragments on the north shore of the large island to the south and beside cloud, and the position of the 10 px thermal anomaly cannot be read from the figure. 03-20 is a white streak under haze and thin cloud (1.08 km2). Most likely the appearance of the shallow summit, but it is near the Karua vent and alerts have continued 11 times, so please check.

note_ja: 圏中心を東西に横切る細長い暗い帯（色なし、2.3 km²）。雲列の南側で雲影の向きと合わず、海面のスリックか内部波と見られるが、源は確認できない。
note_en: A long, thin dark band (no colour, 2.3 km²) crossing the zone centre east-west. It is south of a line of clouds and does not match the direction of the cloud shadows; it looks like a surface slick or internal waves, but the source cannot be confirmed.
2026-11-14: 2026-05-31: clear discoloured water. 2026-06-20: discoloured water. 2026-07-05: discoloured water.

note_ja: 雪をかぶった Thule 島と Cook 島の岸に乳白がかったターコイズの水が付き、03-11 は Thule 島の西岸、03-28 は両島の間の Douglas 海峡と Cook 島の東岸に広がる (5.6・10.7 km2)。氷河の融け水の濁りとみられるが、火山の島の同じ岸で 02-06 から繰り返すので念のため。
note_en: Milky turquoise water clings to the shores of snow-capped Thule Island and Cook Island, on 03-11 on the west coast of Thule Island and on 03-28 spreading in Douglas Strait between the two islands and along the east coast of Cook Island (5.6, 10.7 km2). It appears to be turbid glacial meltwater, but as it repeats on the same shores of volcanic islands from 02-06, to be safe.

note_ja: 南西の氷雪に覆われた島の東岸に沿って緑から青緑の帯が貼り付く。融氷水や波で巻き上げた濁りの可能性が高いが、通常の見え方が雲で比べられず、熱水の可能性を消せない。
note_en: A green to blue-green band clings along the east shore of the ice- and snow-covered island to the south-west. Most likely ice meltwater or turbidity stirred up by waves, but the normal appearance cannot be compared because of cloud, and hydrothermal water cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 横当島から南へ白っぽい帯が 03-12 と 03-20 の両方に伸びる。SWIR でもわずかに明るく、島の風下の薄い雲筋の可能性が高いが、島からの放出も否定できない。
note_en: A whitish band extends south from Yokoate-jima on both 03-12 and 03-20. It is slightly bright in SWIR too, so most likely a thin cloud streak downwind of the island, but emission from the island cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: 同日 2 枚 (11:18、11:24) で、雪に覆われた島の北岸から北へ青緑の筋 (1.49 km2) が雲の間に伸びる。参照画像と 2021-04-02 の候補でも同じ場所に青緑の水があり常在する。氷河の濁りの可能性が高いが、雲と氷が多く熱水の変色と区別しきれない。
note_en: In two images on the same day (11:18, 11:24), a blue-green streak (1.49 km2) extends north between clouds from the north shore of the snow-covered island. The reference image and the 2021-04-02 candidate also have blue-green water at the same place, so it is persistent. Most likely glacial turbidity, but there is much cloud and ice and it cannot be fully distinguished from hydrothermal discolouration.

note_ja: 2 回とも候補は円の北東の縁 (中心から約 11 km) で、06-21 は薄雲のまだらの中、06-26 は積雲の脇の霞の帯の中。既知の浅瀬とは別の位置。雲・霞の可能性が高いが、5 日おいて同じ位置に出るので確かめたい。
note_en: Both times the candidate is on the north-east edge of the circle (about 11 km from the centre): on 06-21 in mottled thin cloud, on 06-26 in a haze band beside cumulus. A different position from the known shoal. Most likely cloud or haze, but it appears at the same position 5 days apart, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 雪と氷に覆われた 2 島の周り。03-28 は雲と霞の多い場面で西の島の北岸の輪郭 (3.74 km2)。04-10 は両島の岸を取り巻く青緑の水 (20.65 km2) で、北東へ直線的な境で広がり、島から北東へ淡い筋も見える。氷河の融け水や砕氷の可能性が高いが、通常の姿は氷と雲で当てにならず、前の 02-10 には熱異常もあるので確認を。
note_en: Around the two snow- and ice-covered islands. 03-28 is a scene with much cloud and haze, an outline on the north shore of the western island (3.74 km2). 04-10 is blue-green water surrounding the shores of both islands (20.65 km2), spreading to the north-east with a straight boundary, and faint streaks are also visible running north-east from the islands. Glacial meltwater or broken ice is likely, but the usual appearance is unreliable because of ice and cloud, and the earlier 02-10 also has a thermal anomaly, so please check.

note_ja: 候補は陽光反射の水面だが、Jadid 島の上に高温画素 1 個があり、島がいつもより橙色に写る。島の真上の雲と影による色ずれの可能性が高いが念のため。
note_en: The candidate is the sunlit reflecting water surface, but there is 1 hot pixel over Jadid Island, and the island appears more orange than usual. Colour misregistration from the cloud and shadow right over the island is most likely, but to be safe.

note_ja: 島々の周りの青緑が通常の浅瀬の輪郭より広がり、島の間をつないで北へ伸びる (3.16 km2)。テフラ島の侵食や浅瀬の巻き上げの可能性が高いが、2011-13 年の新島の周りなので一応見る。開水面の赤い点は白波。
note_en: The blue-green around the islands spreads beyond the usual shoal outline, linking the islands and extending north (3.16 km2). Erosion of the tephra islands or stirring-up of the shoal is most likely, but as it is around the new islands of 2011-13, worth a look. The red dots on the open water are whitecaps.

note_ja: 区域中心から北へ明るい緑の帯が伸びるが、雲の間の晴れ間で強いグリント下 (雲隣接 0.31)。雲縁の光とみられるが中心に重なるので念のため。
note_en: A bright green band extends north from the zone centre, but it is in a clear spell between clouds under strong glint (cloud adjacency 0.31). Seen as light at a cloud edge, but it overlaps the centre, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: Jadid 島北端の北〜北東に青緑の斑が繰り返し出る (03-26 に緑の舌状 2.19 km2、他は 1 km2 未満)。テフラ島の侵食と浅瀬の濁りの可能性が高いが、10 回同じ場所に出ており島が火口なので否定しきれない。
note_en: Blue-green patches recur north to north-east of the north tip of Jadid Island (a green tongue of 2.19 km2 on 03-26, the others under 1 km2). Most likely erosion of the tephra island and shoal turbidity, but it has appeared at the same place 10 times and the island is a vent, so it cannot be fully ruled out.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 02-06は明瞭だが少なくともこの火山から生じた海水変色ではない。エトナの降灰域などの可能性があるかもしれない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 02-06 is clear, but at the least it is not discoloured water produced by this volcano. An area of ash fall from Etna may be one possibility.

note_ja: 南西の端から区域内へ緑の細い筋が蛇行して入り込み、先端が中心の南約3 kmにある。区域内に湧出点は見えず、南方の火山 (Kavachi など) の変色水か沿岸水が流されてきた可能性がある。
note_en: A thin green streak meanders into the zone from the south-west edge, its tip about 3 km south of the centre. No source point is visible within the zone; it may be discoloured water from a volcano to the south (Kavachi, etc.) or coastal water carried in by the current.

note_ja: McDonald 島から東へ明るいターコイズの水が渦を巻いて広がり、21.8 km2 に及ぶ。熱画素 15。島の侵食による濁りの可能性もあるが、島に付いた源から流れ出す形で、雲から離れている。
note_en: Bright turquoise water spreads east from McDonald Island in swirls, covering 21.8 km2. 15 hot pixels. It may be turbid water from erosion of the island, but it has the form of a flow from a source attached to the island and is away from cloud.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 画像を確認 (火山性の可能性が高い)
note_en: 2026-11-14: reviewed from the images (likely volcanic)

note_ja: ラウル島の北岸沖に水色の斑があり、積雲に接している (雲接 0.38)。岸の浅瀬の色や雲の縁の可能性が高いが、色が付いている。
note_en: A light-blue patch off the north shore of Raoul Island, touching cumulus (cloud contact 0.38). Most likely the colour of the shore shoal or a cloud edge, but it is coloured.

note_ja: 04-22 の 2 枚 (同じ日の観測) は島の南の雲に囲まれた淡い灰青色の水域で、雲の縁に接する。03-23 は島の西岸の雲の下の小片、05-22 は霞の中の小片で、位置はそれぞれ違う。雲・霞による可能性が高いが、04-22 の水域は SWIR で暗く、表示されない 3 回分も確かめられない。
note_en: The two images on 04-22 (observations on the same day) are a pale grey-blue water area surrounded by cloud south of the island, touching the cloud edges. 03-23 is a small fragment under cloud on the west coast of the island, and 05-22 is a small fragment in haze, each in a different position. Cloud or haze is most likely, but the water area on 04-22 is dark in SWIR, and the 3 occurrences that are not displayed cannot be checked either.

note_ja: 厚い雲が円の大半を覆い、浮遊物候補 (0.17 km2) は雲の縁の灰色の切れ間の小片。SWIR では雲が薄紫に写る。前後の通過では環礁状の既知浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) に変化はなく雲と見るが、熱異常が 76 px と多く位置が図から読めないので確認を。
note_en: Thick cloud covers most of the circle, and the floating matter candidate (0.17 km2) is a small piece in a grey gap at the cloud edge. In SWIR the cloud appears pale purple. On the passes before and after there is no change in the atoll-like known shoal (cyan outline), and it is read as cloud, but the thermal anomaly is large at 76 px and its position cannot be read from the figure, so please check.

note_ja: ゾーン中心の東 1.8 km、雲から離れた開水面に淡い緑の小斑が東西に 2 つ並び、柔らかい縁と薄い暈がある (0.27 km2)。プランクトンの斑の可能性もあるが、火口丘群の上なので一度見る。前後の通過には見えない。
note_en: 1.8 km east of the zone centre, in open water away from cloud, two small pale green patches side by side east-west, with soft edges and a thin halo (0.27 km2). It may be a plankton patch, but it is over the cone group, so I will look once. Not seen on the passes before and after.

note_ja: 04-03 は厚い雲と強いグリントの下で候補は雲の縁。05-05 と 05-23 は北側の小島の南東、通常の姿で浅瀬のシアン輪郭がある所の脇に同じ位置で青緑の斑 (0.99, 1.47 km2) が出る。06-19 の 9.96 km2 は砂塵の霞で暗く写った場面の東の開水面に散る輪郭で、色の違いは見えない。浅い台地の見え方の可能性が高いが、輪郭の外へはみ出すので確認を。
note_en: 04-03 is under thick cloud and strong glint, and the candidate is a cloud edge. On 05-05 and 05-23 a blue-green patch (0.99, 1.47 km2) appears in the same position south-east of the northern islet, beside the place with a cyan shoal outline in the usual appearance. The 9.96 km2 on 06-19 is outlines scattered over the open water to the east of a scene darkened by dust haze, with no visible difference in colour. The appearance of the shallow platform is most likely, but as it extends beyond the outline, please check.

note_ja: 雲のない開水面で、ゾーン中心の南約 1.3 km に細長い青緑の斑と小さな斑 (1.51 km2)。通常の姿にもその付近に淡い緑の影があり山頂の浅瀬かもしれないが、輪郭は浅瀬の形と一致せず変色水の可能性がある。
note_en: On cloud-free open water, an elongated blue-green patch and a small patch about 1.3 km south of the zone centre (1.51 km2). The normal appearance also has a faint green shade near there, so it may be the summit shoal, but the outline does not match the shape of the shoal and it may be discoloured water.

note_ja: 南西から北東へ区域を横切るシアンの細い筋で、2022-03-21 とほぼ同じ向き・位置。雲から離れており、区域外から流れてきた変色水か沿岸水かは判断できない。
note_en: A thin cyan streak crossing the zone from south-west to north-east, in almost the same direction and position as on 2022-03-21. It is away from cloud, and whether it is discoloured water that flowed in from outside the zone or coastal water cannot be judged.

note_ja: 区域全体に淡いターコイズの細い筋が何本も走り、中心の東約4 kmで筋に付いた小さな斑が候補になっている。ブルームの筋の可能性が高いが、2019 年に噴火した火山 F の区域なので念のため。
note_en: Many thin pale turquoise streaks run across the whole zone, and a small patch attached to a streak about 4 km east of the centre became the candidate. Bloom streaks are most likely, but as this is the zone of volcano F, which erupted in 2019, to be safe.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 05-26: 北にたなびく薄い海水変色のようなものが見える。06-25,30も海水変色がたなびいている。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 05-26: something like thin discoloured water trailing north is visible. Discoloured water trails on 06-25 and 06-30 as well.

note_ja: 海面が黒く描かれる画像で、島々の西に輪郭の柔らかい緑の斑が複数散らばる。発生点がなくブルームの可能性が高いが、描画が暗く通常の見え方と比べにくい。
note_en: In an image where the sea is rendered black, several soft-edged green patches are scattered west of the islands. There is no source point, so most likely a bloom, but the rendering is dark and hard to compare with the normal appearance.

note_ja: 区域中央の北寄りの開けた海に、輪郭のはっきりした緑の斑 (0.26 km2) と、その南へ広がる淡い緑の霞。雲から離れ、平常図には何もない。すぐ西にタイル境の暗い筋があるが斑はその外。前後の回は雲で確かめられない。
note_en: In open sea in the north of the middle of the zone, a sharply outlined green patch (0.26 km2) and a pale green haze spreading south of it. It is away from cloud, and there is nothing in the normal-appearance image. There is a dark tile-boundary streak just to the west, but the patch is outside it. The passes before and after cannot be checked because of cloud.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 10-12以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 10-12. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: Raoul 島西岸の Denham 湾で、岸沿いの青緑の濁りが 2 回とも同じ所に出て沖へ渦を巻き、既知の浅瀬の輪郭より広い (07-26 に 10.48 km2)。冬の波浪による海浜の濁りの可能性が高いが、湾がカルデラなので念のため確認したい。
note_en: In Denham Bay on the west coast of Raoul Island, blue-green turbid water along the shore appears in the same place both times and swirls offshore, wider than the outline of the known shoal (10.48 km2 on 07-26). Beach turbid water from winter waves is most likely, but as the bay is a caldera I would like it checked to be safe.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 確かにこの日だけ島の沿岸から海水変色が伸びている。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water does extend from the coast of the island on this day only.

note_ja: 圏の南縁を南西から北東へ延びる幅数百 m の青緑の筋（0.72 km²）、SWIR では暗く浮遊物ではない。南西約 10 km の Kavachi に 12-05・12-15 の緑の変色水（5〜7 km²）の警報があり、そこから流れてきた変色水の可能性が高い。
note_en: A blue-green streak a few hundred m wide (0.72 km²) running south-west to north-east along the south edge of the zone; dark in SWIR, so not floating matter. Kavachi, about 10 km to the south-west, had alerts for green discoloured water (5-7 km²) on 12-05 and 12-15, and discoloured water that flowed from there is likely.

note_ja: Zubair 群島の中央の島々の周りに青緑の変色水が広く (52.8 km2) 広がり、島の脇に白い噴煙状の雲がある。2013 年の Jadid 島の噴火の時期で、11-08 にも変色水が続く。
note_en: Blue-green discoloured water spreads widely (52.8 km2) around the islands in the middle of the Zubair group, with white plume-like cloud beside an island. This is the time of the 2013 eruption of Jadid Island, and the discoloured water continues on 11-08.

note_ja: Maug のカルデラ内の水面が白っぽく候補になっている。風の当たらない湾内のグリントか浅い縁とみられるが、カルデラ内に熱水があるので念のため。
note_en: The water surface inside the Maug caldera is whitish and became a candidate. Seen as glint in the sheltered bay or the shallow margin, but there is hydrothermal activity inside the caldera, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 区域西の氷に覆われた陸の縁から水色の水が広がり、02-26 の通過にも同じ場所に写る。氷河の融け水の濁りの可能性が高いが、同じ位置の色のついた水なので確認したい。
note_en: Light-blue water spreads from the edge of the ice-covered land in the west of the zone, and it appears in the same place on the 02-26 pass as well. Turbid glacial meltwater is most likely, but as it is coloured water in the same position I would like it checked.

note_ja: Curtis 島の北東側に青緑の水が島から 1〜2 km 広がり、島を湧出点とする色のついた斑に見える。2023-05-20 にも同じ島から北西へ青緑の水が出ており、繰り返している。
note_en: Blue-green water spreads 1-2 km from the island on the north-east side of Curtis Island, looking like a coloured patch with the island as its source point. On 2023-05-20 blue-green water also came out north-west from the same island, so it is recurring.

note_ja: 東の厚い雲の手前、ゾーン中心の南西に淡い水色の斑 0.8 km2。SWIR では薄い霞が重なって見え、霞の可能性が高いが色が雲の白と違う。
note_en: A faint light-blue patch of 0.8 km2 south-west of the zone centre, in front of thick cloud to the east. In SWIR thin haze appears to overlap it and haze is likely, but the colour differs from the white of cloud.

note_ja: 雪をかぶった 2 島の間の水道に、北の雲から南へ垂れる明るい灰青色の舌状の水があり、SWIR では暗い。薄雲か薄い海氷の見込みが高いが、南の島の湾 (Kraternaya 湾) が水色に見えるので念のため。
note_en: In the channel between the two snow-capped islands there is bright grey-blue tongue-shaped water hanging south from the cloud to the north, dark in SWIR. Thin cloud or thin sea ice is very likely, but as the bay of the southern island (Kraternaya Bay) appears light blue, to be safe.

note_ja: 2/2 は南の島の海岸沿いの浅い棚とグリント。2/9 は小島の南、通常の見え方で既知の浅瀬 (シアン輪郭) の位置に青緑の斑があり、周りに淡い暈が広がる。Karua の火口付近にあたる。
note_en: 2/2 is a shallow shelf along the coast of the southern island and glint. 2/9 has a blue-green patch south of the islet at the position of the known shoal (cyan outline) in the usual appearance, with a pale halo spreading around it. This corresponds to the vicinity of Karua's vent.

note_ja: 積雲の多い回で、中心付近に淡く明るい水面の斑 2.6 km2 があるが源点や筋はない。熱画素が 122 と多く、画像からは雲によるものか判別できない。
note_en: A pass with much cumulus; there is a pale bright water-surface patch of 2.6 km2 near the centre, but no source point or streak. There are many hot pixels (122), and whether they are due to cloud cannot be distinguished from the image.

note_ja: Panarea 島の東岸から南東端に沿って幅数百 m の青緑の帯 (0.73 km2) があり、岸から離れない。冬の澄んだ水で砂底の浅い台地が見えたものの可能性が高いが、平常像にはこの帯が無く、島の沿岸には熱水の湧出もあるので確かめたい。東の岩礁群に変色はない。
note_en: A blue-green band a few hundred m wide (0.73 km2) along the east shore to the south-east tip of Panarea, not leaving the shore. Likely a shallow sandy-bottomed platform seen through clear winter water, but this band is not in the normal image, and there is hydrothermal discharge along the island's coast, so I would like to check. No discolouration at the rocky reefs to the east.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 03-13以外の全ての画像に変色水があるように見えるが、雲量が多く判然としない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water seems to be on every image except 03-13, but with much cloud it is not clear.

note_ja: 12-25 は島の東の薄雲・霞のまだらの中の候補。01-14 は雪に覆われた南の島の南岸に沿う鮮やかな青緑の帯で、雲からは離れている。冬の岸の薄氷や雪の可能性が高いが、火口湾の近くなので確かめたい。
note_en: 12-25 is a candidate in mottled thin cloud and haze east of the island. 01-14 is a vivid blue-green band along the south shore of the snow-covered southern island, away from cloud. Thin winter ice at the shore or snow is likely, but it is near the crater bay, so I would like to check.

note_ja: 候補は帯域北東のレイキャネス半島沿岸に沿う乳白緑の帯と雲縁で、パスごとに形が変わる。前後のパスにも円内に乳白色の渦があり晩夏の円石藻ブルームか沿岸水とみられるが、沿岸の同じ側に 11 回出ているので念のため。
note_en: The candidates are a milky green band along the coast of the Reykjanes Peninsula in the north-east of the area and cloud edges, changing shape from pass to pass. The passes before and after also have milky swirls in the circle; looks like a late-summer coccolithophore bloom or coastal water, but it has appeared 11 times on the same side of the coast, so just in case.

note_ja: Landsat の通過で強いグリントがあり、真色パネルは雲 (またはグリント) の白以外が黒く描かれて候補の海面の色が見えない。SWIR では雲の間の小片で、雲かグリントの残りの可能性が高いが確かめられない。
note_en: A Landsat pass with strong glint; the true-colour panel draws everything except the white of cloud (or glint) as black, so the colour of the sea surface at the candidate cannot be seen. In SWIR it is a small fragment between clouds, and remnant cloud or glint is most likely, but this cannot be confirmed.

note_ja: マウグ諸島のカルデラ内の水面と西の口に淡い斑。カルデラ内の静かな深い水の見え方の可能性が高いが、普段の見え方との違いがはっきりしない。
note_en: Pale patches on the water inside the caldera of the Maug Islands and at its western opening. Most likely the appearance of calm deep water in the caldera, but the difference from the normal appearance is unclear.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 08-02にも海水変色があり、サークルの北西側に濃い水塊がある。08-05の海水変色は紡錘上の渦を巻いているように見える。08-30にも微かに深い海水変色がNW-SE方向にサークルを横切っているように見える。方位性と海底地形を踏まえるとHunga Tongaからの重力流懸濁物の可能性が考えられるが確定はできない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water is there on 08-02 as well, with a dense water mass in the north-west of the circle. The discoloured water of 08-05 looks like a spindle-shaped eddy. On 08-30, too, faint deep discoloured water seems to cross the circle from north-west to south-east. From the direction and the seafloor relief it may be suspended matter of a gravity flow from Hunga Tonga, but this cannot be settled.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた Simushir 島の Broutona 湾 (カルデラ) 内の水が灰青緑で、湾の内岸に沿って 6.69 km2 が拾われる (後の 03-10 も湾内が同じ色)。冬の薄氷・シャーベット氷か融雪濁りの可能性が高いが、参照画像がなく判断しきれない。
note_en: The water inside Broutona Bay (a caldera) on snow-covered Simushir Island is grey-blue-green, and 6.69 km2 is picked up along the inner shore of the bay (on the later 03-10 the bay is the same colour). Thin winter ice or slush ice, or turbid snowmelt water, is likely, but there is no reference image, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: 9/20 と 10/7 に円の中心付近 (中心から 1.1〜1.4 km) に雲から離れた小さな緑がかった水色の斑が出て、10/7 の次の通過にも同じ辺りに淡い斑が見える。10/5 の候補は南西の海岸寄りの薄雲の下。
note_en: On 9/20 and 10/7 small greenish light-blue patches away from cloud appear near the centre of the circle (1.1-1.4 km from the centre), and a faint patch is visible around the same place on the pass after 10/7. The 10/5 candidate is under thin cloud near the coast to the south-west.

note_ja: 円の中心の緑の斑 (0.85 km2) から西へ淡い緑の尾が 2 km ほど伸びる。後の 08-15 にも同じ点に青緑の小斑がある。2019 年の島の跡の浅瀬の濁りの可能性もあるが、一点から尾を引く変色水なので確認を。
note_en: A pale green tail extends about 2 km west from the green patch (0.85 km2) at the centre of the circle. The later 08-15 also has a small blue-green patch at the same point. It may be turbid water over the shoal left by the 2019 island, but as it is discoloured water trailing from a single point, please check.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北西岸から渦状に伸びる青緑の濁り (02-14) と周囲の浅瀬の青緑が繰り返し出る。テフラ島の侵食による沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口なので熱水由来を否定しきれない。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water swirling out from the north-west shore of Jadid Island (02-14) and the blue-green of the surrounding shoal appear repeatedly. Coastal turbid water from erosion of the tephra island is likely, but the island itself is the vent, so a hydrothermal origin cannot be fully ruled out.

note_ja: 3 回ともレイキャネス半島の先端から西へ乳白色の渦と筋がゾーンの大部分に広がる（27〜51 km2）。Eldey の位置に起点はなく、2024-03-16 に始まった陸上の Sundhnúkur 噴火の煙霧か沿岸水と見られるが、3 月でブルームの季節でもないので確認を。
note_en: All three times, milky swirls and streaks spread west from the tip of the Reykjanes Peninsula over most of the zone (27-51 km2). There is no origin at the position of Eldey; seen as haze from the onshore Sundhnúkur eruption that began on 2024-03-16, or coastal water, but it is March and not the bloom season either, so please check.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 03-19のサークル内WNWに小さな海水変色のようなものがみられる。それ以外はすべて雲。
note_en: 2026-11-14: On 03-19 something like a small patch of discoloured water is visible in the west-north-west inside the circle. Everything else is cloud.

note_ja: 12-14 は Sholan 島の北、ゾーン中心付近に緑の丸い斑 0.26 km2 があり、12-11 と平常像にも同じ位置に緑の点が見える。2017-06-28 にはここに小島があり、その跡の浅瀬の見込みが高い。12-16 は島の間の浅瀬の帯。
note_en: On 12-14 there is a round green patch of 0.26 km2 north of Sholan Island near the zone centre, and a green dot is also visible in the same position on 12-11 and in the normal-state image. There was a small island here on 2017-06-28, and a shoal left by it is very likely. 12-16 is a band of shoal between the islands.

note_ja: 雪をかぶった 2 島の風下に雲の帯がのび、候補はその脇の暗い海 (04-24 01:04 の 9.13 km2 は処理の違う暗い画像) や雲の縁、北の島の南東岸沿いの淡い帯 (05-14) に出る。雲・霞と融雪の濁りでほぼ説明できるが、05-14 の岸沿いの帯は確かめきれない。
note_en: A band of cloud stretches downwind of the two snow-capped islands, and the candidates appear in the dark sea beside it (the 9.13 km2 on 04-24 01:04 is a dark image with different processing), at cloud edges, and as a pale band along the south-east shore of the northern island (05-14). Cloud, haze and snowmelt turbid water explain almost all of it, but the band along the shore on 05-14 cannot be fully checked.

note_ja: 区域中心 (山頂の浅瀬) に淡い斑があり、普段の様子と 11-16 の前の通過にも同じ位置にかすかな斑がある。浅瀬の見え方か山頂の変色水か画像だけでは決められない。
note_en: A pale patch at the zone centre (the summit shoal); the normal appearance and the earlier pass on 11-16 also have a faint patch at the same position. Whether it is the appearance of the shoal or discoloured water over the summit cannot be decided from the images alone.

note_ja: Karua の小岩礁のすぐ南東 (1回目) と北東 (2回目) に淡い白っぽい斑。普段の姿にも岩礁の南に淡い斑があり常時区分の区域だが、履歴を超えたので念のため。
note_en: A pale whitish patch just south-east (first) and north-east (second) of the small Karua reef. The usual appearance also has a pale patch south of the reef and this zone is in the "persistent" class, but it exceeded its history, so to be safe.

note_ja: 9/29と10/15に島の東〜南東の小積雲の間で淡い白い斑が同じ海域に出る。色も湧出点も見えず、10/22は強い陽光反射、11/2の ap は雲の縁で、たぶん雲周りの薄霞。
note_en: On 9/29 and 10/15 a pale white patch appears in the same sea area between small cumulus east to south-east of the island. Neither colour nor a source point is visible; 10/22 is strong sunlight reflection, and the ap on 11/2 is a cloud edge, so probably thin haze around clouds.

note_ja: 1 回目は区域中心付近に淡い小斑(0.87 km2)、グリントなし。2020-07-23 にも中心付近に淡い斑が出ており、繰り返すので確認したい。2 回目は北からのグリントの帯。
note_en: The first is a small pale patch (0.87 km2) near the zone centre, no glint. A pale patch also appeared near the centre on 2020-07-23, so as it repeats I would like it checked. The second is a band of glint from the north.

note_ja: Sholan 島のすぐ北、既知の浅瀬 (cyan) の外に緑〜青緑の細長い斑が 01-25・01-28・02-04・02-19 と同じ位置に出る (02-04 は白い点を伴う)。水没した岩礁の可能性もあるが、2011-12 年の噴火地点そばなので確認したい。
note_en: Just north of Sholan Island, outside the known shoal (cyan), a long, narrow green to blue-green patch appears in the same position on 01-25, 01-28, 02-04 and 02-19 (02-04 with a white dot). It may be a submerged reef, but as it is next to the 2011-12 eruption site I would like it checked.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島の南側から乳白の青緑の水が南南東へ約 3 km の舌状に広がり、島の西にも斑がある。2016-17 年噴火でできた島の浸食による濁りの可能性が高いが、2022 年 3 月にも同じ島から同様の流れが出ており、島を源とするので念のため。
note_en: Milky blue-green water spreads about 3 km south-south-east from the south side of Bogoslof Island as a tongue, with patches west of the island too. Most likely turbid water from erosion of the island formed in the 2016-17 eruption, but a similar flow also came from the same island in March 2022, and its source is the island, so just in case.

note_ja: 12-16 は中心の小島 (Sholan) の南西岸から淡い緑の筋が南西へ延び、12-23 は島列の東から南へ 2 km 以上の細長いターコイズの帯、後の通過にも島を巻く淡い帯が見える。若いテフラ島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島を源に複数回出ている。11-26・12-03 は新陸判定のみで明るい物は見えない。
note_en: On 12-16 a pale green streak extends south-west from the south-west shore of the islet in the centre (Sholan), and on 12-23 there is a long, narrow turquoise band more than 2 km from the east of the island chain to the south; on later passes a pale band wrapping around the islands is also visible. Turbid water from erosion of the young tephra islands is most likely, but it has appeared several times with the islands as its source. 11-26 and 12-03 are new-land judgements only, and nothing bright is visible.

note_ja: 中心の北西に淡い青白い小斑(0.8 km2)。通常の見え方でも同じ辺りが淡く、色ははっきりしないが、変色水の続く火山なので念のため。
note_en: A small faint bluish-white patch (0.8 km2) north-west of the centre. In the usual appearance too the same area is faint, and the colour is not clear, but it is a volcano with continuing discoloured water, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 自動検知でたぶんOK。はっきり見えている日もある。
note_en: 2026-11-14: The automatic detection is probably right. On some days it is clearly visible.

note_ja: 02-06 に雪をかぶった島の東の海面に南西-北東に伸びる淡い帯 (2.63 km2) があり、SWIR では暗い。雲の切れ間にあり、02-01 の候補は島の西の雲の縁で位置が違うので薄雲の可能性が高いが、雲から離れた部分もある。
note_en: On 02-06 there is a faint band (2.63 km2) on the sea surface east of the snow-capped island, running south-west to north-east, dark in SWIR. It is in a gap in the clouds, and the 02-01 candidate is at a cloud edge west of the island in a different position, so thin cloud is likely, but part of it is away from the cloud.

note_ja: 区域全体が緑がかった水で覆われ、南西に色の境がある。候補は中の小斑。Hunga Tonga の 2022-01-15 噴火の 10 日後で、その灰を含んだ水とみられ、この火山自身の湧出点は見えない。
note_en: The whole zone is covered by greenish water, with a colour boundary to the south-west. The candidate is a small patch within it. Ten days after the 2022-01-15 eruption of Hunga Tonga; looks like water containing its ash, and no source point of this volcano itself is visible.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 03-12は光源の問題のように見える。03-20は色が悪く判然としない。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 03-12 looks like a matter of the lighting. On 03-20 the colour is poor and nothing is clear.

note_ja: Broutona 湾 (Uratman カルデラ) の中に、湾奥から南へ伸びるやや明るい灰青の水の帯が囲まれている。東側に雲ともやがあり薄いもやの可能性が高いが、2019-07-23・2019-09-13 にも同じ湾の中に候補が出ており、普段の様子が無いので念のため。
note_en: Inside Broutona Bay (Uratman caldera), a slightly bright grey-blue band of water extending south from the head of the bay is outlined. There is cloud and haze to the east, so it is most likely thin haze, but candidates also appeared in the same bay on 2019-07-23 and 2019-09-13, and there is no normal-appearance image, so just in case.

note_ja: 島の北西岸から乳白の青緑の帯が北西と南へ数 km 流れ、同日の 2 枚 (22:15, 22:20) に同じ形で写る。2016-17 年噴火の新しい砕屑物でできた島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島から出るプルームの形で熱水の可能性も消せない。
note_en: A milky blue-green band flows several km north-west and south from the north-west shore of the island, captured in the same shape in two images on the same day (22:15, 22:20). Most likely turbid water from erosion of the island built of fresh clastic material from the 2016-17 eruption, but it has the shape of a plume coming from the island, and hydrothermal water cannot be excluded.

note_ja: 01-17 と 01-22 は枠全体の海が乳青緑で、2022-01-15 の Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai 大噴火の降灰による広域の変色とみられ、点源はない。01-07 はグリント下の暗い筋 (海面のスリック)、01-27 は雲の間の小斑。Feinga 自身の活動の兆候は見えない。
note_en: On 01-17 and 01-22 the sea across the whole frame is milky blue-green, read as widespread discolouration from ashfall from the major 2022-01-15 Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai eruption, with no point source. 01-07 is a dark streak under glint (a sea-surface slick), and 01-27 a small patch between clouds. No sign of activity of Feinga itself is visible.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 異常なし (自然色の図 fig07n・fig08n を見ての判定)
note_en: 2026-11-14: nothing anomalous (judged from the natural-colour figures fig07n and fig08n)

note_ja: 小島の南の青緑の斑は通常の見え方の既知の浅瀬（シアンの輪郭）とほぼ重なり、浅瀬そのものの可能性が高い。ただし高温画素14がこの回にあり、北西へ少しはみ出す形でもあるので見直しに回す。
note_en: The blue-green patch south of the islet almost overlaps the known shoal (cyan outline) in the normal appearance, so most likely the shoal itself. However, this pass has 14 hot pixels and the shape protrudes slightly to the north-west, so it is sent for review.

note_ja: 区域中心の南 (山頂の浅瀬) に淡い斑があり、山頂を中心に波の屈折模様が見える。2013-12-02 と同じ位置の斑で、浅瀬の上の波か変色水か画像だけでは決められない。
note_en: There is a faint patch south of the zone centre (the summit shoal), and a wave refraction pattern centred on the summit is visible. A patch at the same position as on 2013-12-02; whether it is waves over the shoal or discoloured water cannot be decided from the image alone.

note_ja: 6月18日の小さな候補はSholan島など小島の脇の浅い棚。6月13日の2.4 km2の大きな候補は島の西に広がるが、グリント除去後の画像がほぼ黒く何が写っているか判断できない。グリント残りの可能性が高いが確認したい。
note_en: The small candidate on 18 June is a shallow shelf beside small islands such as Sholan Island. The large 2.4 km2 candidate on 13 June spreads west of the islands, but the image after glint removal is almost black and what it shows cannot be judged. Residual glint is most likely, but I would like it checked.

note_ja: 円の南西に 0.37 km2 と 0.18 km2 の小さな緑青色の斑が 2 回とも同じ位置に出る。通常の見え方にも同じ位置にかすかな点があり、雲から離れた開けた海面。Karua の火口付近の熱水変色水の可能性がある。02-10 は熱異常画素 8。
note_en: Small green-blue patches of 0.37 km2 and 0.18 km2 south-west of the circle, at the same position both times. The normal appearance also has a faint point at the same position, in open sea away from cloud. It may be hydrothermal discoloured water near the Karua vent. 02-10 has 8 thermal anomaly pixels.

note_ja: 2015年の島の周りにターコイズの水が繰り返し出て、2月12日は島の南へ約3 kmの渦状の帯(16.6 km2)になる。島の凝灰岩丘の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、通常の見え方に島が無く比較できない。
note_en: Turquoise water recurs around the 2015 island, and on 12 February it forms a swirling band about 3 km south of the island (16.6 km2). Most likely turbid water from erosion of the island's tuff cone, but the normal appearance has no island, so it cannot be compared.

note_ja: 5/15 は雲の列の脇、5/18 と 5/30 は島の浅い棚沿いで、通常の見え方の浅瀬と重なる。6/4 の Zubair 島東沖の小さな青い斑は雲や浅瀬では説明しにくい。
note_en: 5/15 is beside a row of clouds, and 5/18 and 5/30 are along the shallow shelf of the islands, overlapping the shoal in the usual appearance. The small blue patch off the east of Zubair Island on 6/4 is hard to explain by cloud or shoal.

note_ja: 鳥島の南東岸に沿って水色の水が帯状に囲まれ、島から東へ淡い筋も延びる。沿岸の浅い棚の可能性もあるが普段の見え方にはない。
note_en: Light-blue water was outlined as a band along the south-east shore of Torishima, and a faint streak also extends east from the island. It could be a shallow coastal shelf, but it is not in the usual appearance.

note_ja: ブロートン湾の内側に淡い斑。島の東は雲だが湾内は晴れている。2021-04-29 にも湾内が囲まれており、繰り返すので確認したい。
note_en: Pale patches inside Broughton Bay. There is cloud east of the island, but the bay is clear. The bay was also outlined on 2021-04-29; since it recurs, I would like it checked.

note_ja: 北硫黄島の西、区域の南寄りに淡い白っぽい小斑がいくつか (3.2 km2)。島の脇の雲に近く海面の濃淡の可能性が高いが、変色の多い区域なので確かめたい。
note_en: Several small pale whitish patches (3.2 km2) west of Kita-Ioto, in the southern part of the zone. They are close to the cloud beside the island and sea-surface shading is most likely, but as this zone has frequent discolouration I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: ゾーン南西部で積雲の上側に青緑の広がり (1.37 km2)。SWIR では雲のない水面で、影の色とは違う。2018-04-13 とは位置が 1 km ほど違うが、同じ火山で青緑の斑が出ている。
note_en: A blue-green spread (1.37 km2) on the upper side of cumulus in the south-west of the zone. In SWIR it is cloud-free water surface, and the colour differs from that of shadow. The position differs by about 1 km from 2018-04-13, but a blue-green patch appears at the same volcano.

note_ja: 3 月の雪に覆われた島のブロートン湾の中に灰緑色の水と岸沿いの候補がある。薄い氷や雪解けの濁りと思われるが、画像だけでは確かめられない。
note_en: In Broutona Bay on the island, covered with March snow, there is grey-green water and a candidate along the shore. Thought to be thin ice or turbid snowmelt water, but this cannot be confirmed from the image alone.

note_ja: 07-26 に Curtis 島の北岸から北へ約 3 km、水色の筋状の流れが伸び、雲からは離れている。島の熱水か浅瀬の懸濁か判別できない。07-31 の候補は雲の縁。
note_en: On 07-26 a light-blue streaky flow extends about 3 km north from the north shore of Curtis Island, away from cloud. Whether it is hydrothermal water from the island or suspended matter on a shoal cannot be distinguished. The candidate on 07-31 is a cloud edge.

note_ja: 中央の島々に付いた青緑の浅瀬ハローが既知浅瀬の輪郭の少し外へ張り出しているだけで、通常の見え方にも同じ色の縁がある。風浪による再懸濁と見られ、島から離れた斑は無い。
note_en: The blue-green shoal halo around the central islands merely extends slightly beyond the outline of the known shoals, and the usual appearance has an edge of the same colour. It appears to be resuspension by wind waves; there is no patch away from the islands.

note_ja: 常時変色水のある福徳岡ノ場で、中心から北東約1.6 kmに淡い緑の斑があり、東西に淡い帯が伸びる。雲から離れ高温画素6。既知の活動の続きと見られ、変色の規模は小さい。
note_en: At Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba, where discoloured water is always present, there is a pale green patch about 1.6 km north-east of the centre, with pale bands extending east-west. Away from cloud, 6 hot pixels. It appears to be a continuation of the known activity, and the discolouration is small in extent.

note_ja: 主な候補は南の南硫黄島の岸を縁取る青緑のハローで通常要因だが、両パスとも圏中央の火口付近に小さな候補があり、10-07 は火口の南東に淡い緑の水が広がる。常時変色する区域で、継続中の活動の可能性。
note_en: The main candidate is the blue-green halo fringing the shore of Minami-Ioto to the south, a usual cause, but on both passes there is a small candidate near the vent in the middle of the zone, and on 10-07 pale green water spreads south-east of the vent. A zone with constant discolouration; possibly ongoing activity.

note_ja: 雪の残る北の島の南岸沖に細長い水色の斑が1つ。湾口に近く常時区分の区域なので、海氷片か岸の浅所かを確認したい。
note_en: A single long, narrow light-blue patch off the south shore of the northern island, where snow remains. It is close to the bay mouth and in a "persistent" class zone, so I would like to check whether it is a fragment of sea ice or a shallow area along the shore.

note_ja: ゾーン南西の雲の脇に青緑の水の斑 (0.29 km2) があり、05-16 の後の画像でもゾーン南縁に青緑の筋が見える。約 10 km 南西の Kavachi の変色水が流れ込んだ可能性がある。
note_en: There is a patch of blue-green water (0.29 km2) beside cloud in the south-west of the zone, and on the later image of 05-16 a blue-green streak is also visible on the south edge of the zone. Discoloured water from Kavachi, about 10 km to the south-west, may have flowed in.

note_ja: 浮遊物候補はジャディード島の岸の砕波と浅瀬の縁。ただし南の画面外の一点から北へ扇状に広がる白い筋が島の上空を覆っており、雲か塵か噴気か見分けられない（前後の通過には無い）。
note_en: The floating matter candidates are breaking waves on the shore of Jadid Island and the edge of the shoal. However, white streaks fanning out north from a single point off-screen to the south cover the sky over the island, and cannot be told apart as cloud, dust or fumarolic plume (not present on the passes before and after).

note_ja: 中心からわずか 0.07 km の所に緑の小さな斑 (0.10 km2) があり、ズームでは南西へ淡い筋が伸びる。西に積雲とその影があり雲影の縁の可能性もあるが、2016 年・2019 年にも山頂付近に小さな斑が出ている。
note_en: A small green patch (0.10 km2) only 0.07 km from the centre; zoomed in, a pale streak extends south-west. There is cumulus and its shadow to the west and it may be the edge of a cloud shadow, but small patches also appeared near the summit in 2016 and 2019.

note_ja: パナレア島の東の岩礁群の周りに淡いまだらの斑が広がる。浅瀬と海面の粗さの模様に見えるが、ガス噴出のある海域なので念のため。
note_en: Pale mottled patches spread around the group of rocks east of Panarea. They look like a pattern of shoals and sea-surface roughness, but it is an area with gas emissions, so just in case.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北〜北東に接するターコイズの斑が 4 回とも同じ所に出る（03-20 は北へ伸びる舌状）。侵食される島の濁りや浅い台地の可能性が高いが、通常の見え方より広く 14 回続く。
note_en: A turquoise patch adjoining the north to north-east of Jadid Island appears in the same place all 4 times (on 03-20 a tongue extending north). Turbid water from the eroding island or a shallow platform is likely, but it is wider than the usual appearance and continues for 14 occurrences.

note_ja: 区域北東部に北東-南西に細長い淡い白の斑（1.8 km2）が 1 回。色がなく湧出点も不明で海面のスリックらしいが確かではない。
note_en: A long, thin faint white patch (1.8 km2) running north-east to south-west in the north-east of the zone, once. No colour and no clear source point; it seems to be a surface slick, but this is not certain.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-11のみ横当島南岸に有意な海水変色がみられる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Marked discoloured water lies along the south coast of Yokoate-jima on 07-11 only.

note_ja: 候補は積雲の間の淡い斑で、雲の影か薄雲とみられる。ただ高温画素が 288 と多く、雲の縁のずれによるものとみられるが、位置が絵から分からないので念のため。
note_en: The candidate is pale patches between cumulus, looks like cloud shadow or thin cloud. However, there are as many as 288 hot pixels; they look like the result of misregistration at cloud edges, but their position cannot be seen from the image, so just in case.

note_ja: カルデラ西縁の氷に覆われた島 (Cook 島) の東岸から乳白色の水色の水が東へ広がり、雲の縁にも接する。氷河の融水による濁りの見込みが高いが、カルデラ内なので念のため。
note_en: Milky light-blue water spreads east from the east shore of the ice-covered island on the western rim of the caldera (Cook Island) and also touches the cloud edge. Most likely turbid water from glacial meltwater, but it is inside the caldera, so just in case.

note_ja: 北硫黄島の西岸から西へ淡い白っぽい水が広がる (3.1 km2)。雲は島の上だけでグリントもなく、前後の通過にも小さな候補がある。
note_en: Pale whitish water spreads west from the west coast of Kita-Ioto (3.1 km2). Cloud is only over the island and there is no glint, and the earlier and later passes also have small candidates.

note_ja: 区域の西を南北に貫く幅 1 km ほどの乳白色の水色の帯。グリントも雲もなく、東の縁がはっきりしている。湧出点は見えずブルームの筋の可能性もあるが、色が目立つ。
note_en: A milky light-blue band about 1 km wide running north-south through the west of the zone. There is no glint or cloud, and the eastern edge is sharp. No source point is visible and it may be a bloom streak, but the colour is conspicuous.

note_ja: 中心から 0.7〜0.9 km に淡い緑の小斑 (0.06〜0.12 km2) と、その周りに薄い青緑のにじみが 10-11・10-18 の 2 回あり、前のパス 10-03 にも同じ所に淡い緑が見える。2022 年の変色水と同じ位置で、小さいが雲とは離れている。
note_en: Small pale green patches (0.06-0.12 km2) 0.7-0.9 km from the centre, with a thin blue-green blur around them, on 2 passes (10-11, 10-18), and the previous pass, 10-03, also shows pale green at the same place. Same position as the 2022 discoloured water; small, but away from cloud.

note_ja: 快晴の 7/12 に円の中心付近で緑がかった水色の斑と、その南に広がる淡い緑の塊が出る。7/14 も中心付近に小さな緑の斑、7/22 の通過では中心付近から南東へ細い緑の筋が延びる。雲は無く SWIR で暗い。
note_en: On clear 7/12, a greenish light-blue patch near the centre of the circle and a pale green mass spreading south of it. 7/14 also has a small green patch near the centre, and on the 7/22 pass a thin green streak extends south-east from near the centre. No cloud; dark in SWIR.

note_ja: 浮遊物候補 0.66 km2 は大きな雲の塊の脇の暗い水に散る小片で、雲の縁の色ずれに見える。ただし熱異常が 150 px と多く、北の雲が SWIR で紫に写り、位置が図から読めないので確認を。前後の通過には何もない。
note_en: The floating matter candidate of 0.66 km2 is small pieces scattered over dark water beside a large cloud mass, and looks like colour misregistration at the cloud edge. However, the thermal anomaly is large at 150 px, the cloud to the north appears purple in SWIR, and its position cannot be read from the figure, so please check. Nothing on the passes before and after.

note_ja: 2-3月の2回、群島中部の小島の北西岸から北西へ延びる青緑の帯が同じ位置に出ている(既知浅瀬の輪郭の外に少しはみ出す)。若い島の浅い棚か侵食の濁りの可能性が高いが、20回の警報があるので一度確認したい。6月の2回は画像端の直線沿いと強いグリント下の散点で人工物。
note_en: On two occasions in February-March, a blue-green band extending north-west from the north-west shore of a small island in the middle of the archipelago appears in the same position (protruding slightly beyond the outline of the known shoal). A shallow shelf of the young island or turbid water from erosion is most likely, but as there have been 20 alerts I would like it checked once. The two in June are artefacts along a straight line at the image edge and scattered points under strong glint.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 05-19 and 05-21 as well.

note_ja: 10-31 は北の島との間の水道の影の脇の小片、11-08 は雪をかぶった本島の東岸に沿う細い帯、12-08 は雲の切れ間の茶色の小片。11-30 は本島の東岸から東へ 2 km ほど伸びる青緑の舌 (1.11 km2) で、岸が起点。沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、温泉のある島なので確認を。
note_en: 10-31 is a small piece beside the shadow of the channel between it and the northern island, 11-08 a thin band along the east shore of the snow-capped main island, and 12-08 a small brown piece in a gap in the clouds. 11-30 is a blue-green tongue (1.11 km2) extending about 2 km east from the east shore of the main island, starting at the shore. Coastal turbid water is likely, but it is an island with hot springs, so please check.

note_ja: 2019-20 年の火口の位置に青緑の明るい斑が 07-16・07-31・08-10 と前後の画像でも毎回出て、08-10 は南西へ数 km の筋を引く。侵食で消えた 2019 年の島の浅瀬の濁りの可能性もあるが、点から流れ出す形なので見る。
note_en: A bright blue-green patch appears at the position of the 2019-20 vent every time, on 07-16, 07-31 and 08-10 and in the earlier and later images, and on 08-10 it trails a streak several km to the south-west. It may be turbid water over the shoal of the 2019 island that has disappeared through erosion, but as it has the form of a flow from a point, worth a look.

note_ja: 中央の小島の北端に緑の尾 (04-20、05-25) が出るほかは、強い太陽反射の下で積雲の縁や島の縁に散る色の滲み (05-13、06-02)。小島の浅い台地の暈の可能性が高いが、島が火口なので 2017 年の一続きとあわせて確認したい。
note_en: Apart from a green tail at the north tip of the central islet (04-20, 05-25), these are colour bleeds scattered along cumulus edges and the island edge under strong sun glint (05-13, 06-02). Most likely the halo of the islet's shallow platform, but the island is a vent, so I would like it checked together with the 2017 sequence.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 05-10は海水変色と白色噴煙を映している。05-30はサークル外に海水変色が見える。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 05-10 shows discoloured water and a white plume. On 05-30 discoloured water is visible outside the circle.

note_ja: マウグ島のカルデラ内の水域中央に淡い細長い斑 (1.4 km2)。中央の浅い高まりの見え方の可能性が高いが、熱水のあるカルデラなので確かめたい。
note_en: A pale elongated patch (1.4 km2) in the middle of the water inside the Maug caldera. The appearance of the central shallow high is most likely, but as this is a caldera with hydrothermal activity I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 2回ともゾーン東縁(中心から約17km)の雲の縁に灰色の霞状の候補があり、雲で説明できそうだが位置がほぼ同じで、9月25日は熱画素6。中身は霞で起点も色もないので念のための確認。
note_en: Both times there is a grey hazy candidate at the cloud edge on the east edge of the zone (about 17 km from the centre); it can probably be explained by cloud, but the position is almost the same, and on September 25 there are 6 hot pixels. Its content is haze with no origin or colour, so this is a just-in-case check.

note_ja: 中心付近から北東へ白い小さな塊が一直線に並び、その南西端（中心から 0.6 km）に淡い細長い変色が乗る。船の航跡と船舶雲の可能性が高いが、端が中心と重なるので確認したい。前後の回には何もない。
note_en: Small white masses line up in a straight line north-east from near the centre, and a faint long, thin discolouration lies at their south-west end (0.6 km from the centre). A ship wake and ship-track cloud are likely, but the end overlaps the centre, so I would like to check. Nothing on the passes before and after.

note_ja: リッター島の南に白い細い帯が南北に伸びる。2024-08-01 と同じ形と位置で、島の風下の風の陰の可能性が高いが、島 (火口) を起点にするので 2 回分を並べて確かめたい。
note_en: A thin white band extends north-south south of Ritter Island. It has the same shape and position as on 2024-08-01, and the wind shadow downwind of the island is most likely, but as it starts from the island (vent) I would like to confirm it by placing the two side by side.

note_ja: 10-4は東の大きな雲が落とす黒い影の縁に沿う細い帯、10-9は霞の中の褐色の小斑で、どちらも影の縁の明るい帯の可能性が高い。ただし2回とも島の北東のほぼ同じ場所にあるので雲とは断定しない。
note_en: 10-4 is a thin band along the edge of the black shadow cast by a large cloud to the east, and 10-9 a small brown patch in haze; both are likely the bright band at a shadow edge. However, both times they are at almost the same place north-east of the island, so they are not declared to be cloud.

note_ja: マヘンゲタン島の東に淡い灰色がかった斑が 1 つあり、雲からは離れている。小さく不明瞭だが島の近くなので念のため。
note_en: One pale greyish patch east of Mahengetang Island, away from cloud. Small and indistinct, but near the island, so just in case.

note_ja: 雪に覆われたカルデラ湾の南東岸沿いに淡い帯。2015-12-23 もほぼ同じ岸沿いに候補があり、雪の明るさの隣接効果か結氷の可能性が高いが、同じ位置なので確かめたい。
note_en: A pale band along the south-east shore of the snow-covered caldera bay. 2015-12-23 also has a candidate along almost the same shore; an adjacency effect from the bright snow or freezing is most likely, but as it is in the same position I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: Bogoslof 島から青緑の濁りが南東・南西・南へ尾を引き、前後の通過 (02-27, 03-09) でも島を起点に同じように出る。2016-17 年噴火の新しい島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島が火口なので熱水由来を否定できない。
note_en: Blue-green turbid water trails south-east, south-west and south from Bogoslof Island, and appears in the same way starting at the island on the passes before and after (02-27, 03-09). Turbid water from erosion of the new island from the 2016-17 eruption is likely, but the island is the vent, so a hydrothermal origin cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: ゾーン中心(0.08km)に淡い青白の斑があり、周りに中心を囲む淡い弧状の帯(同心円状の波の可能性)が見える。4月12日の通過にも中心に青い斑があるので浅い山頂が透けて見えている可能性が高いが、既知浅瀬の輪郭が無いので確認したい。
note_en: A pale bluish-white patch at the zone centre (0.08 km), with faint arc-shaped bands surrounding the centre (possibly ring waves (concentric waves)). The 12 April pass also has a blue patch at the centre, so most likely the shallow summit showing through, but there is no known shoal outline, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 07-27は同心円状の波紋ではない
note_en: 2026-11-14: 07-27 is not a set of concentric ripples.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 少なくとも3つの変色源がサークル内にみられる。サークル外からたなびいている変色域もあるため火山性とは考えにくい。
note_en: 2026-11-14: At least three sources of discoloured water are seen inside the circle. There are also discoloured areas trailing in from outside the circle, so volcanic origin is hard to accept.

note_ja: 候補 (45 km2) はグリントの帯と撮像の継ぎ目の段差、霞の面で常時区分の区域。ただ南の小島から南へ白い筋が延び、前後の通過にも同じ筋があるので (地形性の雲か) 確かめたい。
note_en: The candidate (45 km2) is a glint band, a step at an image seam and a hazy surface, in a zone of the "persistent" class. However, a white streak extends south from the small southern island and the passes before and after show the same streak, so I would like it checked (orographic cloud?).

note_ja: 01-09 と 02-08 は画像端の黒い直線に沿う帯 (センサー端)。01-21 は積雲の間に淡い褐色の細長い筋があり熱異常画素 26 を伴う。雲の影の縁か飛行機雲の可能性が高いが確かめられない。
note_en: 01-09 and 02-08 are bands along the black straight line at the image edge (sensor edge). On 01-21 there is a faint brown, long, thin streak between cumulus, accompanied by 26 thermal anomaly pixels. The edge of a cloud shadow or a contrail is likely, but this cannot be confirmed.

note_ja: 7月28日、区域の東半分を灰色の霞状の塊が覆い、その西縁に沿って浮遊物候補 1.06 km2 と高温画素 2。SWIR では周りの白い積雲より透けた灰色で、雲か噴気・噴煙かを判断できない。8月15日は積雲の間の緑の小点 (0.16 km2) で、平常図と 8月17日にも同じ辺りに淡い緑が見える。
note_en: On July 28, a grey hazy mass covers the eastern half of the zone, with floating matter candidates of 1.06 km2 and 2 hot pixels along its west edge. In SWIR it is a more translucent grey than the surrounding white cumulus, and whether it is cloud or a fumarolic or eruption plume cannot be judged. August 15 is a small green dot between cumulus (0.16 km2), and faint green is also visible around the same place in the normal view and on August 17.

note_ja: 候補自体は1月28日が画像端沿い、2月19日・22日が雲の間の淡い白い斑で、雲と人工物で説明できる。ただ2月19日に南の小島付近から北東へ扇状に広がる白い塊(下側が暗くSWIRでは薄紫)があり、影を伴う積雲の塔と見えるが噴煙でないことを一度確かめたい。
note_en: The candidates themselves are along the image edge on January 28 and faint white patches between clouds on February 19 and 22, explainable by cloud and artefacts. However, on February 19 there is a white mass spreading like a fan to the north-east from near the small island to the south (dark on the underside, pale purple in SWIR); it looks like a cumulus tower with its shadow, but I would like to confirm once that it is not an eruption plume.

note_ja: 浮遊物の候補は薄雲とグリントの斑で否定できるが、区域の西寄りに暗い物体から西へたなびく灰白色の帯が写る。硫黄鳥島の噴気の可能性があり確認したい。
note_en: The floating matter candidates are thin cloud and glint patches and can be dismissed, but in the western part of the zone there is a grey-white band trailing west from a dark object. It may be a fumarolic plume from Io-Torishima, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 厚い雲の切れ間で、島の東 2 km に明るい水色の斑。強いグリントと薄雲の色の可能性もあるが、2022-24年の活動期の最中なので確認したい。
note_en: In a gap in thick cloud, a bright light-blue patch 2 km east of the island. It may be the colour of strong glint and thin cloud, but as it is in the middle of the 2022-24 activity period I would like it checked.

note_ja: 中心の南南西約3.7 kmに緑の斑があり、雲から離れている。前の 03-21 に南西の端で緑の水塊が見え、2022 年と同じく南西から入る水の可能性がある。
note_en: A green patch about 3.7 km south-south-west of the centre, away from cloud. On the previous 03-21 a green water mass is visible at the south-west edge, so, as in 2022, it may be water entering from the south-west.

note_ja: 山頂の熱水域 (中心から 0.36 km) で、白く明るい点 (SWIR でも小さく光る) から北西へ緑〜青緑の短い帯が尾を引く。漁船とその航跡の可能性が高いが、線ではなく幅のある斑で、浅い山頂の砕波や熱水の湧出とも区別できない。
note_en: In the summit hydrothermal area (0.36 km from the centre), a short green to blue-green band trails north-west from a bright white point (which also shines faintly in SWIR). A fishing boat and its wake are likely, but it is a wide patch rather than a line, and cannot be distinguished from breaking waves over the shallow summit or hydrothermal discharge.
2026-11-14: Visible on 06-24, 06-27, 06-28 and 06-30. The other days are doubtful.

note_ja: 小島の南東、平常図の浅所 (水色の小円) の位置に緑の柔らかい斑 (0.25 km2)。浅い山頂が透けて見えるものが有力だが、浅所の輪郭よりやや広く、雲から離れている。
note_en: A soft green patch (0.25 km2) south-east of the islet, at the position of the shallow area (small light-blue circle) in the normal-state image. The shallow summit showing through is the most likely explanation, but it is slightly wider than the outline of the shallow area and is away from cloud.

note_ja: 主な候補は太陽反射注意の下で画像西端の近くに広がる淡い斑で、反射の名残とみられる。ただしゾーン中心のすぐ北東にも小さな淡い斑があり、念のため確認したい。
note_en: The main candidate is a faint patch spreading near the west edge of the image under sun glint caution, seen as residual glint. However, there is also a small faint patch just north-east of the zone centre, so I would like to check just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 04-26,05-19: 同心円状の波紋が見える。 05-01: 微かな海水変色のようなものが見える。
note_en: 2026-11-14: 04-26 and 05-19: concentric ripples are visible. 05-01: something like faint discoloured water is visible.

note_ja: 新しい陸地 (nl) の理由で、輪郭は無く、ゾーン一面に小さな積雲が散らばる。3 回続けて同じ画素に雲が落ちたものとみられ、明るい陸の塊は見えない。
note_en: Flagged for new land (nl): there is no outline, and small cumulus clouds are scattered over the whole zone. Cloud seems to have fallen on the same pixels three times in a row; no bright mass of land is visible.

note_ja: Jadid 島から北北西へ灰色の細い帯(ap、0.93 km2)が伸び、SWIR でも筋が見える。島の南東の緑の縁は常時の浅い台地。2025-10〜2026-03 の Jadid の灰色の帯と同じ形の可能性。
note_en: A thin grey band (ap, 0.93 km2) extends north-north-west from Jadid Island, and a streak is visible in SWIR too. The green fringe south-east of the island is the permanent shallow platform. Possibly the same shape as the grey band at Jadid in 2025-10 to 2026-03.

note_ja: 区域中心の既知の浅瀬（ふだんの見た目の水色の小さな輪郭）の東 1 km に、濃い青の小斑が二つある。浅瀬の一部か変色水か画像だけでは決められない。
note_en: Two small dark blue patches 1 km east of the known shoal at the zone centre (the small light-blue outline in the normal appearance). Whether they are part of the shoal or discoloured water cannot be decided from the images alone.

note_ja: 01-02 は崩れた雲・霞の中の小さな白斑、01-19 は中心の南約2 kmの霞の中のかすかな白斑で、雲の原因が濃い。01-19 に高温画素 2 があり、位置も中心付近なので念のため。
note_en: 01-02 is a small white patch in broken cloud and haze, and 01-19 a faint white patch in haze about 2 km south of the centre; a cloud cause is likely. 01-19 has 2 hot pixels and the position is near the centre, so just in case.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 05-18.
2026-11-14: Discoloured water on 06-01 as well.

note_ja: ゾーン中央の Sholan 島の北東岸から青緑の帯が北東へ流れ出し、4-1と4-11で同じ島を起点に伸びる（4-11は約1 km2）。若い火砕丘の浸食による濁りの可能性もあるが、起点が噴火でできた島そのもので熱水起源を否定できない。
note_en: A blue-green band flows out north-east from the north-east shore of Sholan Island in the middle of the zone, extending from the same island on 4-1 and 4-11 (about 1 km2 on 4-11). It may be turbid water from erosion of the young pyroclastic cone, but its starting point is the island built by the eruption itself, and a hydrothermal origin cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: Maug カルデラの中央の水面に淡い褐色がかった斑。前の通過 (2017-02-22) も候補で、2025年10月にもカルデラ内に淡い斑がある。中央火口丘の浅所か熱水かを確認したい。
note_en: A faint brownish patch on the water in the middle of the Maug caldera. The previous pass (2017-02-22) was also a candidate, and in October 2025 there is also a faint patch inside the caldera. I would like to check whether it is the shallow part of the central cone or hydrothermal.

note_ja: 快晴の通過で、円の南西部に明るい緑がかった水色の筋が何本も南西の縁から北東へ延びる。SWIR で暗く雲ではない。帯域の南西約 10 km の Kavachi から流れてきた変色水の可能性が高い (植物プランクトンの可能性も残る)。
note_en: On a clear pass, many bright greenish light-blue streaks extend north-east from the south-west edge in the south-west part of the circle. Dark in SWIR, so not cloud. Discoloured water that flowed from Kavachi, about 10 km south-west of the zone, is likely (phytoplankton remains possible).

note_ja: 須美寿島の岩礁から南東へ細い空中の帯 (橙の輪郭、0.57 km2) が伸び、岩礁の周りが暗い緑に写る。薄雲に覆われた通過で、岩礁の風下の雲のすじの可能性が高い。
note_en: A thin band in the air (orange outline, 0.57 km2) extends south-east from the rocks of Sumisujima, and the area around the rocks appears dark green. A pass covered by thin cloud, and a cloud streak downwind of the rocks is most likely.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた Simushir 島の Broutona 湾内で、湾の中央の水が灰色に明るい (2.33 km2)。冬なので薄氷か風の弱い水面の可能性が高いが、参照画像も前後の通過もなく判断しきれない。
note_en: Inside Broutona Bay on snow-covered Simushir Island, the water in the middle of the bay is a bright grey (2.33 km2). As it is winter, thin ice or a calm water surface is most likely, but there is no reference image and no earlier or later pass, so it cannot be fully judged.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた西の島の西岸に接する明るい青緑の水 (5.11 km2) で、周りは積雲に囲まれる。後の 03-11 も両島の周りに青緑の水が出て警報になり、2020-04 にも同じ見え方がある。氷河の融け水や砕氷の可能性が高いが、島の岸に繰り返し出るので確認を。
note_en: Bright blue-green water (5.11 km2) touching the west shore of the snow-covered western island, surrounded by cumulus. On the later 03-11, blue-green water also appears around both islands and triggers an alert, and 2020-04 has the same appearance. Most likely glacial meltwater or brash ice, but it recurs on the island's shore, so please check.

note_ja: 島の北東端の沖、礁の輪の近くに淡い斑。2017-01-25 と 2020-04-23 と同じ場所で 3 回目。礁か沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが確認したい。
note_en: A pale patch off the north-east tip of the island, near the ring of reef. Same place as 2017-01-25 and 2020-04-23; the third time. Most likely reef or coastal turbidity, but I would like it checked.

note_ja: リッター島から南へ白い帯が細長く伸び、島を起点にしている。グリントなしの判定だが風下の風の陰や雲の影と平行な筋にも見え、色は白で湧出とは言い切れない。
note_en: A white band extends long and narrow to the south from Ritter Island, starting at the island. It is judged as no glint, but it also looks like the wind shadow downwind or a streak parallel to cloud shadows, and its colour is white, so it cannot be said to be upwelling.

note_ja: 通常の見え方は 2022 年以降で島が無いため、2021 年の Hunga 島の岸と周りの青緑の暈が新陸・変色水として拾われている。08-30 は島の南 1.5 km に島から離れた 4.29 km2 の乳青色の斑があり、09-14 の後の通過にも南へ伸びる青緑の筋が写る。島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、2021-12 噴火前の変色水も否定できない。
