note_en: The usual appearance is from 2022 onwards with no island, so the 2021 shore of Hunga island and the blue-green halo around it are picked up as new land and discoloured water. On 08-30 there is a milky blue patch of 4.29 km2 1.5 km south of the island, separate from it, and a blue-green streak extending south is also captured on the pass after 09-14. Turbid water from erosion of the island is likely, but discoloured water before the 2021-12 eruption cannot be ruled out.

note_ja: Landsat 8。円の北西に長さ 1.5 km ほどのわずかに明るい細長い斑があり、雲もグリントもない。周りの海面のまだら模様とほとんど変わらず海面の荒れか油膜状の筋と思われるが、原因を決めきれない。
note_en: Landsat 8. In the north-west of the circle there is a slightly bright elongated patch about 1.5 km long, with no cloud or glint. It is hardly different from the mottled pattern of the surrounding sea surface and is thought to be rough sea or an oil-slick-like streak, but the cause cannot be decided.

note_ja: 候補は南の南硫黄島を覆う雲のすぐ北、島の北東岸の沖に接する小さな青緑の斑（中心から 4.4 km）。雲の縁か島の岸の浅い水と見られるが、決めきれない。ゾーン中心の火口にもいつもの淡い斑が見える。
note_en: The candidate is a small blue-green patch just north of the cloud covering Minami-Ioto to the south, touching the sea off the island's north-east shore (4.4 km from the centre). It appears to be a cloud edge or shallow water along the island's shore, but this cannot be decided. The usual pale patch is also visible at the vent at the zone centre.

note_ja: 島の西から東へ延びる淡い緑がかった斑の境界が囲まれた。源点ははっきりせず水塊の境界にも見えるが、変色の多い区域なので念のため。
note_en: The boundary of a faint greenish patch extending from the west to the east of the island was outlined. The source point is not clear and it also looks like a water-mass boundary, but it is a zone with frequent discolouration, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 晴天率 0.99 の静かな海面に、中心の南東 2 km で縁のぼやけた楕円形の明るい青緑の斑 (1.11 km2) が 1 つだけ浮く。雲から離れ SWIR では暗い水で、通常の姿と前後の通過 (07-21, 08-15) の同じ位置には何もない。1 回限りだが、2021 年 12 月の Hunga 噴火の 4 か月前の近くの変色なので確認を。
note_en: On a calm sea with a clear fraction of 0.99, a single bright blue-green oval patch with blurred edges (1.11 km2) floats 2 km south-east of the centre. It is away from cloud and is dark water in SWIR, and there is nothing in the same position in the usual appearance or on the earlier and later passes (07-21, 08-15). It is a one-off, but please check it as nearby discolouration four months before the December 2021 Hunga eruption.

note_ja: 快晴・グリントなしの沖合で、中心の東 1.8 km に緑〜ターコイズの斑が西北西から東南東へ一列に並び、ズームでは塊から尾を引く帯に見える。SWIR は暗く雲ではない。East Epi の他の帯域でも 2018〜2021 年に同じような緑の小斑が出ている。
note_en: Offshore, clear and without glint, green to turquoise patches line up west-north-west to east-south-east 1.8 km east of the centre; zoomed in, they look like a band trailing from a mass. Dark in SWIR, not cloud. Similar small green patches have also appeared in other East Epi zones in 2018-2021.

note_ja: 横当島の南岸、二つの山体のつなぎ目付近の一点から南西へ約3km、細い青緑の帯が流れている。島の上には雲があり雨後の濁りの可能性もあるが、いつもの見え方には無く、起点が一点にまとまっているので確認したい。
note_en: From a single point on the south shore of Yokoate-jima, near the junction of the two edifices, a thin blue-green band flows about 3 km to the south-west. There is cloud over the island and it may be turbid water after rain, but it is not in the usual appearance and its origin is concentrated at one point, so I would like it checked.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 12-08以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 12-08. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: グリント注意で全体が緑がかった場面。円の南、中心から 3.5 km ほどの一点から南東へ扇状に広がる白い筋があり、その頭に小さな候補がある。北東の箱の中の候補 (1.00 km2) は南西へ伸びる淡い灰色の斑。白い筋は低い雲の筋の可能性が高いが、活動的な火山の上で一点から出ているので確認を。前後の通過に変色はない。
note_en: A scene under glint caution with a greenish cast overall. In the south of the circle, about 3.5 km from the centre, white streaks spread in a fan to the south-east from a single point, with a small candidate at their head. The candidate in the north-eastern box (1.00 km2) is a pale grey patch extending south-west. The white streaks are most likely low cloud streaks, but as they come from a single point above an active volcano, please check. No discolouration on the earlier and later passes.

note_ja: 09-20 と 10-07 の 2 回とも、ゾーン中心から 0.2〜0.4 km の同じ位置に縁のぼやけた緑の小斑 (0.20, 0.11 km2) が出る。雲から離れた開水面で、通常の姿には何もなく、10-05 の通過にも同じ所に淡い緑が見える。East Epi B の山頂の変色水の可能性がある。
note_en: On both 09-20 and 10-07 a small green patch with blurred edges (0.20, 0.11 km2) appears in the same position 0.2-0.4 km from the zone centre. It is open water away from cloud, there is nothing in the usual appearance, and pale green is also visible in the same place on the 10-05 pass. It may be discoloured water at the summit of East Epi B.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 島の北側に青いパッチがあり、すべての写真で見えていて動かないので浅瀬と考えられる。
note_en: 2026-11-14: A blue patch lies north of the island; it is visible on all the images and does not move, so it is taken for a shoal.

note_ja: 群島中央の浅所を持つ島から北へ張り出す水色の舌状の斑 (1.3 km2、輝き注意)。2019年3〜4月の帯と同じ島で、若い島の浸食による濁りが有力。
note_en: A light-blue tongue-shaped patch (1.3 km2, glint caution) protruding north from the island with a shallow area in the middle of the archipelago. It is the same island as the band in March-April 2019, and turbid water from erosion of the young island is the most likely explanation.

note_ja: ロウ島南の小島から南へ淡い白っぽい水が尾を引く (1.8 km2)。南端は雲とその影に接し霞の可能性もあるが、同じ Tuluman 付近で 2019-03 などにも淡い水が出ている。
note_en: Faint whitish water trails south from the small island south of Lou Island (1.8 km2). The south end touches cloud and its shadow and could be haze, but faint water also appeared near the same Tuluman in 2019-03 and at other times.

note_ja: 12-14 は Panarea 島の岸から東の小島群 (2002 年のガス噴出域を含む) までの浅い台地を広く覆うターコイズの暈 (8.3 km2)。海面に白波が一面に散る荒れた日で、波による底質の巻き上げの可能性が高いが、前後の晴れた通過には無い。12-24 は雲の影の縁の淡い帯。
note_en: 12-14 is a turquoise halo (8.3 km2) broadly covering the shallow platform from the shore of Panarea to the group of islets to the east (including the 2002 gas emission area). It was a rough day with whitecaps scattered over the whole sea surface, and stirring-up of bottom sediment by waves is most likely, but it is not present on the clear passes before and after. 12-24 is a pale band at the edge of a cloud shadow.

note_ja: 雲の多い場面で、中央の浅瀬の東に緑の小斑 (0.15 km2) と小さな浮遊物候補 (0.07 km2)、その西にも青緑の水が見える。前の 04-07 の通過には円の中の一点から北東へ弧を描く淡い緑の尾が写り、後の 04-17 にも淡い緑の斑がある。2022 年の噴火の前年に変色水が続いていた可能性があるので確認を。
note_en: In a cloudy scene, a small green patch (0.15 km2) and a small floating matter candidate (0.07 km2) east of the central shoal, with blue-green water also visible to the west. The previous pass, 04-07, shows a pale green tail arcing north-east from one point in the circle, and the later 04-17 also has a pale green patch. Discoloured water may have continued in the year before the 2022 eruption, so please check.

note_ja: 福徳岡ノ場の中心の北北西約2 kmに淡い緑の弧状の筋。前後の回にも中心付近に淡い緑が見え、持続的な弱い変色の範囲内と見る(glint caution)。
note_en: A faint green arc-shaped streak about 2 km north-north-west of the centre of Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba. Pale green is also seen near the centre on the passes before and after; read as within the range of persistent weak discolouration (glint caution).

note_ja: 区域南半分を淡い霞のような面が覆い、その北縁の区域中央付近に褐色の小さな候補がある。霞の北端が細くくびれて見え、薄雲とみられるが、2023 年に噴火した East Epi B の上なので確認したい。
note_en: A pale haze-like surface covers the southern half of the zone, and there is a small brown candidate on its northern edge near the middle of the zone. The northern end of the haze appears to narrow sharply and it appears to be thin cloud, but as it is above East Epi B, which erupted in 2023, I would like it checked.

note_ja: 候補は 04-09 が雲の縁、04-25 が島の南 5 km の淡い白い斑で、湧出点はない。ただし 04-25 は島を通って東西に伸びる緑がかった帯が見え、2019-08-13 には島の北東岸に青緑の斑があるので、島の熱水によるものか確認したい。
note_en: The candidates are a cloud edge on 04-09 and a pale white patch 5 km south of the island on 04-25, with no source point. However, on 04-25 a greenish band runs east-west through the island, and on 2019-08-13 there is a blue-green patch on the island's north-east shore, so I would like to check whether it comes from the island's hydrothermal activity.

note_ja: 中心の北の沖合に淡いターコイズの広がりがあり、候補はその縁（0.12 km2）。積雲が近いが斑は雲の外で、hot px 20 を伴う。2018-06-25 の同じ帯域の緑の斑とほぼ同じ場所。
note_en: There is a pale turquoise spread offshore north of the centre, and the candidate is its edge (0.12 km2). Cumulus is close but the patch is outside the cloud, and it is accompanied by hot px 20. Almost the same place as the green patch in the same band of area on 2018-06-25.

note_ja: 中心から 0.2 km ほどの所に小さな緑の斑が 2 つ (計 0.24 km2) あり、南西へ淡い筋が伸びる。雲から離れ、グリント注意だが波の模様とは色が違う。2016 年・2021 年にも同じ山頂付近に小さな斑が出ている。
note_en: Two small green patches (0.24 km2 in total) about 0.2 km from the centre, with a faint streak extending south-west. Away from cloud; glint needs caution, but the colour differs from the wave pattern. Small patches also appeared near the same summit in 2016 and 2021.

note_ja: 2回ともグリント注意の場面で、中心の南西5-6 kmに小さな白い斑が積雲や雲影の間に散る。雲によるものに見えるが、2回とも南西の近い位置(2 kmほどの差)に出ており、2026年噴火地点の領域なので一度確認したい。
note_en: Both are scenes under glint caution, with small white patches scattered among cumulus and cloud shadows 5-6 km south-west of the centre. They look like they are due to cloud, but both appeared in close positions to the south-west (differing by about 2 km), and as this is the area of the 2026 eruption site I would like it checked once.

note_ja: 雲に覆われた Panarea 島の東、Lisca Bianca などの岩礁群のそばの開水面に乳白の斑 (0.78 km2) が広がり、SWIR では暗く雲ではない。2002 年のガス噴出火口の付近で、通常の姿の浅瀬の小さな水色より広い。
note_en: East of cloud-covered Panarea, a milky patch (0.78 km2) spreads over open water beside the group of rocks including Lisca Bianca; it is dark in SWIR, so not cloud. It is near the vent of the 2002 gas emission, and wider than the small light-blue shoal in the normal appearance.

note_ja: 区域の中心に緑の変色水。尾を引く日があり、VIIRS・MODIS・OLCI のどれにも出る。高解像度の衛星が撮らない火山。
note_en: Green discoloured water at the zone centre. On some days it trails a tail, and it appears in all of VIIRS, MODIS and OLCI. A volcano that high-resolution satellites do not image.

note_ja: 円内の小島 (Jadid 島) から青緑の舌が 03-15 は南西へ、04-11 と 04-26 は北東へ伸び (最大 2.36 km2)、警報は 3 か月で 22 回。06-20 は砂塵の霞で暗い場面の島の脇の小さな浮遊物候補 (0.22 km2) で霞の筋と見る。2013 年の島の侵食による濁りの可能性が高いが、島そのものが火口で同じ所から繰り返し出るので確認を。
note_en: From the islet in the circle (Jadid Island), a blue-green tongue extends south-west on 03-15 and north-east on 04-11 and 04-26 (up to 2.36 km2); 22 alerts in 3 months. 06-20 is a small floating matter candidate (0.22 km2) beside the island in a scene darkened by dust haze, read as a haze streak. Most likely turbid water from erosion of the 2013 island, but the island itself is the vent and it recurs from the same place, so please check.

note_ja: 雲の少ない開水面で、ゾーン南部に青緑の淡い広がりがあり南東端に白い点 (0.38 km2)。通常の姿でもこの付近がわずかに明るく、浅い山頂が澄んだ日に透けた可能性もあるが、2018 年・2024 年にも近くで青緑の斑が出ている。
note_en: On open water with little cloud there is a pale blue-green spread in the southern part of the zone with a white dot at its south-east end (0.38 km2). In the usual appearance too this area is slightly bright, and the shallow summit may have shown through on a clear day, but blue-green patches also appeared nearby in 2018 and 2024.

note_ja: Raoul 島西岸の Denham 湾の中に青緑の水が湾を満たすように広がり、通常の見え方の浅瀬の輪郭より広い。湾の浅い砂底や波による濁りとみられるが、2016・2019 年にも同じ西側に候補があり確認したい。
note_en: Blue-green water spreads as if filling Denham Bay on the west coast of Raoul Island, wider than the shoal outline in the usual appearance. It appears to be the bay's shallow sandy bottom or turbid water from waves, but as there were also candidates on the same west side in 2016 and 2019 I would like it checked.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 島の周囲に弱い海水変色が見られるが、殆どの写真に見られるようだ。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Weak discoloured water is seen around the island, but it seems to be there on most of the images.

note_ja: 5/17(反射なし)に岩の東に淡い白い斑が小さく出て、5/25は北側の反射の中。たぶん岩の風下の海面模様だが、変色水の多い区域なので念のため。
note_en: On 5/17 (no glint) a small faint white patch appears east of the rock, and on 5/25 it is within the glint on the north side. Probably a sea-surface pattern in the lee of the rock, but it is a zone with frequent discoloured water, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 09-26以外の全ての画像に変色水あり。基準値を超えているかどうかは目測困難。
note_en: 2026-11-14: Discoloured water on every image except 09-26. Whether it exceeds the threshold is hard to judge by eye.

note_ja: Raoul 島の西岸 (Denham 湾) の沖に乳白がかったターコイズの水が大きく広がる (7.0 km2)。岸から出る雨後の濁りの可能性はあるが、Denham カルデラの上で 01-01 にも西岸に小さな水色の斑が残るので念のため。
note_en: Milky turquoise water spreads widely off the west shore of Raoul Island (Denham Bay) (7.0 km2). It may be post-rain turbid water coming from the shore, but it is over the Denham caldera and a small light-blue patch remains on the west shore on 01-01 too, so just in case.

note_ja: 北硫黄島から北西へ延びる線上に淡い白っぽい斑が並ぶ。SWIR では同じ向きに暗い筋があり島の風下の風の影の可能性が高いが、変色の多い区域なので確かめたい。
note_en: Pale whitish patches are lined up on a line extending north-west from Kita-Ioto. In SWIR there is a dark streak in the same direction, and the wind shadow downwind of the island is most likely, but as this zone has frequent discolouration I would like it confirmed.

note_ja: 中央の島の砂嘴の先から青緑の帯が 2〜3 km 流れ出し、向きは回ごとに変わる。若いテフラ島の侵食による濁りと見られるが、給源が島で 10 回出ている。
note_en: A blue-green band flows 2-3 km out from the tip of the central island's spit, its direction changing from pass to pass. It appears to be turbid water from erosion of the young tephra island, but its source is the island and it has appeared 10 times.

note_ja: カルデラ湾内の候補が 09-19（西部、小積雲の脇）と 10-06（東岸沿い、薄雲の下）にあり、09-16 も dw 0.79 で湾内が繰り返し拾われている。真色では湾の水色に目立つ変化が無く雲影・薄雲の可能性が高い。09-04 の浮遊物は北岸のリーフ縁、11-03 は北西岸。
note_en: Candidates in the caldera bay occur on 09-19 (western part, beside small cumulus) and 10-06 (along the east shore, under thin cloud), and 09-16 also has dw 0.79, so the bay is picked up repeatedly. In true colour there is no notable change in the colour of the bay water, and cloud shadow or thin cloud is likely. The floating matter on 09-04 is at the reef edge on the north shore, and on 11-03 on the north-west shore.

note_ja: 雪氷に覆われた Thule 島と Cook 島の北岸沿い、両島の間の海峡の北口に青緑の水が 12-06・12-21 と後の 01-02・01-17 に繰り返し出る。氷河の融水濁りや砕氷の可能性が高いが、カルデラの上の同じ位置に続くので一度見る。
note_en: Along the north shores of snow- and ice-covered Thule Island and Cook Island, at the north mouth of the strait between the two islands, blue-green water appears repeatedly on 12-06 and 12-21 and on the later 01-02 and 01-17. Turbid glacial meltwater or broken ice is likely, but it continues at the same position over the caldera, so taking a look once.
2026-11-14: Faint discoloured water on 02-10, 02-20 and 02-26. Hard to confirm on 02-18 and 03-06.

note_ja: ラウル島西岸の Denham 湾に水色の水が 8-23 と 9-08 の 2 回、同じ位置に出る。平常像にも岸沿いの浅瀬があり浅い台地や岸の濁りの可能性が高いが、平常より沖へ広い。
note_en: Light-blue water appears twice, on 8-23 and 9-08, at the same position in Denham Bay on the west shore of Raoul Island. The normal image also has a shoal along the shore, and a shallow platform or turbid water at the shore is likely, but it extends further offshore than usual.

note_ja: 12-08 は東の Ronde 島の岸の既知の浅瀬の小斑。12-23 は中心から 1.8 km、雲に囲まれた隙間の淡い不定形の斑で、SWIR では薄いもやがかかっており薄雲の可能性が高いが、活動的な火口の近くなので念のため。
note_en: 12-08 is a small patch on the known shoal at the shore of Ronde Island to the east. 12-23 is a faint irregular patch 1.8 km from the centre in a gap surrounded by cloud; in SWIR thin haze lies over it and thin cloud is likely, but it is near an active vent, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 1 回目は雲。2 回目は島の南西岸沖、浅い棚の外側に淡い水色の斑が海岸に沿う。2015-02-07 にもほぼ同じ場所に出ており、棚か沿岸の濁りの可能性が高いが確認したい。
note_en: The first is cloud. The second is a faint light-blue patch off the south-west shore of the island, outside the shallow shelf, following the coast. It also appeared at almost the same place on 2015-02-07; the shelf or coastal turbid water is likely, but I would like to check.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた 2 島の沿岸に沿う淡い灰青の帯 (03-04 は東岸から南西の島へ 4.75 km2、03-19 は南岸に沿う 2.57 km2)。雪の隣接効果か沿岸の薄氷・潮目の可能性が高いが、海峡の水の色の変化を否定しきれない。
note_en: Faint grey-blue bands along the coasts of the two snow-covered islands (03-04: 4.75 km2 from the east shore towards the south-western island; 03-19: 2.57 km2 along the south shore). An adjacency effect from snow, or coastal thin ice or a tide line, is likely, but a change in the colour of the water in the strait cannot be fully ruled out.

note_ja: ロウ島南東岸の沖に淡い白っぽい水 (1.7 km2)、区域中心 (Tuluman) から 0.7 km。区域全体に霞の濃淡があり霞の可能性が高いが、同じ付近に繰り返し出ている。
note_en: Pale whitish water off the south-east shore of Lou Island (1.7 km2), 0.7 km from the zone centre (Tuluman). The whole zone has patchy haze, so most likely haze, but it recurs near the same place.

note_ja: 候補は西側の雲塊の縁に沿う淡い水色の帯で、薄雲のかかりと見るのが自然。ただ前後の通過 (02-12・04-17) でも島の周りに淡い青緑の水が見えるため、念のため確認したい。
note_en: The candidate is a faint light-blue band along the edge of a cloud mass on the west side, most naturally read as thin cloud cover. However, faint blue-green water can be seen around the island on the passes before and after (02-12, 04-17), so I would like to check just in case.

note_ja: 区域中央の北西寄りに水色 (ターコイズ) の変色水の斑があり、積雲とは別に見える。前の 8/15 にも中央に水色の円い斑、後の 9/08 にも南西へ水色の帯があり、カバチの活動が続いていた可能性が高い。
note_en: A patch of light-blue (turquoise) discoloured water north-west of the middle of the zone, visible separately from the cumulus. The earlier 8/15 also has a round light-blue patch in the middle, and the later 9/08 a light-blue band to the south-west; most likely Kavachi's activity was continuing.

note_ja: マヘンゲタン島の南の海岸から淡い白っぽい斑が 1 km ほど延びる。グリントなし、雲から離れている。熱水活動の知られる場所なので確認したい。
note_en: A pale whitish patch extends about 1 km from the south coast of Mahangetang Island. No glint, away from cloud. As this is a place with known hydrothermal activity I would like it checked.

note_ja: この通過の候補は積雲の周りの薄いもやで説明できるが、10-27 の後の通過に区域中心の北に細長い緑の斑が写っている (検出は 0)。念のため確かめたい。
note_en: The candidate on this pass can be explained by thin haze around cumulus, but on the later pass of 10-27 a long, narrow green patch appears north of the zone centre (0 detections). I would like it confirmed to be safe.

note_ja: 礁と海岸。毎回同じ場所に出るので、1 件ずつの確認からは外した (2 回目の遡及調査の報告)。
note_en: Reef and coast. It shows at the same place every time, so it was left out of the one-by-one review (report of the second hindcast).

note_ja: 2026-11-14: 少なくとも2つの島から伸びる海水変色の一部であることは確か。02-26にも同様の変色域がある。
note_en: 2026-11-14: It is certainly part of discoloured water that extends from at least two islands. A similar discoloured area is there on 02-26.

note_ja: Jadid 島 (2013年の新島) の上に細長い白い噴気状の雲が乗り、島から西と南へ緑・水色の変色水が広がる。2013年の噴火の続きに見え、カタログの期間と合わなかっただけかもしれない。
note_en: A long, thin white fumarole-like cloud sits over Jadid Island (the new island of 2013), and green and light-blue discoloured water spreads west and south from the island. It looks like a continuation of the 2013 eruption, and may simply not have matched the catalogue period.

note_ja: 中心の北東 2 km に淡い青白い小斑が 2 つ、中に濃い点がある。小さな積雲の近くで雲の可能性もあるが、気象庁が白色の変色域を確認した区域なので念のため。
note_en: Two small faint bluish-white patches 2 km north-east of the centre, with a dark dot inside. Near small cumulus and could be cloud, but this is a zone where the Japan Meteorological Agency confirmed a white discoloured area, so flagged just in case.

note_ja: 雪に覆われた Ushishir 島の北岸に接して、輪郭のはっきりした淡い青の細長い斑（1.46 km2）がある。周りに薄雲がかかり、岸の浅い水か雪解けの濁りか薄雲か画像からは決めきれない。火口湾の中は常態と同じ青緑。
note_en: Touching the north shore of snow-covered Ushishir Island, a sharply outlined pale blue elongated patch (1.46 km2). Thin cloud lies around it, and the images cannot decide whether it is shallow shore water, snowmelt turbidity or thin cloud. Inside the crater bay it is the same blue-green as usual.

note_ja: Jadid 島の北〜北東端から青緑の水が扇形・鉤形に伸び (12-05・01-16)、02-08・02-10 は島の西側に筋状に広がる。11 回とも島に付着して繰り返し、2013 年の新島の浸食による濁りとみられるが、島からの熱水流出も否定できない。
note_en: Blue-green water extends in fan and hook shapes from the north to north-east tip of Jadid Island (12-05, 01-16), and on 02-08 and 02-10 spreads in streaks to the west of the island. All 11 times it recurs attached to the island; looks like turbid water from erosion of the 2013 new island, but hydrothermal outflow from the island cannot be ruled out either.
